Eligibility Criteria

  • Disc Code 101 – Technician Apprentice (Mechanical): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 102 – Technician Apprentice (Electrical): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Electrical Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 103 – Technician Apprentice (Instrumentation): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Instrumentation Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 104 – Technician Apprentice (Civil): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Civil Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 105 – Technician Apprentice (Electrical & Electronics): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Electrical & Electronics Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 106 – Technician Apprentice (Electronics): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Electronics Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 107 – Trade Apprentice (Fitter): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Fitter) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 108 – Trade Apprentice (Electrician): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Electrician) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 109 – Trade Apprentice (Electronics Mechanic): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Electronics Mechanic) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 110 – Trade Apprentice (Instrument Mechanic): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Instrument Mechanic) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 111 – Trade Apprentice (Machinist): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Machinist) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 112 – Graduate Apprentice (BA/B.Com/B.Sc/BBA): Regular full-time Graduate in any discipline with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 113 – Trade Apprentice – Data Entry Operator (Fresher): Class 12th (but below graduate) with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/Board.
  • Disc Code 114 – Trade Apprentice – Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders): Class 12th (but below graduate) plus Skill Certificate of 'Domestic Data Entry Operator' for training of less than one year issued by an awarding body recognized under National Skill Qualifications Framework or any other authority recognized by the Central Government.
  • Qualification must be from a recognized University/Institute as a full-time regular course. Qualifications acquired through Part-time / Correspondence / Distance Learning mode are NOT ELIGIBLE.
  • For Graduate and Technician disciplines, qualification must be acquired between 01.04.2022 and 28.02.2026.
  • For Trade Apprentices (ITI/Data Entry Operator), qualification must be acquired between 01.04.2021 and 28.02.2026.
  • Candidates possessing higher qualifications such as B.E./B.Tech., MBA, MCA, CA, ICWA, LLB or equivalent are NOT ELIGIBLE.
  • Diploma holders under lateral entry scheme (Class XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year) are also eligible subject to prescribed percentage in aggregate of all semesters.
  • A candidate may undergo a maximum of two apprenticeship trainings, and the second training shall not be in the same trade.

Salary / Stipend

  • Rate of stipend payable to apprentices per month shall be as prescribed under the Apprentices Act, 1961/1973 and Apprentices Rules 1992/2019/2025 as amended from time to time.
  • The exact stipend amount is not specified in the notification; candidates are advised to refer to the latest Apprentices Rules for updated stipend rates.

Age Limit (as on 28-02-2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 Years
  • Maximum Age: 24 Years
  • SC/ST candidates: Age relaxation of 5 years (maximum up to 29 years)
  • OBC-NCL candidates: Age relaxation of 3 years (maximum up to 27 years)
  • PwBD candidates: Age relaxation of up to 10 years (up to 15 years for SC/ST PwBD; up to 13 years for OBC-NCL PwBD)
  • Cutoff/Reckoning date for age criteria: 28.02.2026

Application Fee

  • No Application Fee has been mentioned in the official notification.
  • Candidates apply through NAPS / NATS portals; any charges levied by the portal (if any) are not specified in this notification.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 11/03/2026
Opening of Online Application 11/03/2026 from 10:00 AM onwards
Last Date for Submission of Online Application 26/03/2026 up to 5:00 PM
Document Verification Date To be intimated on registered email ID / IOCL website
Cutoff / Reckoning Date (Age & Qualification) 28/02/2026

Selection Process

  • Candidates must register successfully on NAPS/NATS portal and apply against the notification to be considered for the selection process.
  • There will be no written test or interview.
  • A merit list will be prepared based on the percentage of marks secured in the essential prescribed qualification for the respective post.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for Document Verification.
  • Shortlisted candidates must complete a Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Test and be adjudged medically fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical format.
  • Candidates whose documents and Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Certificate are found in order shall be issued an Offer of Engagement for Apprenticeship Training.
  • Opportunities not filled through the initial shortlisting shall be filled by eligible candidates from the merit cum panel list for the same opportunity.

General Information / Instructions

  • Candidates must apply only for ONE discipline code. Applications for more than one discipline code will be summarily rejected.
  • Applicants must submit applications only against vacancies notified under the states of Western Region (Maharashtra, Gujarat, Goa, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, UT of Daman & Diu, UT of Dadra & Nagar Haveli). Selection of training locations outside notified states will result in rejection.
  • Candidate profile on the portal must be 100% complete (Personal Details, Educational Details, Category, etc.).
  • The candidature of the applicant shall be provisional and subject to subsequent verification of certificates and testimonials.
  • Any false or incorrect information furnished at any stage will lead to cancellation of candidature and liability for criminal prosecution.
  • Candidates should maintain the same registered email ID and mobile number till completion of apprenticeship training.
  • SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates applying for Unreserved (UR) seats shall be considered subject to fulfilling standards applicable to General category candidates.
  • PwBD candidates are NOT eligible to apply for Discipline Codes 101, 102, 103, 104, 105, 106, 107, 108, 109, 110, 111.
  • Reservation will be applicable as per the prescribed percentage for the respective States/UT.
  • No. of seats indicated is tentative and may increase or decrease at the absolute discretion of management.
  • Upon completion of the Apprenticeship period, IOCL shall have NO obligation to offer employment, nor can an Apprentice claim the right for employment.
  • A minimum one-year gap between two apprenticeship trainings is required, provided the previous training is completed.
  • All future correspondence and latest information shall be shared only on IOCL website: https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships.
  • For OBC-NCL category, candidates must submit a latest caste certificate not more than 12 months old from 28.02.2026 in the Proforma prescribed by Govt. of India.
  • Canvassing of any kind shall disqualify the candidate.

How to Apply

  • Candidates meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria must apply online only through the NAPS/NATS Portal.
  • For Trade Apprentice (ITI/Data Entry Operator): Register at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/ (NAPS)
  • For Technician Apprentice (Diploma) and Graduate Apprentice: Register at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php (NATS)
  • After registration, login to the respective NATS/NAPS portal using your User ID/Email ID and APPLY for apprenticeship openings using the following Establishment IDs of IOCL (Marketing Division) – Western Region:
    • NATS Establishment ID: WMHMCC000053
    • NAPS Establishment ID: E01172700332
  • Application window: 11.03.2026 (10:00 AM) to 26.03.2026 (5:00 PM).
  • No other means or mode of application will be accepted.
  • Ensure your profile is 100% complete with Personal Details, Educational Details, and Category before applying.
  • Before applying, keep ready: PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, Bank Account details with Cheque Book (name printed), and scanned copies of Educational Qualification Certificates.
  • Candidates are advised to apply well in advance before the last date to avoid last-minute technical issues.
  • Candidates registered with Local/State Employment Exchange(s) / Vocational Rehabilitation Centre for PwBD and meeting prescribed eligibility criteria must apply through NAPS/NATS Portal.

Candidates must qualify the APPSC TGT Written Exam 2026 by securing the prescribed minimum marks to be shortlisted for the APPSC TGT Viva‑Voce round.

Stage 1 – APPSC TGT Written Examination 2026

  • The APPSC TGT Written Examination (Objective) consists of two parts – a General paper and a Concerned Subject paper, together carrying a total of 450 marks.
  • Paper 1 – General English, General Studies, Aptitude & Pedagogy (Objective): 150 marks.
  • Paper 2 – Concerned Subject (Objective): 300 marks in the relevant TGT subject (e.g. English, Hindi, Mathematics, Science, Social Science, etc.).
  • There is negative marking in the APPSC TGT exam – 1/6th of the marks allotted to the question will be deducted for each wrong answer.
  • To qualify the written exam, a candidate must secure at least the minimum qualifying marks prescribed in the notification (overall aggregate as well as subject‑wise), only then they will be considered for the next stage of the APPSC TGT selection process 2026.

Stage 2 – APPSC TGT Viva‑Voce & Classroom Teaching 2026

  • Candidates who qualify in the written examination will be shortlisted in order of merit in a ratio of about 3 times the number of advertised TGT vacancies for the Viva‑Voce and Classroom Teaching test.
  • The APPSC TGT Viva‑Voce and Classroom Teaching carries 50 marks and is conducted on the premises of the Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission.
  • This stage evaluates the candidate’s subject knowledge, teaching skills, communication ability, classroom handling and overall suitability for the Trained Graduate Teacher post.

Final Merit List – APPSC Trained Graduate Teacher 2026

  • The final selection for APPSC Trained Graduate Teacher Recruitment 2026 is made on the basis of total marks obtained out of 500 marks (450 marks in Written Examination + 50 marks in Viva‑Voce & Classroom Teaching).
  • Candidates who fail to meet the minimum qualifying marks in the written exam or are found ineligible at document verification will not be considered for final appointment as APPSC TGT, even if they appeared in the examination.

How to Apply for APPSC TGT Recruitment 2026

The application process for APPSC Trained Graduate Teacher Recruitment 2026 is completely online. Eligible candidates must first complete One Time Registration (OTR) on the APPSC portal and then submit the APPSC TGT Application Form 2026 within the specified dates.

  • Step 1: Visit the official website of Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission at www.appsc.gov.in.
  • Step 2: Click on the “One Time Registration (OTR)” link and complete the registration by entering basic details to generate your Login ID and password (if already registered, skip this step and log in directly).
  • Step 3: After successful OTR, log in with your registered User ID and password and open the online application link for Advertisement No. 02/2026 – Trained Graduate Teacher Examination 2026 (Secondary Level).
  • Step 4: Fill in the APPSC TGT online application form with accurate personal details, contact information, TGT subject/post, category, educational qualifications and B.Ed details as per your certificates.
  • Step 5: Upload scanned copies of your recent passport‑size photograph, signature and required documents (photo ID, APST certificate, PwBD certificate, etc.) in the prescribed format and file size.
  • Step 6: Pay the APPSC TGT application fee 2026 online – ₹150 for APST candidates and ₹200 for other candidates, while PwBD candidates are exempted from fee payment.
  • Step 7: Carefully review all details entered in the APPSC TGT Application Form 2026; submit only a single, fully completed application. In case of multiple forms, the one with the highest Registration ID and complete details will be considered.
  • Step 8: Click on “Submit” to finalise the form and download/print the submitted APPSC TGT application form and fee receipt for future reference, written examination and document verification.

Applicants are advised to complete the APPSC TGT online form 2026 well before the last date to avoid last‑minute technical issues and ensure successful submission.

AP DME Senior Resident Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates applying for AP DME Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 must ensure that they fully satisfy the prescribed eligibility criteria regarding qualification, age limit and local status before submitting the online application form.

Educational Qualification: Applicants must possess a postgraduate medical degree MD/MS in the concerned specialty or a DNB degree in Broad Specialties granted by a recognized medical institution with an attached hospital or by a hospital with at least 500 beds, as per National Medical Commission and Medical Institutions (Qualifications of Faculty) Regulations, 2025.

Registration in AP Medical Council: The candidate should be registered with the Andhra Pradesh Medical Council and must hold a valid registration certificate at the time of applying for AP Senior Resident posts 2026.

Age Limit: For AP DME Senior Resident Recruitment 2026, the upper age limit is generally 44 years for clinical specialties and higher (for example up to 49 years) as on the date of notification as specified in the AP Senior Resident notification. Candidates must check the exact age criteria and any applicable relaxations in the official advertisement.

Local Candidature: Local candidates of Andhra Pradesh will be given preference for selection to AP Senior Resident posts, based on study certificates (such as study from 4th to 10th class in AP) or other documents prescribed in the notification. Non‑local candidates with valid AP Medical Registration may be considered only if suitable local candidates are not available.

Other Eligibility Conditions: Candidates already working as Senior Residents in Government Medical Colleges of Andhra Pradesh are generally not eligible to apply again under this AP DME Senior Resident Recruitment 2026. Applicants must also satisfy all conditions related to caste, EWS, disability status and reservation norms as per rules of Government of Andhra Pradesh and the Directorate of Medical Education.

AP DME Senior Resident Salary 2026

Candidates appointed through AP DME Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 will be engaged on a fixed monthly honorarium as notified by the Government of Andhra Pradesh.

Monthly Remuneration: Selected Senior Residents in Broad Specialties will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 80,500/- per month as per G.O.Ms.No.723 HM&FW (C1) Department dated 04.12.2024.

Tenure of Engagement: The Senior Resident post is a tenure position for one year only and selected candidates are required to compulsorily complete the one-year Senior Residency period as per AP DME rules.

No Claim for Permanent Appointment: The Senior Resident engagement is purely on tenure basis and does not confer any right for regularization or permanent absorption in Government Medical Colleges and Hospitals of Andhra Pradesh.

AP DME Senior Resident Application Fees 2026

Applicants for AP DME Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 must pay the prescribed application fee online while submitting the application form.

Application Fee for OC Candidates: Candidates belonging to Open Category (OC) have to pay an application fee of Rs. 2000/- for AP Senior Resident posts.

Application Fee for BC/SC/ST Candidates: Candidates belonging to BC, SC and ST categories are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 1000/- for submitting the AP DME Senior Resident application form 2026.

Mode of Payment: The AP Senior Resident application fee must be paid through the specified online payment mode integrated with the application portal, and applications without successful fee payment will be rejected.

AP DME Senior Resident Selection Process 2026

The AP DME Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 selection process will be based on merit in the postgraduate examination and applicable reservation rules.

Merit-Based Shortlisting: The marks obtained in the postgraduate exam (MD/MS/DNB – theory and practical) will be considered for preparing the merit list for Senior Resident posts in Broad Specialties.

Rule of Reservation: Selection will be carried out by strictly following the Rule of Reservation (RoR) as per the State and Subordinate Service rules of Andhra Pradesh, applying category-wise reservation to the available Senior Resident vacancies.

Tie-Breaker Criteria: In case two or more candidates secure the same postgraduate marks, the date of birth will be used as a tie-breaker and the elder candidate will be given preference in AP Senior Resident selection 2026.

Final Decision of Selection Committee: The selection committee reserves the right to modify conditions, alter notified posts and finalize the selection list in accordance with AP DME guidelines and Government orders.

How to Apply for AP DME Senior Resident Recruitment 2026

Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria for AP DME Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 must submit their applications exclusively through the online mode within the prescribed dates.

Step 1 – Visit Official DME AP Website: Go to the official website of the Directorate of Medical Education, Andhra Pradesh and open the link for “Senior Residents-2026 Notification No. 1/2026”.

Step 2 – Read Notification Carefully: Download and read the detailed AP DME Senior Resident Notification 2026 to understand the eligibility conditions, department-wise vacancies, selection process, documents required and important instructions for online application.

Step 3 – Online Registration: Complete the candidate registration on the AP DME portal by providing basic details such as name, mobile number, email ID and AP Medical Council registration details to generate login credentials for AP Senior Resident application 2026.

Step 4 – Fill Online Application Form: Log in using the credentials and fill the AP Senior Resident online application form with personal information, educational qualifications (MBBS and MD/MS/DNB), marks in postgraduate exams, local status details, category, and other required data accurately.

Step 5 – Upload Required Documents: Upload scanned copies of the prescribed documents such as SSC certificate (date of birth proof), AP Medical Council registration, PG mark sheets, MBBS and PG degree/provisional certificates, study certificates (4th to 10th), social status certificate (SC/ST/BC/EWS), PH certificate and Aadhaar card in the specified format and size.

Step 6 – Pay Application Fee Online: Pay the applicable AP DME Senior Resident application fee (Rs. 2000 for OC, Rs. 1000 for BC/SC/ST) through the available online payment options on the portal and ensure that the payment status is successful.

Step 7 – Submit Application Form: After verifying all entered details, uploaded documents and fee payment, submit the AP Senior Resident application form 2026 online before the last date mentioned in the notification, as no offline applications will be accepted.

Step 8 – Print Application for Record: Download and take a printout of the successfully submitted AP DME Senior Resident application form and fee payment receipt for future reference during verification and appointment process.

AP High Court Recruitment 2026 - Overview

Advertisement

AP High Court Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

AP High Court has published the official notification for recruitment of 300 posts vide Notification No. 01/2026/Estt., dated 20.03.2026. The detailed notification and online application link are available on the official APHC website [aphc.gov.in](https://aphc.gov.in) under Recruitment section.

Apply Online

The AP High Court Recruitment 2026 announces a total of 300 posts with community-wise reservation (121 General/OC, 33 EWS, 24 BC-A, 26 BC-B, 3 BC-C, 19 BC-D, 12 BC-E, 4 SC-A, 20 SC-B, 20 SC-C, 18 SC-D, and ST). AP High Court Eligibility Criteria 2026

AP High Court eligibility criteria include age limit, educational qualification and other conditions. All conditions must be fulfilled as on 01.01.2026.

Age Limit & Relaxation 2026

Particulars Details

Age Relaxation for Sports Quota As per respective community/category

AP High Court Educational Qualification 2026

Educational and professional qualifications for AP High Court Recruitment 2026 are post-specific and must be from Government-recognised universities/institutions.

  • Section Officer: Degree in Law (3 or 5 years course). Preference for computer skills.
  • Senior System Officer: B.Tech (CSE/ECE/EEE/IT)/M.Sc. Computer Science + Certificate with 5 years work experience on Networking and Server Maintenance Administration.
  • Computer Operator: Degree in Computer Science + Typewriting English Higher Grade (45 w.p.m.).
  • Assistant Librarian: Degree in Law (3 or 5 years) + B.Li.Sc. + Computer skills certificate for library maintenance.
  • Librarian Grade-II: Degree in Arts/Science/Commerce/Law + B.Li.Sc.
  • U.D. Stenographer: Degree in Arts/Science/Commerce/Law + Shorthand English (120 w.p.m.) + Typewriting English Higher Grade (45 w.p.m.).
  • Assistant/Examiner/Copyist: Degree in Arts/Science/Commerce/Law.
  • Typist: Degree in Arts/Science/Commerce/Law + Typewriting English Higher Grade (45 w.p.m.).
  • Data Entry Operator: Degree with Computer Science as main subject + Typewriting English Higher Grade (45 w.p.m.).
  • Stenographer: Degree in Arts/Science/Commerce/Law + Shorthand English (80 w.p.m.) + Typewriting English Higher Grade (45 w.p.m.).
  • Office Subordinate: Pass in 7th Class or equivalent. Candidates who failed Intermediate or equivalent will be considered but those with higher qualifications will not be eligible.

AP High Court Selection Process 2026

The AP High Court Selection Process 2026 includes two stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Examination

  • Section Officer: General Knowledge (20 Marks) + Mental Ability (10 Marks) + Law Civil/Criminal (50 Marks) = 80 Marks
  • All Other Degree Posts: General Knowledge (40 Marks) + Mental Ability (40 Marks) = 80 Marks
  • Office Subordinate: General Knowledge (50 Marks) + Mental Ability (30 Marks) = 80 Marks
  • Total Questions: 80 (Each 1 mark)
  • Duration: 90 Minutes
  • Language: English and Telugu (English version final)
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: 40% (OC/EWS), 35% (BC), 30% (SC/ST/PwBD)

Stage 2: Skill Test (For Selected Posts Only)

  • Applicable for: Senior System Officer, Computer Operator, U.D. Stenographer, Stenographer, Typist, Copyist, Data Entry Operator
  • Computer Based Examination marks used for screening only (not added to final merit)
  • Final selection based ONLY on Skill Test performance
  • Skill Test mode and particulars will be uploaded on aphc.gov.in

Merit List Preparation

  • For Section Officer, Assistant Librarian, Librarian Gr.-II, Assistant, Examiner, Office Subordinate: Merit based on Computer Based Examination marks
  • For Senior System Officer, Computer Operator, U.D. Stenographer, Stenographer, Typist, Copyist, DEO: Merit based ONLY on Skill Test marks
  • Tie-breaker: Age (elder first) → Higher educational qualification → Highest marks in prescribed qualification
  • Score normalization for multi-shift examinations will be applied

AP High Court Salary 2026

Selected candidates will receive the following monthly salary as per AP State Pay Scales:

  • Section Officer: ₹57,100 - ₹1,47,760
  • Senior System Officer: ₹44,570 - ₹1,27,480
  • Computer Operator: ₹40,970 - ₹1,24,380
  • Assistant Librarian: ₹40,970 - ₹1,24,380
  • Librarian Grade-II: ₹35,570 - ₹1,09,910
  • U.D. Stenographer: ₹34,580 - ₹1,27,480
  • Assistant/Examiner/Typist/Copyist/Data Entry Operator/Stenographer: ₹25,220 - ₹80,910
  • Office Subordinate: ₹20,000 - ₹61,960

This appointment shall be covered by the Contributory Pension Scheme.

How to Apply for AP High Court Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates can apply for AP High Court Recruitment 2026 by following the steps given below.

  1. Visit official AP High Court website [aphc.gov.in](https://aphc.gov.in)
  2. Navigate to Recruitment section and click on Notification No. 01/2026/Estt.
  3. Read the complete notification carefully
  4. Click on "Apply Online" link (available from 30.03.2026)
  5. Complete registration with valid email ID and mobile number
  6. Login and fill all mandatory details in the application form (Personal Information, Educational Qualifications, Upload Documents, Payment)
  7. Upload required documents:
    • Pass certificates and marksheets
    • Date of Birth certificate (SSC/10th certificate)
    • Caste certificate (if applicable - SC/ST/BC/EWS)
    • Non-Creamy Layer certificate (for BC candidates - issued in 2025 or 2026)
    • EWS Certificate (issued in 2025 or 2026 showing annual family income below ₹8,00,000)
    • PwBD Certificate (issued in 2025 or 2026 by Medical Board)
    • Ex-Servicemen Discharge Certificate (if applicable)
    • No Objection Certificate from employer (if employed)
    • Recent passport size photograph and signature
  8. Pay application fee online:
    • OC/EWS/BC candidates: ₹800 per post
    • SC/ST/PwBD candidates: ₹400 per post (only AP recognized SC/ST)
  9. Choose examination center preference (3 preferences)
  10. Verify all details and click Final Submit before 19.04.2026 (11:59 PM)
  11. Take printout of the submitted application for future reference

Important Instructions

  • Only online applications will be accepted; no other mode entertained
  • Candidates must pay separate fee for each post applied
  • Application fee once paid is non-refundable
  • BC candidates must upload latest non-creamy layer certificate issued in 2025 or 2026, otherwise considered under Open Category
  • EWS candidates must upload latest certificate issued in 2025 or 2026 showing annual family income below ₹8,00,000
  • PwBD candidates must upload latest disability certificate issued in 2025 or 2026 by Medical Board
  • 33.13% posts reserved for women as per G.O.Ms.No.77 dated 02.08.2023
  • Selection against BC-E vacancy subject to outcome of Civil Appeal Nos.2628-2637/2010 pending before Supreme Court
  • Waitlist will be maintained for one year
  • No TA/DA will be paid for examination or skill test
  • Bigamy marriage candidates not eligible
  • Persons dismissed/terminated/removed from government service not eligible
  • Persons convicted for moral turpitude not eligible
  • AP High Court reserves the right to increase/decrease vacancies or cancel notification at any stage
  • All announcements will be made only on official website aphc.gov.in; candidates advised to visit regularly

Eligibility criteria - South Central Railway Act Apprentice 2025-26

1) Educational qualification​

  • 10th class/SSC passed under 10+2 system with minimum 50% aggregate marks from a recognised board.

  • ITI certificate in the relevant notified trade from an institute recognised by NCVT/SCVT (trade-wise: AC Mechanic, Carpenter, COPA, Diesel Mechanic, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic, Fitter, Industrial Electronics, Machinist, MMTM, Motor Mechanic Vehicle, Painter, Welder).

  • Candidate must possess required qualification as on date of online application submission.

  • Engineering graduates and diploma holders are not eligible for this Act Apprentice notification (covered under separate scheme).

2) Age limit (as on 11.04.2026)​

  • Minimum age: 15 years.

  • Maximum age: 24 years.

Category-wise permissible date of birth range:

Category Date of birth between
UR / EWS 11-04-2002 and 11-04-2011
SC / ST 11-04-1997 and 11-04-2011
OBC-NCL 11-04-1999 and 11-04-2011
Ex-Servicemen / PwBD (UR) 11-04-1992 and 11-04-2011
Ex-Servicemen / PwBD (SC/ST) 11-04-1987 and 11-04-2011
Ex-Servicemen / PwBD (OBC) 11-04-1989 and 11-04-2011

Relaxations included in above ranges:

  • SC/ST: +5 years.

  • OBC-NCL: +3 years.

  • PwBD: +10 years.

  • Ex-Servicemen: +10 years up to length of service in Defence Forces (no extra relaxation for their children).

3) Residential / jurisdiction eligibility​
Candidates must reside in districts under South Central Railway jurisdiction and provide valid proof of residence. Eligible areas:

  • Telangana: all districts.

  • Andhra Pradesh: all districts except Manyam, Srikakulam, Vizianagaram.

  • Maharashtra: Akola, Amaravati, Aurangabad, Beed, Chandrapur, Hingoli, Jalna, Latur, Nanded, Nasik, Parbhani, Washim, Yavatmal.

  • Karnataka: Balki, Bellari, Belgaum, Bidar, Gulbarga/Kalaburgi, Raichur, Yadgir.

  • Tamil Nadu: Vellore.

  • Madhya Pradesh: Burhanpur, Khandwa.

4) Category certificates (for reservation)​

  • SC/ST: Central Government format caste certificate (Annexure-B).

  • OBC-NCL: caste + NCL certificate (issued within 3 years) in Central format (Annexure-C) + self-declaration (Annexure-D).

  • EWS: valid Income & Asset certificate (Annexure-E).

  • PwBD: disability ≥40% in prescribed format (Annexure-G/H).

5) Salary/Stipend

  • Selected candidates will be paid a stipend during the apprenticeship at the prescribed rates as per extant instructions.

SCR Apprentice Selection Process 2025-26

  • Merit List Basis: Selection for SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 will be done purely on merit, by taking the average of percentage marks in 10th (minimum 50% aggregate) and ITI marks, giving equal weightage to both.
  • No Exam / Interview: There will be no written test or viva-voce for South Central Railway Apprentice Recruitment 2025-26.
  • Tie-breaking: If two candidates have the same aggregate percentage, older candidate (higher age) will be preferred; if DOB is also same, the candidate who passed Matriculation earlier will be preferred.
  • Document Verification (DV): Shortlisted candidates will be called for DV where all original certificates (education, ITI, caste, EWS, PwBD, ExSM, RDAT registration, medical fitness) will be verified.
  • Medical Fitness: Candidates must produce medical fitness certificate from a government-authorised doctor (Gazetted, not below Asst. Surgeon) in prescribed format at DV; without this, they will not be considered.
  • Training & Stipend: Selected candidates will undergo apprenticeship training as per Central Apprenticeship Council syllabus and receive stipend at prescribed rates during training.
  • No Job Guarantee: SCR apprenticeship 2025-26 provides training only; there is no guarantee of regular railway job after completion of apprenticeship.

South Central Railway Apprentice Application Form 2026

  • Application Mode: Online only via RRC/SCR portal; no offline forms will be accepted.
  • Application Dates: SCR Apprentice online form 2026 is available from 12 March 2026 (17:00 hrs) to 11 April 2026 (23:59 hrs).
  • Fee: ₹100 for applicable categories; SC/ST, female/Transgender and PwBD candidates are exempt from fee payment.
  • Multiple Trades: Candidates with ITI in more than one trade can submit separate SCR Apprentice application 2026 for each trade.
  • Communication: All updates regarding SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 application form, merit list and DV will be sent via registered email/SMS and uploaded on RRC-SCR webpage only.

How to Apply for South Central Railway Apprentice Recruitment 2025-26

  1. Visit the official South Central Railway website: https://scr.indianrailways.gov.in and go to About Us → RRC-SCR to open the ONLINE ACT APPRENTICE APPLICATION link.
  2. Read the detailed SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 notification carefully and ensure you belong to the eligible states/districts and possess required 10th + ITI qualification.
  3. Complete Registration: select state and district, upload address proof, enter valid mobile number and email ID, create a password and verify OTPs sent to mobile and email.
  4. Login as a registered candidate and fill in personal details (name, DOB, category, etc.) and educational/technical details (10th marks, ITI trade, ITI marks, RDAT registration number).
  5. Select your priority/preference of training units (Divisions/Workshops/Sheds) only for trades you are eligible for; options once submitted cannot be changed.
  6. Upload a recent colour photograph (JPEG, ≤1 MB, not older than 3 months), signature image (≤1 MB) and required certificates (10th, ITI, RDAT form, caste, EWS, PwBD, ExSM, medical certificate) in PDF format (≤2 MB).
  7. Ensure you have completed RDAT/NAPS registration at www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in and obtained registration number before filling the SCR apprentice application.
  8. Check all details in the Preview page carefully; after clicking Submit, no modification will be allowed.
  9. Pay the application fee (if applicable) through online payment gateway (Net Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI) and generate e-receipt.
  10. Download/print the final submitted SCR Apprentice application form 2026 and keep it along with fee receipt and uploaded documents for Document Verification.

Gauhati High Court Stenographer Grade III Selection Process 2026

The selection process consists of three stages:

Stage I – Stenography Test (Dictation & Transcription) – 90 Marks

  • Voice testing before dictation (2 minutes).
  • Dictation in shorthand at 80 wpm (total 560 words in 7 minutes).​
  • Time allowed for testing computer: 3 minutes.​
  • Time for transcription on computer: 20 minutes

Stage II – Written Test (Descriptive) – 100 Marks, 2 Hours (Qualifying)

  • English Language Segment – 80 marks (Composition, Essay, Grammar).​
  • Mizo Language Segment – 20 marks.​
  • Candidates in ratio of 1:10 from the stenography merit list will be called for the written test.​
  • Minimum qualifying marks:
  • 40% in English segment (32/80).​
  • 40% in Mizo segment (8/20).​
  • Written test is qualifying in nature and marks will not be counted for final merit.​

Stage III – Interview / Viva‑Voce – 30 Marks

  • Candidates in ratio of 1:3 in order of merit in stenography test will be called for Interview/Viva‑Voce, subject to qualifying written test.​
  • Minimum qualifying marks: 60% (18 out of 30) in Interview/Viva‑Voce.​

Final merit

Final selection will be based on total marks obtained in Stenography Skill Test and Interview/Viva‑Voce only. If two or more candidates secure the same grand total, higher marks in the stenography test will be given preference; if still tied, the candidate senior in age will be preferred.

Punjab Police Constable Selection Process 2026

The Punjab Police Constable Recruitment 2026 selection process consists of three stages:

Stage-I: Computer Based Test (CBT)

The CBT comprises two papers:

Paper-I (100 marks, 2 hours duration)

Section Topics Number of Questions
General Awareness Constitution, Central & State Legislature, History, Geography, Culture & Economy of Punjab, Health & Nutrition, Current Affairs 35
Quantitative Aptitude and Numerical Skills Simplification, Average, Decimal & Fractions, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Profit & Loss, Simple Interest, Time & Work 20
Mental Ability & Logical Reasoning Number & Letter Series, Sequencing, Statements & Conclusions, Pattern Completion, Order & Ranking, Direction & Distances, Relationship Problems 20
English Language Skills Reading Comprehension, Punjabi to English Translation, Sentence rearrangement & correction, Error Spotting, Fill in the Blanks, Spelling Correction, Vocabulary 10
Punjabi Language Skills ਸ਼ੁੱਧ/ਅਸ਼ੁੱਧ, ਸਮਾਨਾਰਥਕ/ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਸ਼ਬਦ, ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਅਖਾਣ ਅਤੇ ਮੁਹਾਵਰੇ, ਅੰਗਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਤੋਂ ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਅਨੁਵਾਦ, etc. 10
Digital Literacy & Awareness Fundamentals of Computers, MS Office, Internet, Email Communication, Mobile Phones 05
Total   100

Paper-II (50 marks, 1 hour duration) – Mandatory Qualifying Paper

  • Punjabi Language test of Matriculation standard
  • Qualifying criteria: 50% marks (25 out of 50)
  • Note: Marks obtained in Paper-II will NOT be counted for merit calculation

Minimum Qualifying Marks (Paper-I after normalization):

  • SC/BC/EWS/Ex-Servicemen: 35%
  • Other categories: 40%

Important Points:

  • No negative marking
  • Normalization will be applied as CBT conducted in multiple shifts
  • Answer key will be published after exam; candidates can raise objections within 48 hours (Rs. 50 per objection)

Stage-II: Physical Screening Test (PST) & Physical Measurement Test (PMT)

Candidates qualifying Paper-I and Paper-II will be shortlisted for Stage-II based on merit.

Physical Screening Test (PST):

Candidate Category Physical Tests
Male (including Ex-servicemen below 35 years) • 1600 meters race in 6 min 30 sec (1 chance)
• Long Jump 3.80 meters (3 chances)
• High Jump 1.10 meters (3 chances)
Ex-Servicemen Male (above 35 years) • 1400 meters walk/run in 12 min (1 chance)
• 10 Full Squats within 3 minutes (1 chance)
Female/Transgender (including Ex-servicemen below 35 years) • 800 meters race in 4 min 30 sec (1 chance)
• Long Jump 3.00 meters (3 chances)
• High Jump 0.95 meters (3 chances)
Ex-Servicemen Female (above 35 years) • 800 meters run in 6 minutes (1 chance)

Physical Measurement Test (PMT):

  • Height measurement as per eligibility criteria mentioned above
  • Candidates not meeting minimum height will be disqualified

Note: Pregnant female candidates may request postponement of PST/PMT by submitting medical certificate from government hospital. One opportunity will be given within 6 months after delivery.

Stage-III: Document Scrutiny

Candidates qualifying Stage-II will be called for document verification. Required documents include:

  • Matriculation certificate (proof of age)
  • 10+2 or equivalent certificate
  • Punjabi qualification proof
  • Domicile certificate (for female candidates applying under General category)
  • Category certificate (SC/BC/EWS/Ex-Servicemen, etc.)
  • NOC (for serving government employees)
  • Photo identity proof (Aadhaar, Driving License, PAN, Voter ID, or Passport)

Note: Candidates unable to produce original documents will not be considered for selection.

  2. Click on "Punjab Police Constable Recruitment 2026" link under latest notifications
  3. Complete registration with basic details and generate login credentials
  4. Log in and fill the online application form with personal, educational, and cadre preference details
  5. For District Cadre, fill 15 district preferences in order of priority (selected candidates will not be posted in their home district)

  7. Pay application fee online through available payment modes
  8. Submit the form and download/print the final submitted application for future reference
  9. Note your Registration ID and keep checking portal for updates

Important: Candidates are advised to apply well before the closing date to avoid last-minute server load issues.

How to Apply for Punjab Police Constable Recruitment 2026

  • Applications must only be submitted in the online mode on https:///ur.ls/punjabpolicerecruitment2026.

  • Applicants are advised to read the instructions, as given on the Recruitment Portal, carefully, before filling-up the application form.

  • Disc Code 106 – Technician Apprentice (Electronics): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Electronics Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 107 – Trade Apprentice (Fitter): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Fitter) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 108 – Trade Apprentice (Electrician): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Electrician) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.

  • Disc Code 113 – Trade Apprentice – Data Entry Operator (Fresher): Class 12th (but below graduate) with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/Board.

  • Candidates must register successfully on NAPS/NATS portal and apply against the notification to be considered for the selection process.

  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for Document Verification.

IIFCL Grade A & Grade B Eligibility Criteria 2026

For both IIFCL Assistant Manager (Grade A) and IIFCL Manager (Grade B) posts, candidates must be citizens of India and meet the age, educational qualification and post‑qualification experience as on 28 February 2026.

Age Limit

  • Assistant Manager (Grade A): 21 to 30 years as on 28 February 2026 (candidate must have attained 21 years and must not have attained 30 years).

  • Relaxations in upper age limit for SC, ST, OBC (NCL), EWS, PwBD, Ex‑Servicemen and children/family members of 1984 riots victims are applicable as per Government of India rules.

Educational Qualification & Experience (Common pattern)

  • Generalist Streams (Grade A & Grade B): Postgraduate degree/diploma in any discipline or professional qualifications such as LLB/BA+LLB, Chartered Accountant (CA), Company Secretary (CS), CMA/ICWA, B.Tech/B.E. with required post‑qualification officer‑cadre experience in Banks/Financial Institutions/PSUs/government or reputed organisations.

IIFCL Grade A & Grade B Selection Process 2026

The IIFCL Grade A & Grade B Selection Process 2026 is identical for both posts and consists of two phases – an online examination followed by a technical and behavioural interview.

  • Phase I – Online Examination: Objective type, 200 marks, with two tests – Test I (Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, English Language, Current Affairs related to Financial Sector – 100 marks) and Test II (Domain Knowledge – 100 marks). Total 150 questions, 120 minutes with sectional time limits, and negative marking of 1/4th of the marks for each wrong answer.
  • Phase II – Interview: Candidates shortlisted based on Phase I performance will be called for an interview of 100 marks, which may be conducted in Hindi or English at IIFCL’s office in New Delhi.
  • Final Merit List: Prepared by combining marks of Online Examination (Phase I) and Interview (Phase II) with a weightage of 40:60 respectively; candidates must qualify both stages and rank sufficiently high in merit to be selected.
  • IIFCL may additionally conduct Group Discussion, psychometric tests or other assessment tools, and reserves the right to change the selection procedure or exam structure as notified on its website.

SSB Constable Eligibility Criteria 2026

SSB Constable Tradesman & Driver eligibility criteria include nationality, age limit, educational qualification, trade experience and medical/physical standards, and all conditions must be fulfilled as on the closing date of application.

Nationality

  • For Constables (Washerman, Barber, Water Carrier, Waiter, Tailor, Gardener, Cobbler): The candidate must be a citizen of India.
  • For Constables (Driver, Veterinary, Carpenter, Nursing Orderly): Only Indian citizens will normally be appointed, but subjects of Nepal or Bhutan are not debarred subject to Central Government permission.

Age Limit

The crucial date for determining age and all eligibility criteria is the last date for receipt of online applications, i.e. 30 days from the date of publication in Employment News.

  • Constable (Veterinary): 18 to 27 years
  • Constable (Driver) – Male: 18 to 27 years
  • Constable (Gardener, Water Carrier, Cobbler, Tailor, Washerman, Barber, Waiter): 18 to 23 years
  • Constable (Carpenter): 18 to 25 years
  • Constable (Nursing Orderly): 18 to 27 years

Age Relaxation

  • SC/ST: 5 years
  • OBC: 3 years
  • Ex-Servicemen: 3 years after deduction of military service rendered from actual age.
  • Departmental candidates (Central Government employees) and special categories such as J&K/Ladakh domiciles and dependents of 1984 riot victims get relaxation as per notified limits.

SSB Constable Educational Qualification 2026

Educational and professional qualifications for SSB Constable Tradesman & Driver Recruitment 2026 are post-specific and must be from recognised boards/ITI/Institutes.

  • Constable (Veterinary): 10th pass with Science as main subject from a recognised board and 1 year experience in treatment of different species of animals in a recognised veterinary hospital.
  • Constable (Driver) – Male: 10th pass from a recognised board and must possess a valid Heavy Vehicle Driving Licence.
  • Constables (Gardener, Water Carrier, Cobbler, Tailor, Washerman, Barber, Waiter): Matriculation or equivalent plus either 2 years work experience in the respective trade, or 1 year certificate course from recognised ITI/Vocational institute with at least 1 year experience, or 2 years diploma from recognised ITI in the trade or similar trade; must qualify trade test; multi-skilled candidates will be given preference.
  • Constable (Carpenter): Matriculation or equivalent and either 2 years work experience in the trade, or 1 year ITI/Vocational certificate with 1 year experience, or 2 years ITI diploma in the trade; must qualify trade test.
  • Constable (Nursing Orderly): 10th pass, First Aid certificate from St. John’s Ambulance Organisation or Red Cross Society of India, and minimum 1 year working experience as Nursing Orderly in a 50-bedded hospital/institution recognised by Central/State Government.

Candidates who are appearing in examination/awaiting results or not in possession of educational/professional certificates on the last date of application need not apply.

SSB Constable Selection Process 2026

The SSB Constable Tradesman & Driver Selection Process 2026 comprises multiple stages, and only those candidates who qualify each stage as per SSB norms will be considered for final appointment.

  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET): For Constables (Veterinary, Driver, Gardener, Water Carrier, Cobbler, Tailor, Washerman, Barber, Waiter, Carpenter & Nursing Orderly), PET consists of 4.8 km race in 24 minutes for male candidates and 2.4 km race in 18 minutes for female candidates; Ex-Servicemen are exempted from PET but must attend other stages.
  • Physical Standard Test (PST): Candidates who qualify PET will undergo PST where height and chest (for male candidates) are measured as per category and region-wise standards; those not meeting minimum standards are rejected.
  • Written Examination: Objective-type written test as per SSB pattern for Constable posts (detailed scheme to be provided on official website/notification).
  • Trade/Skill Test: Practical trade test for Tradesman posts and driving/maintenance test for Driver post to assess hands-on skills.
  • Documentation & Medical Examination: Verification of original documents, certificates, category proofs followed by medical examination as per SSB medical standards.

SSB Constable Exam Pattern 2026

The SSB Constable written exam pattern 2026 for Tradesman, Driver and other posts will generally include questions from General Knowledge, Elementary Mathematics, Reasoning and Trade-related subjects as per SSB guidelines.

Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed exam scheme and syllabus published on the official SSB website and in the detailed recruitment notification before starting preparation.

SSB Constable Salary 2026

All SSB Constable Tradesman, Driver, Veterinary, Carpenter and Nursing Orderly posts are placed in Pay Level-3 (₹21,700–69,100) of the 7th Central Pay Commission.

In addition to basic pay, Constables are entitled to Dearness Allowance, Ration Money Allowance, House Rent Allowance and other admissible allowances, and will be covered under Defined Contributory Pension Scheme or Unified Pension Scheme as applicable for new central government entrants.

SSB Constable Application Fee 2026

  • Applications submitted without successful online fee payment (where applicable) will be rejected, so candidates must carefully follow the payment steps on the SSB recruitment portal.

How to Apply for SSB Constable Tradesman & Driver Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates can apply online for SSB Constable Tradesman & Driver Recruitment 2026 within 30 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News by following the steps given below.

  • Visit the official SSB recruitment website and open the online application link for the Constable posts.

  • Submit the online application form on or before the last date.

IAF Agniveervayu Sports Intake 02/2026 – Eligibility Criteria

1. Age Limit

  • Date of Birth: Candidate must be born between 02 July 2005 and 02 January 2009 (both dates inclusive).
  • Upper Age on Enrolment: Maximum 21 years as on date of enrolment (for those clearing all stages).

2. Marital Status

  • Only unmarried male candidates are eligible.
  • Candidates must undertake not to marry during the four-year engagement period; marriage during engagement will lead to discharge.

3. Educational Qualification

Science Subjects (any one):

  • 10+2/Intermediate with Mathematics, Physics and English from recognised Board with minimum 50% aggregate and 50% in English, OR
  • 3 years Diploma in Engineering (Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics/Automobile/Computer Science/Instrumentation Technology/IT) with 50% aggregate and 50% in English in Diploma or in 10+2/Matric, OR
  • 2 years Vocational Course with non-vocational subjects Physics and Mathematics with 50% aggregate and 50% in English in Vocational or in 10+2/Matric.

Other than Science Subjects (any one):

  • 10+2/Intermediate in any stream with 50% aggregate and 50% in English, OR
  • 2 years Vocational Course with 50% aggregate and 50% in English in Vocational or in 10+2/Matric.

4. Sports Achievements

  • Represented India in Junior/Senior International competitions recognised by IOC/IOA in notified disciplines, OR
  • Minimum 5th place in Junior Nationals, Senior Nationals, All India Inter University, or Khelo India Nationals in listed sports, OR
  • Represented State/UT in National/All India Inter University/Khelo India in team events.

  • Minimum height 152 cm; chest 77 cm with minimum 5 cm expansion.

A total of 29 vacancies are notified - 25 posts on Regular Basis across streams such as Legal, Risk Management, Internal Audit, IS Audit, Administration, Human Resources, Company Secretariat, Vigilance, Lending Operations, Investment & Treasury, Information Technology, and Compliance; and 4 posts on Contract Basis for Corporate Strategy, Partnerships & Ecosystem Development and Investment & Treasury. NaBFID Officers (Senior Analyst) Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

The official NaBFID Senior Analyst Recruitment 2026 notifications have been released on 18 March 2026 on the Bank's official website. Two separate advertisements have been issued - Advertisement No. NaBFID/REC/SNA/2025-26/01 for Full Term (Regular Basis) and Advertisement No. NaBFID/REC/SNA/2025-26/02 for Fixed Term (On Contract) appointments. Candidates are advised to read the detailed advertisement carefully before applying.

  • Regular Basis Notification PDF: Download from nabfid.org/careers
  • Contract Basis Notification PDF: Download from nabfid.org/careers

NaBFID Senior Analyst Vacancy 2026 – Details

A total of 29 Senior Analyst vacancies are notified across Regular and Contract engagements. Category-wise breakup is as given below.

Regular Basis – 25 Vacancies

Activity Date

Last Date to Apply & Fee Payment 08 April 2026
Online Examination – Regular Basis (Tentative) May 2026

NaBFID Senior Analyst Eligibility Criteria 2026

Age Limit (as on 28.02.2026)

Minimum age: 21 years | Maximum age: 40 years. Candidates must have been born not earlier than 01.03.1986 and not later than 28.02.2005.

Category Age Relaxation (in years)
SC / ST 5 years
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years
PwBD – GEN / EWS 10 years
PwBD – OBC 13 years
PwBD – SC / ST 15 years
Ex-Servicemen 5 years

Educational Qualification & Experience

All qualifications must be regular full-time from a Government-recognised University/Institution and results must have been declared on or before 28.02.2026. A minimum of 4 years of post-qualification experience in the relevant function is mandatory for all positions.

Stream Educational Qualification Experience Required
Legal LLB from recognised university (Masters in Law desirable) 4 years; preferred in corporate/project finance law
Risk Management PG/MBA (Finance/Banking) / ICWA / CFA / CA (FRM desirable) 4 years in corporate credit appraisals / risk management
Internal Audit PG/MBA (Finance) / CA / ICWA (CIA / IIBF certification desirable) 4 years in Banking/FI Audit
IS Audit BE/B.Tech/MCA/M.Sc/MBA in CS/Cybersecurity/IT (CISA/CISSP desirable) 4 years in IS/IT Audit; RBI-regulated entity preferred
Administration PG in Commerce/Accounts 4 years in accounts dept. with vendor invoicing/GST exposure
Human Resources PG/MBA in HR/IR/Personnel Management 4 years in HR functions in financial/corporate sector
Company Secretariat Company Secretary (ICSI member) 4 years as CS in listed companies
Vigilance PG/MBA / CA / ICWA / CFA 4 years in financial sector; 2 years in Vigilance/Compliance
Lending Operations PG/MBA (Finance) / ICWA / CFA / CMA / CA 4 years; 2 years in corporate credit appraisals/operations
Investment & Treasury PG/MBA (Finance/Forex) / ICWA / CA / CFA (Treasury/Forex cert. desirable) 4 years; 2 years in treasury/investment/forex
IT – Business Analyst BE/B.Tech/MCA/M.Tech (CS/IT/AI) with PMP/BPM/Agile cert. or MBA with CS graduation 4 years in IT Project Management/Business Analyst in BFSI
IT – Cloud Infrastructure BE/B.Tech/MCA/M.Tech with AWS/Azure/GCP/Oracle cloud certification 4 years managing cloud infrastructure
Compliance MBA (Finance) / CA / ICWA / PG (Finance) 4 years; 2 years in Audit/Compliance in RBI-regulated entity
Corporate Strategy (Contract) CA / PG (Economics) / MBA (Finance/Strategy/Sustainability) 4 years in financial sector/consultancy; strategy experience preferred

NaBFID Senior Analyst Salary 2026

For Regular Basis positions, the annual fixed compensation for Senior Analyst grade is approximately ₹24.81 lakh. In addition, variable pay (performance bonus) of up to 20% on fixed compensation may be paid based on performance, as decided by the Bank from time to time. Compensation may be revised at suitable intervals as approved by the Board. Group Insurance (Medical, Accidental & Term Life) will be provided over and above the compensation.

For Contract Basis positions, remuneration will be offered based on qualification, experience, suitability, last drawn salary and market benchmark and shall not be a limiting factor for suitable candidates. The Fixed Term engagement will be for a minimum of 5 years, which may be renewed at NaBFID's discretion.

NaBFID Senior Analyst Selection Process 2026

The selection process differs for Regular and Contract basis appointments as follows.

Regular Basis: The selection process comprises an Online Examination followed by a Personal Interview. If fewer applications are received for any stream, the Bank may change the process to Shortlisting-cum-Interview. The online exam consists of 50 objective-type questions (Professional Knowledge) carrying 100 marks to be completed in 60 minutes. There is a negative marking of ¼ mark for each wrong answer. Minimum qualifying marks are 40% for UR/EWS and 35% for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates. Final selection is based on Online Exam (70% weightage) and Interview (30% weightage).

Contract Basis: The selection process is Shortlisting-cum-Interview. If a large number of applications are received, the Bank may conduct an Online Exam. A Psychometric Test and Group Discussion may also be conducted as additional assessment tools. Interviews will be held at Mumbai only.

NaBFID Senior Analyst Application Fee 2026

Category Application Fee
General / EWS / OBC ₹800 + applicable taxes
SC / ST / PwBD ₹100 + applicable taxes (Intimation charges only)

Fee is non-refundable. Payment can be made through Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Mobile Wallets, or UPI. Bank transaction charges and GST are to be borne by the candidate.

Important Instructions

  • The application process is complete only when the application fee is successfully deposited online on or before 08.04.2026.
  • All candidates must ensure they fulfil the eligibility criteria as on the cut-off date 28.02.2026 before applying.
  • Candidates must upload all required documents - Brief Resume, ID Proof, Age Proof, Educational Certificates, Experience Certificates, and Caste/EWS/PwBD Certificate (if applicable) - in PDF format, failing which the candidature will not be considered.
  • No candidate is permitted to apply for more than one position. If multiple applications are submitted, only the latest valid registration (higher registration number) will be retained and fees paid for other registrations will be forfeited.
  • Candidates are advised to regularly check https://nabfid.org/careers for updates. No separate intimation will be issued for any change or update - all corrigenda will be hosted only on the Bank's website.
  • Call letters for examination and interviews will be available only on the Bank's website. All communications will be sent by email only - no hard copy will be dispatched.
  • Interviews for both Regular and Contract positions will be held at Mumbai only.
  • Candidates called for Interview will be reimbursed actual travel expenses up to a maximum of IInd AC rail fare of mail express train, upon submission of to & fro tickets.
  • Selected candidates may be posted at Mumbai, New Delhi, or anywhere in India as per the Bank's discretion. Only candidates willing to serve anywhere in India should apply.
  • Candidates serving in Govt./Quasi-Govt./PSU/Nationalised Banks/Financial Institutions must submit a No Objection Certificate from their employer at the time of interview.
  • All educational qualifications must be regular full-time. MBA/PG Diploma must be 2-year full-time; MCA must be 3-year full-time (or 2-year full-time if admitted on or after 2020-21 as per UGC guidelines).
  • The offer to join NaBFID is subject to verification of original documents at any stage after qualifying the exam/shortlisting/interview/date of joining.
  • If a candidate is found ineligible at any stage - even after appointment - the candidature/services will be cancelled/terminated without notice.
  • Candidates must carry original photo identity proof (PAN Card/Passport/Driving License/Voter ID/Aadhar etc.) along with a photocopy at the time of examination/interview. Ration Card and Learner's Driving License are not valid identity proofs.
  • The handwritten declaration must be written in the candidate's own handwriting in English only on white paper with black ink; signatures in CAPITAL LETTERS will not be accepted.
  • Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification. No correspondence will be entertained by any ineligible or non-selected candidate.
  • Any legal proceedings arising out of this advertisement can be instituted only in Mumbai. Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Mumbai only shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • No change in category of any candidate is permitted after registration of online application.

How to Apply for NaBFID Senior Analyst Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates can apply online for NaBFID Senior Analyst Recruitment 2026 from 18.03.2026 to 08.04.2026 by following the steps below.

  1. Visit the official NaBFID website at https://nabfid.org/careers and click on the "APPLY ONLINE" link for the relevant advertisement (Regular or Contract).
  2. Click on "Click here for New Registration", enter your Name, Contact details and Email ID. A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated and sent to your registered email/mobile.
  3. Fill in all personal, educational and professional details in the online application form. Use "SAVE AND NEXT" to save your progress. No changes are permitted after clicking "COMPLETE REGISTRATION".
  4. Upload scanned copies of your Photograph (4.5cm×3.5cm, 20–50 KB), Signature (10–20 KB), Left Thumb Impression (20–50 KB), Handwritten Declaration (50–100 KB), and all required documents in PDF format (max 500 KB each).
  5. Also capture a live photograph using webcam or mobile QR scan as required by the application system.
  6. Proceed to the payment tab and pay the application fee online through the available digital payment methods.
  7. Submit the form and download the e-Receipt and a printout of the completed application for future reference.

SSB Paramedical Eligibility Criteria 2026

Eligibility criteria include age limit, educational qualification, professional qualification and experience. All conditions must be met by the closing date of receipt of applications.

Age Limit & Relaxation 2026

Category Age Relaxation beyond Upper Age Limit
Minimum Age (All Posts) 18 years

Children/Dependants of 1984 Riot Victims – UR 5 years

Children/Dependants of 1984 Riot Victims – SC/ST 10 years

Note: Age relaxation is NOT admissible to sons, daughters and dependants of ex-servicemen. The crucial date for determining age shall be the closing date of receipt of applications.

SSB Paramedical Educational & Professional Qualification 2026

Post-wise essential educational and professional qualifications are as follows:

Post Essential Educational & Professional Qualification
Head Constable (Laboratory Assistant) (i) 12th class pass with Biology as a subject from a recognized Board.
(ii) Certificate course of minimum one year in Laboratory Assistant Course from a recognized institution.
(iii) Working experience of minimum one year as Lab Assistant in a Laboratory Diagnostic Centre or hospital or institution lab recognized by Central/State Government.
Head Constable (Physiotherapy Assistant) (i) 12th class pass from a recognized Board.
(ii) Certificate course of minimum one year in Physiotherapy from a recognized institute.
(iii) Experience of minimum one year as Physiotherapy Assistant from a Physiotherapy Centre or minimum 100-bedded hospital or institute recognized by Central/State Government.
Constable (Nursing Assistant cum Medic) (i) 10th class pass from a recognized Board.
(ii) First Aid Certificate course from St. John's Ambulance Organization or Red Cross Society of India.
(iii) Experience of minimum one year as Nursing Assistant in a minimum 50-bedded Hospital or Institution recognized by Central/State Government.

SSB Paramedical Selection Process 2026

The SSB Paramedical Selection Process 2026 consists of the following stages:

  • Stage I – Physical Efficiency Test (PET):
    • HC (Lab Assistant) & HC (Physiotherapy Assistant): Male – 1.6 km in 6 min 30 sec; Female – 800 m in 4 min
    • Constable (Nursing Assistant cum Medic): Male – 4.8 km in 24 min; Female – 2.4 km in 18 min
    • Ex-Servicemen are exempted from PET
  • Stage I – Physical Standard Test (PST): Height and chest measurement as per category-wise norms (General/UR/OBC/EWS: Male 165 cm, Female 155 cm; chest for males 75–80 cm; relaxations for ST, NE States, Garhwali, Kumaoni, Dogra, Maratha, J&K/Ladakh candidates).
  • Stage II – Written Examination (Computer Based Test):
    • HC (Lab Assistant & Physiotherapy Assistant): 150 marks, 3 hours, 150 MCQs – Part I (50 marks): GK, Maths, Reasoning, General English/Hindi; Part II (100 marks): Technical Subject. Negative marking: 0.25 per wrong answer.
    • Constable (Nursing Assistant cum Medic): 100 marks, 2 hours, 100 MCQs – GK, Maths, Reasoning, General English/Hindi. Negative marking: 0.25 per wrong answer.
  • Stage III – Documentation & Detailed Medical Examination (DME) / Review Medical Examination (RME): Top 3 times the number of vacancies (category-wise) from written exam will be called. Final merit list drawn on written exam marks.

SSB Paramedical Application Fee 2026

Category Fee
UR, EWS, OBC ₹100/- (Non-Refundable)
SC, ST, Ex-Servicemen, Female Candidates Exempted (No Fee)

Payment mode: Net Banking / Credit Card / Debit Card / UPI.

How to Apply for SSB Paramedical Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official SSB Recruitment website https://recruitment.ssb.gov.in/ or https://ssb.gov.in/ and read all instructions carefully before filling the application.
  2. Fill Part-I of the online application: Post name, personal details (name as per matriculation certificate), father's/mother's name, date of birth, gender, nationality, religion, marital status, category.
  3. Fill Part-II: Upload passport-size coloured photograph (JPG, 4–12 KB, 100×120 pixels, white background, 75% face) and signature (JPG, 4–12 KB, 140×80 pixels, blue/black ink).
  4. After successful upload, a Registration Number will be generated – note it down or take a printout.
  5. Fill remaining details: Aadhaar number/photo ID, identification marks, mobile number (mandatory), email ID (mandatory), education qualification, postal/permanent address, criminal case declaration, and create a password.
  6. Proceed to Part-III: Pay examination fee (if applicable) through Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card/UPI.
  7. Take a printout of the submitted application form for future reference.
  8. Report to the recruitment venue on the date mentioned in the Admit Card with all original documents, certificates, Aadhaar Card, etc.

Important Instructions

  • A candidate can apply for only ONE post from the three posts mentioned.
  • Only online applications will be accepted; applications through any other mode will be rejected.
  • All educational/professional certificates must be possessed by the closing date of receipt of applications.
  • Date of Birth and name as recorded in Matriculation certificate are final; no subsequent change will be considered.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in recruitment tests; candidates must arrange their own stay for at least one week. Unemployed SC/ST candidates appearing in written test will be reimbursed fare as per rules.
  • Biometric attendance, digital photograph, signature and thumb impression will be taken at all stages.
  • Once category is registered, no change of category will be entertained.
  • SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates fulfilling UR eligibility criteria may apply against unreserved vacancies where no reserved vacancies exist.
  • EWS certificate must be valid for 2026–2027; OBC Non-Creamy Layer certificate should be within three years of the closing date.
  • Persons employed in Government/Semi-Government/PSUs must apply through proper channel and submit NOC at documentation stage.
  • Calculator, digital diary, mobile phone, pager, whitener, blade etc. are prohibited at the recruitment venue.
  • DG, SSB reserves the right to increase/decrease/cancel vacancies or postpone the recruitment without assigning any reason.
  • All updates and amendments will be available only on the SSB Recruitment website; candidates must visit regularly.

  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET): Only for Sub Inspector (Communication) – Male: 1.6 km in 6 min 30 sec; Female: 800 m in 4 min. Ex-Servicemen exempted.
  • Physical Standard Test (PST): Height & chest measurement as per category and region-wise standards.
  • Written Examination: Computer Based Test (CBT) of 150 marks (3 hours) – Part-I (General Knowledge, Maths, Reasoning, English/Hindi – 50 marks) & Part-II (Technical Subject – 100 marks).
  • Documentation & Detailed Medical Examination (DME): Verification of documents followed by medical examination as per SSB medical standards.
  • Review Medical Examination (RME): If required.

SSB Sub-Inspector Salary 2026

All SSB Sub-Inspector (Staff Nurse, Pioneer & Communication) posts are placed in Pay Level-6 (₹35,400–1,12,400) of the 7th Central Pay Commission.

In addition to basic pay, selected candidates are entitled to Dearness Allowance, Ration Money Allowance, House Rent Allowance and other admissible allowances, and will be covered under Defined Contributory Pension Scheme or Unified Pension Scheme as applicable.

How to Apply for SSB Sub-Inspector Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates can apply online for SSB Sub-Inspector Recruitment 2026 within 30 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News by following the steps given below.

  1. Visit the official SSB recruitment website https://recruitment.ssb.gov.in/
  2. Complete the registration using a valid email ID and mobile number, then log in and fill in personal, educational and other details in the SSB Sub-Inspector online application form.
  3. Select only one post (a candidate can apply for only one post) and upload scanned copies of photograph, signature and required documents in the prescribed format and size.
  4. Pay the application fee online (₹200 for UR/EWS/OBC; exempted for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen/Female) through netbanking/credit card/debit card/UPI and submit the form; take a printout of the final submitted application for future reference.

Important Instructions

  • Only eligible candidates may apply and minutely go through all the provisions & requirements in the notification to ensure that he/she is eligible for the post for which he/she is applying.
  • Candidates should bring all original documents i.e. matriculation, technical pass certificate alongwith self attested Photostat copies of the same at the time of documentation, failing which candidature of candidate will be rejected in the documentation stage of recruitment.
  • Name, Father’s Name & Date of Birth should be mentioned exactly as recorded in Matriculation certificate. Persons employed in Government/Semi-Government/Public Sector Undertakings should apply through proper channel. No objection certificate from their employer will be required to be submitted at the time of documentation.
  • Falsification/Forgery of documents to mislead the Recruitment Board or to gain access to examination would lead to legal/debar action against the candidate, besides cancellation of his/her candidature and debarring him/her for future examination. Admit cards/call letters to appear in recruitment process will be uploaded on SSB official website https://recruitment.ssb.gov.in/ & https://ssb.gov.in/.
  • The Government/SSB shall not be responsible for damage/injury/death/loss to the individual, if any, sustained during the entire recruitment process/journey. The DG, SSB has full right to make changes/cancel/postpone the recruitment without assigning any reason.
  • Candidates canvassing in any form/bringing outside influence/pressure/offering illegal gratification/blackmailing/threatening to blackmail any person connected with recruitment will be disqualified. It should, however be clearly understood that the Recruitment Board reserves absolute discretion to reject or accept any candidate at any stage.
  • Mere qualifying all the prescribed tests in SSB recruitment does not confer the right to any candidate for final selection. Change in category will NOT be entertained once registered and the candidature of such candidate shall be cancelled. Candidates who are not in possession of certificate of minimum education qualification by closing date of receipt of applications i.e. 30 (thirty) days from the date of publication of this advertisement in the Employment News need not to apply. Calculator, Digital Diary, Cellular Phone, pager, Whiteners, blade etc. are prohibited in the recruitment venue.
  • The candidates will not be considered for recruitment if involved/convicted/arrested in any criminal case under IPC or any other Act of the Central Government or State Government. The selection committee will not enter into any correspondence with the candidate except in the case of change of address sought by a candidate.
  • Any amendment in the schedule/condition/process of recruitment will be available on SSB official website https://recruitment.ssb.gov.in/ & https://ssb.gov.in/ only. Candidates are advised to login to this site regularly. The advertisement is also available on SSB official website https://recruitment.ssb.gov.in/ & https://ssb.gov.in/.
