Eligibility Criteria

  • Nationality: Candidate must be a Citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal, or a subject of Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1st January 1962 with intent to permanently settle, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from specified countries. Candidates under categories (b) to (e) require an eligibility certificate from Government of India.
  • Qualification: Candidate must have passed the written and practical parts of the final MBBS Examination from a recognized university.
  • Provisional Admission: A candidate who has appeared or is yet to appear in the final MBBS Examination may also apply. Such admission will be provisional and subject to cancellation if proof of passing is not produced within the stipulated time period after result declaration of the written examination (within 15 days window provided by the Commission).
  • Internship: A candidate who has yet to complete the compulsory rotating internship is educationally eligible to appear in the examination, but will be appointed only after completion of the compulsory rotating internship.
  • Physical & Medical Standards: Candidates must be physically and medically fit according to the physical/medical standards for CMS Examination 2026 as per regulations contained in Appendix III to the Rules of the Examination.
  • Marital Status: No person who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a living spouse, or having a living spouse has entered into a marriage with any other person, shall be eligible, unless exempted under personal law applicable and with Central Government approval.

Salary / Stipend

  • Assistant Divisional Medical Officer (Railways): Pay Matrix Level-10 (Rs. 56,100 – 1,77,500) + Non-Practising Allowance (NPA) as per rules. Private practice is prohibited.
  • Medical Officers Grade – Central Health Service (CHS): Pay Matrix Level-10 (Rs. 56,100 – 1,77,500) + NPA as per orders issued by Government from time to time. Private practice of any kind, including Lab and consultant practice, is prohibited.
  • General Duty Medical Officer – NDMC: Pay Matrix Level-10 (Rs. 56,100 – 1,77,500) + Restricted NPA. Promotion to Senior Medical Officer (Level-11: Rs. 67,700 – 2,08,700), Chief Medical Officer (Level-12: Rs. 78,800 – 2,09,200), Chief Medical Officer (NFSG) (Level-13: Rs. 1,18,500 – 2,14,100), and Senior Administrative Grade (Level-14: Rs. 1,44,200 – 2,18,200).
  • General Duty Medical Officer Grade-II – MCD: Minimum of first cell Rs. 56,100 in Level-10 of Pay Matrix under 7th CPC + NPA and other admissible allowances. Private practice of any kind is prohibited.
  • All appointed candidates will be governed by the Contributory Pension System (NPS) effective from 01.01.2004 (for Railways) as per Government orders.

Age Limit (as on 01-08-2026)

  • Maximum Age (General): 32 Years (candidate must have been born not earlier than 2nd August 1994)
  • For Medical Officers Grade – General Duty (CHS): Maximum 35 Years as on 01.08.2026
  • SC / ST candidates: Upper age relaxable by maximum 5 years
  • OBC candidates: Upper age relaxable by maximum 3 years
  • Defence Services personnel disabled in operations: Maximum 3 years relaxation
  • Ex-Servicemen (with at least 5 years Military Service as on 01.08.2026): Maximum 5 years relaxation
  • ECOs/SSCOs (with initial assignment of 5 years Military Service extended beyond 5 years): Maximum 5 years relaxation (with Ministry of Defence certificate)
  • Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD): Maximum 10 years relaxation
  • Candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC who also fall under Ex-Servicemen or PwBD categories are eligible for cumulative age relaxation under both categories.
  • Date of Birth accepted: as entered in the Matriculation / Secondary School Leaving Certificate or equivalent recognized certificate only. No other document for age proof will be accepted.

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS Candidates: Rs. 200/- (Rupees Two Hundred only)
  • Exempted from Fee: All Female candidates, SC candidates, ST candidates, and Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) candidates
  • Note: OBC and EWS candidates are NOT exempted and must pay the full fee of Rs. 200/-.
  • Mode of Payment: Net Banking of any Bank, or Visa/Master/RuPay/Credit/Debit Card/UPI Payment only.
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances nor can the fee be held in reserve for any other examination.
  • Applications submitted without the prescribed fee (unless fee remission is claimed) shall be summarily rejected.

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Date of Notification of Examination 11/03/2026
Opening of Online Application 11/03/2026
Last Date for Filling Up of Online Application 31/03/2026 (up to 06:00 PM)
Date of Written Examination 02/08/2026
Helpline Operational Period 11.03.2026 to 31.03.2026 (10:00 AM to 5:30 PM on working days)
Issuance of e-Admit Card Last working day of the preceding week of the date of examination
Representation Window on Question Paper / Provisional Answer Keys 3rd day to 7th day (06:00 PM) after the Examination date

Selection Process

  • Selection is based on two stages: Written Examination (500 Marks) + Personality Test/Interview (100 Marks) = Total 600 Marks.
  • Written Examination (Part-I) – 500 Marks:
    • Paper-I (Code No. 1): General Medicine and Paediatrics – 250 Marks | 120 Questions (96 from General Medicine + 24 from Paediatrics) | Duration: 2 hours
    • Paper-II (Code No. 2): Surgery, Gynaecology & Obstetrics, Preventive & Social Medicine – 250 Marks | 120 Questions (40 from each part) | Duration: 2 hours
    • Both papers are completely Objective Type (Multiple Choice Answers). Question papers are in English only.
    • Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) of marks assigned to that question will be deducted for each wrong answer. No penalty for unanswered questions.
  • Personality Test/Interview (Part-II) – 100 Marks: Candidates qualifying the written examination will be called for Interview/Personality Test conducted by the Commission to assess General Knowledge, academic ability, intellectual curiosity, balance of judgment, integrity of character, initiative and leadership.
  • Tie-Breaking Principle:
    • If Final Marks are equal: candidate securing more marks in Written Total ranked higher.
    • If still equal: senior in age ranked higher.
    • If Date of Birth also same: candidate whose date of completion of Internship is earlier ranked higher.
    • If tie persists: resolved at the discretion of the Commission.
  • The Commission has discretion to fix qualifying marks in any or both papers of the examination.
  • Successful candidates will be considered for appointment on the basis of order of merit and preferences expressed for various posts.
  • Exam Centres: 48 centres across India including Agartala, Ahmedabad, Aizawl, Bareilly, Bengaluru, Bhopal, Bhubaneswar, Chandigarh, Chennai, Cuttack, Dehradun, Delhi, Dharwad, Dispur, Faridabad, Gangtok, Gautam Buddha Nagar (Noida), Ghaziabad, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Imphal, Itanagar, Jaipur, Jammu, Jorhat, Kanpur, Kochi, Kohima, Kolkata, Lucknow, Madurai, Meerut, Mumbai, Nagpur, Panaji (Goa), Patna, Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair), Prayagraj (Allahabad), Raipur, Ranchi, Sambalpur, Shillong, Shimla, Srinagar, Thiruvananthapuram, Tirupati, Udaipur, Visakhapatnam.
  • Allotment of Centres is on "first-apply-first-allot" basis. PwBD candidates can opt for their desired centre regardless of ceiling.
  • Face authentication is mandatory for all candidates at the examination venue.
  • Candidates must reach the examination venue at least 30 minutes prior to commencement of each session. No late entry will be allowed.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must apply online only at: https://upsconline.nic.in
  • Complete the following four modules on the portal:
    • Account Creation
    • Universal Registration (URN Profile) – register once in lifetime
    • Common Application Form (CAF)
    • Examination Specific Module (including fee payment and centre selection)
  • Upload: scanned photograph (.jpg, 20 KB to 200 KB), scanned signature (.jpg, 20 KB to 100 KB), and a live photograph during CAF filling.
  • Signature must be signed three times (one below the other) on plain white paper in black ink.
  • Keep one Photo ID (Aadhaar Card / Voter Card / PAN Card / Passport / Driving Licence / Any other State/Central Govt. issued Photo ID) for all future references.
  • Pay the prescribed fee of Rs. 200/- online through Net Banking / Visa / Master / RuPay / Credit / Debit Card / UPI (not applicable for exempted candidates).
  • Application window: 11.03.2026 to 31.03.2026 (06:00 PM).
  • Candidates are strongly advised to apply well in advance to secure their preferred examination centre (first-apply-first-allot basis).
  • Candidates in Government service must submit an undertaking to their Head of Office/Department and mention it in the application.
  • Do not submit multiple applications. Multiple applications by the same candidate will be rejected.
  • Hard copy of the application form is NOT required to be submitted to the Commission.
  • Candidates qualified for Personality Test must mandatorily login to the portal within 15 days of result declaration of written examination to update details and upload proof of passing the qualifying examination.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Online applications are invited from unmarried male candidates for enrolment as sailors in Medical Branch for SSR (Med) in 02/2027 batch.
  • Candidates must satisfy eligibility conditions as laid down by the Government of India for enrolment as sailors in the Indian Navy.
  • Candidates must have qualified in 10+2 examination with Physics, Chemistry, Biology (PCB) from Boards of School Education recognised by Ministry of Education, Government of India.
  • Passed Matriculation from any recognised board
  • Candidates must have scored at least 50% marks in aggregate and a minimum of 40% in each subject (Physics, Chemistry and Biology) in the 10+2 examination.
  • Candidates who are appearing in class 12th Board Exam of academic year 2025-26 are also eligible to apply, provided they fulfil all other eligibility criteria.
  • Such appearing candidates will be selected only when they produce the original marksheet during subsequent stages of recruitment and secure the minimum prescribed marks in aggregate as well as in individual subjects.
  • Candidates must be born between 01 May 2005 and 31 October 2009 (both dates inclusive) to be eligible for SSR (MED) 02/2027 batch.
  • Candidates born between 01 May 2005 and 31 October 2009 are also eligible to apply for INET 2026 and will be considered for Stage II recruitment of the respective batch as per age criteria.
  • Candidates must be in good physical and mental health, free from any disease or disability likely to interfere with efficient performance of duties at sea and ashore in peace as well as war conditions.
  • Minimum height standard for male candidates is 157 cm, with height relaxations regulated as per Government orders; detailed regulations are available on the official website.
  • Visual standards required are uncorrected vision 6/12, 6/12 and corrected vision 6/6, 6/6 with colour perception CP Pass.
  • Permanent body tattoos are only permitted on inner face of forearms (from inside of elbow to the wrist) and on the reverse side of palm/back (dorsal) side of hand; permanent tattoos on any other part of the body are not acceptable and will lead to bar from recruitment.
  • Insurance cover (on contribution) of Rs. 75 lakhs is applicable for sailors.
  • Candidates must meet medical standards as assessed by authorised military doctors during Recruitment Medical Examination and Pre-Enrolment Medicals at INS Chilka.

Salary/Stipend

  • During the initial training period, a stipend of Rs. 14,600/- per month will be admissible to candidates.
  • On successful completion of initial training, candidates will be placed in Level 3 of the Defence Pay Matrix (Rs. 21,700 – Rs. 69,100) with Military Service Pay (MSP) of Rs. 5,200/- per month plus Dearness Allowance as applicable.

Selection Process

  • The selection process consists of Stage I – INET (Indian Navy Entrance Test) followed by Stage II (Physical Fitness Test, Written Examination and Recruitment Medical) and Pre-Enrolment Medicals.
  • Stage I – INET is a computer-based examination with 100 objective-type (multiple-choice) questions, each carrying 1 mark.
  • The Stage I question paper is bilingual (Hindi & English) and comprises four sections: English, Science, Biology and General Awareness.
  • The standard of Stage I question paper is that of 10+2, and syllabus and sample papers are available on the official website.
  • The duration of Stage I examination is one hour, and candidates are required to pass in all sections as well as in aggregate; pass marks in each section and aggregate are determined by the Indian Navy.
  • Negative marking is applicable in Stage I – one fourth (0.25) marks will be deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Centre allocation for INET (online examination) is at the discretion of the Indian Navy.
  • In case of extraneous circumstances causing non-conduct of INET or as per service requirement, Indian Navy reserves the right to shortlist candidates based on marks obtained in qualifying examinations (10th/12th board exams).
  • Results of Stage I – INET (Pass/Fail) along with marks scored will be uploaded on the candidate’s online dashboard.
  • Candidates eligible for Stage II as per age criteria will be shortlisted for SSR (Medical) 02/2027 batch based on marks obtained in Stage I – INET 2026.
  • Shortlisting for Stage II will be carried out state wise, and cut-off marks for next stage will vary from state to state as vacancies are allotted state-wise.
  • If candidates with the same percentage exceed required numbers, shortlisting will be done based on Date of Birth, with earlier DOB (fewer chances) given priority.
  • Sponsor candidates and NCC ‘C’ certificate holders who upload original sponsor and NCC certificates during Stage I application and whose certificates are verified will be exempted from Stage I – INET and will be directly issued call-up for Stage II based on eligibility.
  • Stage II begins with Physical Fitness Test (PFT), which is mandatory; candidates undergoing PFT do so at their own risk.
  • PFT standards for male candidates are: 1.6 km run in 6 min 30 sec, 20 Squats (Uthak Baithak), 15 Push-ups and 15 Bent Knee Sit-ups.
  • The Stage II written exam is conducted only for candidates who qualify the PFT and consists of 100 objective-type questions of 1 mark each.
  • The Stage II written exam question paper is bilingual (Hindi & English) and comprises four sections: English, Science, Biology and General Awareness, with 10+2 level standard and one-hour duration.
  • Candidates must pass in all sections and in aggregate in the Stage II written exam; pass marks are set by the Indian Navy.
  • Recruitment Medical Examination is carried out for candidates who qualify PFT; candidates who qualify Recruitment Medical are considered for the merit list.
  • Candidates found medically unfit in Recruitment Medical may appeal for review at a designated military hospital within 5 days; medical certificates from other hospitals are not accepted and no further review/appeal is permissible.
  • Provisional Select List is prepared based on performance in Stage II written exam, subject to qualification in PFT and Recruitment Medical; merit list for SSR (Medical) is state-wise and cut-off for call-up to INS Chilka varies by state.
  • Pre-Enrolment Medical formalities are conducted at INS Chilka and induction is subject to qualifying these formalities; candidates not qualifying pre-enrolment medicals will be rejected.

  • All required original documents (certificates, mark sheets, domicile certificate, NCC certificate if held) must be scanned and uploaded as per the specifications given in the online application.
  • Candidates must upload the prescribed photograph as specified, and also capture a good quality live photograph through webcam during application.
  • Examination fee payment of Rs. 550/- plus 18% GST must be made online using net banking, credit/debit card or UPI during application; admit card will be generated only after successful fee payment.
  • Candidates may optionally use Common Service Centres (CSC) for uploading application for a service fee of Rs. 60 + GST.
  • After submission, candidates should regularly check their online dashboard on the recruitment website for updates, admit card download, results and call-up letters.
  • Candidates must download call-up letters cum admit cards for Stage I – INET and later stages from the website; no call-up letters will be sent by post.
  • Candidates must report to the examination centre as per reporting time mentioned in call-up letter; late reporting (30 minutes after reporting time) will not be permitted.
  • Selected candidates must carry all original documents and self-attested copies to recruitment stages including INS Chilka for verification; any discrepancy with online details will result in cancellation of candidature.

    • Ex-Servicemen are exempted from PET but must appear in PST, Written Examination, Skill Test (as applicable), Documentation and Medical Examination.
    • PST – Candidates must meet prescribed height and chest standards (post-wise and category-wise as per notification).
    • General (UR/EWS/OBC): Male – 165 cm height, 75–80 cm chest; Female – 155 cm height (Head Constable Steward). Different standards apply for SC/ST, NE States, J&K and other specified categories.
  • Stage II – Written Examination (Computer Based Test – CBT):
    • Paper-I Common Entrance Test: 3 hours duration, 150 marks, 150 multiple-choice objective type questions.
    • Part-I (50 Marks): General Knowledge, Mathematics, Reasoning, General English/General Hindi.
    • Part-II (100 Marks): Technical Subject.
    • Minimum qualifying marks: 50% for Gen/EWS/OBC/Ex-SM; 45% for SC/ST.
    • Final Merit will be prepared on the basis of marks obtained by candidates in the written examination.
  • Stage III – Skill Test (Only for Head Constable Electrician):
    • Skill test will be conducted for up to 20 times the vacancies (category-wise) for the post of Head Constable (Electrician).
    • Skill test carries 50 marks; minimum qualifying marks for all categories including SC/ST/OBC/EWS/Ex-Servicemen: 60%.
    • Skill test is qualifying in nature. Marks of skill test will not be included in the final merit list.
  • Stage IV – Document Verification (DV) and Detailed Medical Examination (DME) / Review Medical Examination (RME):
    • Candidates shortlisted up to 3 times the vacancies (category-wise) will be called for Documentation and DME/RME.
    • All original documents will be verified by detailed BOOs of SSB.
    • Candidates declared unfit in DME may prefer an appeal for Review Medical Examination (RME). The decision of RME Board will be final and no 2nd appeal will be entertained.
  • Final Selection: Final selection list will be prepared in order of merit, category-wise, after completion of Review Medical Examination. Where equal marks are obtained: candidate with more marks in Part-II (Technical Subject) will rank higher; if still equal, senior in age will rank higher; if date of birth is also same, priority based on alphabetical order of names in English.

AAI RCDU Apprentice Vacancy 2026 Details

A total of 10 Apprentice vacancies (05 Graduate Apprentices + 05 Diploma Apprentices) will be filled under the AAI RCDU Apprentice Recruitment 2026 for a one-year apprenticeship training program at RCDU/FIU/CRSD & E&M Workshop and related units at Safdarjung Airport, New Delhi. Check AAI RCDU Apprentice post-wise vacancy and stipend details in the table below.

Post Name AAI RCDU Apprentice Vacancy 2026 Training Duration Monthly Stipend
Graduate Apprentice 05 1 year ₹15,000 (AAI share ₹10,500 + Govt share ₹4,500 through DBT)
Diploma Apprentice 05 1 year ₹12,000 (AAI share ₹8,000 + Govt share ₹4,000 through DBT)
Total AAI RCDU Apprentice Posts 10  

Note: The above AAI RCDU Apprentice vacancy 2026 is tentative and can be reduced, increased or interchanged within the sanctioned strength as per AAI's requirement. Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS is applicable; unfilled reserved category seats may be filled from other reserved or general categories.

AAI RCDU Apprentice Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates who wish to apply for AAI RCDU Graduate & Diploma Apprentice Recruitment 2026 must ensure that they fulfil the eligibility criteria regarding nationality, year of passing, age limit and educational qualification as specified in the official notification.

AAI RCDU Apprentice Age Limit 2026

  • Maximum Age: 27 years as on 24 November 2025.
  • Age relaxation as per Government of India rules for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD and other reserved categories will be applicable.

AAI RCDU Apprentice Educational Qualification 2026

  • For Graduate Apprentice (Technical): Candidates should possess a full-time regular four-year Degree in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) in Electronic & Communication/Electronic & Instrumentation/Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE) or related streams recognized by AICTE, Government of India.
  • For Graduate Apprentice (General Stream): Candidates should possess a regular/correspondence/distance three-year degree in B.Com/BA/B.Sc/BBA/BCA from a recognized university.
  • For Diploma Apprentice (Technical): Candidates should possess a full-time regular three-year Diploma in Engineering in Electronic & Communication/Electronic & Instrumentation/Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE)/Material Management or related streams recognized by AICTE, Government of India.
  • Year of Passing: Only those candidates who have passed their degree or diploma in the year 2021 or after 2021 are eligible to apply for AAI RCDU Apprentice Recruitment 2026.
  • Nationality & Domicile: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. Preference will be given to candidates with domicile of Delhi or NCR area.
  • Candidates who have already completed their apprenticeship or terminated it midway or are currently pursuing apprenticeship in other organizations or in AAI with the same qualification level are not eligible.
  • Candidates who have job experience or training for a period of 1 year or more after obtaining their educational qualification are not eligible as per the Apprentices Act, 1961.

AAI RCDU Apprentice Selection Process 2026

The AAI RCDU Graduate & Diploma Apprentice Recruitment 2026 selection process will be based on a walk-in interview-cum-document verification on 27 March 2026 followed by medical fitness certification at the time of joining.

Stage 1 – Walk-in Interview-cum-Document Verification

  • All candidates who have registered on the NATS portal (NATS Portal ID: NDLNDC000087) for the AAI RCDU Apprentice Recruitment 2026 must attend the walk-in interview-cum-document verification on 27 March 2026 from 1000 hrs to 1800 hrs at the AAI RCDU Training Centre, Safdarjung Airport, New Delhi.
  • Candidates must bring the following original documents along with one photocopy set: University Registration No./Roll No./Enrollment No., Final Degree/Diploma Certificate/Consolidated Marksheet, Name of College/University, Percentage of marks or CGPA (and its equivalent formula), Branch of study, Month and year of passing, Aadhaar Card copy, Bank details, Valid personal Email ID & Mobile No., Passport size photograph, and PAN Card copy.
  • Provisional selection of candidates will be merit-based and the decision of AAI will be final and binding.

Stage 2 – Medical Fitness Certificate

  • The final selection will be based on successful interaction, verification of original certificates and testimonials, and submission of a Medical Fitness Certificate (to be obtained only from a Government Medical Officer or Medical Officer of a Government Undertaking) at the time of joining.
  • The candidature of applicants is purely provisional and subject to verification of all certificates and documents.

AAI has no obligation to provide regular or contractual employment to apprentices upon completion of the training program. This apprenticeship does not create any liability on AAI for employment or placement.

AAI RCDU Apprentice Application Fee 2026

There is no application fee required for AAI RCDU Apprentice Recruitment 2026 for any category of candidates (General/OBC/EWS/SC/ST/PwBD). AAI does not collect any application fee or any other type of fees for this apprenticeship engagement.

How to Apply for AAI RCDU Apprentice Recruitment 2026

The application process for AAI RCDU Graduate & Diploma Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is online through the NATS (National Apprenticeship Training Scheme) portal. Candidates must register on the NATS portal and then attend the walk-in interview-cum-document verification on 27 March 2026.

  • Step 1: Visit the official NATS portal at https://www.nats.education.gov.in and click on the student registration link or use the direct student registration URL: https://moenats.aicte-india.org/student_register.php.
  • Step 2: Complete your enrollment on the NATS portal by entering basic details (Name, Father/Mother's name, Aadhaar number), educational details (Course/Institute details, University Reg. No./Roll No., final degree/diploma certificate, percentage of marks or CGPA, branch of study, month and year of passing), communication information (Address, Mobile No., valid personal Email ID), training preference (Preferred field/location for apprenticeship), and bank details.
  • Step 3: Upload scanned copies of your Final Degree/Diploma Certificate/Consolidated Marksheet (PDF format, size less than 1 MB) and Passport size photograph (JPEG format, size less than 1 MB).

The FSSAI Internship 2026 selection process is merit-based and carried out through online scrutiny of applications by the concerned Nodal Officers at FSSAI (HQ), Regional Offices and National Food Laboratories.

Eligibility criteria - IIT Delhi Non Academic Recruitment 2026

1) Nationality & general eligibility

  • Applicants must be Indian Nationals and meet all conditions specified in Advt. No. E‑II/01/2026(DR) and E‑II/02/2026(DR) for IIT Delhi Non Academic posts.

2) Educational qualification & experience (brief)

  • Superintending Engineer: Master’s/Bachelor’s in relevant Engineering with long Group‑A experience as Executive Engineer in specified pay levels.​

  • Chief Security Officer: Commissioned Officer/Police officer with Bachelor’s/Master’s degree and 15–20 years relevant experience as per clauses.​

  • Administrative Assistant, Accounts & Audit Assistant: 30 years.​

Selection Process

  • The selection shall be made through examination schemes as specified below:
    • One Tier (General) – Post Code 17/26: One Tier exam (I-T-G) of 2 hours duration. Total 200 MCQ questions of 200 marks. Syllabus: General Awareness, General Intelligence & Reasoning Ability, Arithmetical & Numerical Ability, Test of Hindi Language & Comprehension, Test of English Language & Comprehension (40 marks each). Final merit will be prepared on the basis of marks secured in the written examination.
    • One Tier (Technical) – Post Codes 07/26, 08/26, 09/26, 10/26, 11/26, 13/26, 14/26, 16/26, 18/26, 19/26, 20/26: One Tier exam (I-T-T) of 2 hours duration. Total 200 MCQ questions of 200 marks. Section-A: General Awareness, General Intelligence & Reasoning Ability, Arithmetical & Numerical Ability, Test of Hindi Language & Comprehension, Test of English Language & Comprehension (20 marks each; 100 questions: 100 marks). Section-B: Objective type MCQs on the subject concerned as per the qualification prescribed for the post (100 questions: 100 marks). Mandatory minimum qualifying marks applicable only in domain subject specific Section-B, not in Section-A. Combined marks of both sections reckoned for final merit list.
    • Two Tier (General) – Post Code 12/26: Two-tier exam (II-T-G). Tier-I (2 hours): 200 MCQ questions of 200 marks (qualifying in nature). Tier-II (3 hours, one session): Part-I MCQ (200 questions: 200 marks) + Part-II Descriptive (75 marks) = Grand Total 275. Part-II: Essay in English (50 marks) + Letter writing/Expansion of ideas in English (25 marks). Selection based on cumulative marks obtained in Part-I & Part-II of Tier-II.
    • Two Tier (Technical-2) – Post Codes 01/26, 02/26, 03/26, 04/26, 05/26, 06/26, 15/26: Two-tier exam (II-T-T2). Tier-I (2 hours): Section-A (100 questions: 100 marks, general) + Section-B (100 questions: 100 marks, subject-related) = 200 marks (qualifying in nature). Tier-II (3 hours, one session): Part-I MCQ (200 questions: 200 marks, subject-related) + Part-II Descriptive (50 marks) = Grand Total 250. Part-II: Essay in English (30 marks) + Letter writing/Expansion of ideas in English (20 marks). In Tier-II, mandatory minimum qualifying marks applicable in domain subject specific Part-I; combined marks of both parts reckoned for final merit list.
  • Marks scored by candidates in the Computer Based Test/Exam will be normalized (if required) using the formula published by DSSSB vide Notice No. 10(271)/Sec.Cell/DSSSB/18/989 dated 11.07.2018.
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: General/EWS: 40%; OBC (Delhi): 35%; SC/ST/PH (PwBD): 30%. Ex-Servicemen will be given 5% relaxation in their respective categories, subject to a minimum of 30%.
  • Negative Marking: Deduction of 0.25 marks for each wrong MCQ answer of 01 mark.
  • Skill Test / Physical Endurance Test / Driving Test / Trade Test etc. will be taken as per requirement of the job.
  • Draft answer keys of the Computer Based Examination will be displayed on the DSSSB website after the examination. Candidates may submit online objections within the stipulated time limit.

How to Apply

  • Before submitting online applications, the candidate must ensure that he/she is registered on DSSSB's portal i.e. https://dsssbonline.nic.in. Registration with DSSSB is a one-time exercise.
  • Eligible candidates may apply online through the website https://dsssbonline.nic.in from 27th February 2026 (12.00 Noon) up to 28th March 2026 (till 11:59 PM), thereafter the link will be disabled.
  • Candidates must go through the instructions carefully while filling up the online application form for the post concerned.
  • Candidates must submit their application through Online Mode only. No other mode of application shall be accepted. Applications received through any other mode i.e. by post / by hand / by mail etc. will not be accepted.
  • Pay the application fee of ₹100/- through SBI e-Pay only. No other mode of payment shall be accepted.
  • Before submission of the online application, candidates must check and ensure that they have filled correct details. Once the online application form is submitted, no request for change/correction/modification (including change of category) shall be entertained.
  • Candidates are advised to submit the online application much before the closing date and not to wait till the last date.
  • If an applicant submits multiple registrations and appears in the examination more than once, his/her candidature will be cancelled and he/she will be debarred from the examinations of the Board.
  • Candidates are advised to upload a recent and clear colour photograph. The background should be plain white or off-white, with full face, front view, eyes open.
  • Candidates must fill their correct and active e-mail addresses and mobile numbers in the online application form.
  • After successful submission, candidates should take a printout of the online application form for their own records.

Special Physical Standards

Candidates belonging to following regions will be given 4 cms height relaxation:

  • North East Region: Sikkim, Nagaland, Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Tripura, Mizoram, Meghalaya and Assam.
  • Gorkhas.
  • Garhwalis.
  • Ladakher.
  • Tribals of recognized tribal areas.

Note: Domicile and Caste certificate will be considered to determine applicability of height relaxation.

Application Fee

  • Examination Fee: Rs 250/- per application for all categories.
  • Payment Mode: Online (through the website during application).

Important Dates

  • Starting Date for Apply Online: 13-02-2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 01-04-2026
  • Online Exam Dates: 01/06/2026 to 15/06/2026 (Tentative)
  • Firm dates for online exam will be announced later on the website.

Selection Process

  • Phase I - Online Common Entrance Exam (CEE): Conducted at Computer based test centres. This will be conducted for provisionally shortlisted candidates. Admission to the examination will be purely on the basis of Admit Card. The CEE will be conducted at designated centres tentatively between 01 Jun 2026 to 15 Jun 2026.
  • Phase II - Recruitment Rally: Proportionate to the vacancies available candidates would be shortlisted based on the aggregate marks scored in the CEE. Shortlisted candidates will attend the Recruitment Rally at designated venue where the Physical Fitness Test, Physical Measurement Test, Medical Test and Document Verification will be conducted.

Physical Fitness Test (PFT) (At Rally Site)

  • 1.6 Km Run
    • Group I: Upto 7 Min 45 Secs - Excellent
    • Group II: 7 Min 46 Sec to 8 Min 30 Sec - Good
  • Long Jump: 10 Feet (Need to qualify)
  • High Jump: 3 Feet (Need to qualify)

Note: Provisions for extra time for 1.6 Km run in hilly terrain and lower timing for Long Jump and High Jump in such cases.

Medical Standards

  • Candidates must be in good physical and mental health, free from any disability likely to interfere with efficient performance of duties.
  • Detailed medical examination as per Army standards.

Final Merit List

  • Final merit list will be based on aggregate of marks scored in CEE and performance in PFT (if applicable).
  • Recruitment is purely based on merit depending on available vacancies.

Note: Selection in the Indian Army is 'Fair & Transparent' and on merit only. At no stage any bribe is to be paid to anyone for selection or recruitment in the Indian Army. Candidates should not fall prey to unscrupulous persons posing as recruiting agents.

How to Apply

  1. Visit the official website: www.joinindianarmy.nic.in.
  2. If new user, complete the registration process by providing basic details and creating a login ID.
  3. Login using the credentials and fill the online application form carefully.
  4. Upload required documents, photographs, and signatures as per specifications.
  5. Pay the examination fee of Rs 250/- online.
  6. Submit the application and take a printout for future reference.

Note: Applications invited from domiciles of all districts of Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, UT of Chandigarh & Delhi. Any change in policy or details published in notification will be intimated on registered email/mobile number and with a ticker on the www.joinindianarmy.nic.in web portal.

Documents Required

Candidates must carry the following documents in original along with self-attested photocopies at the rally site (Phase II):

  • Admit Card.
  • 20 copies of passport size photographs.
  • Education Certificates (Marksheets, Degree, etc.).
  • Domicile Certificate.
  • Caste Certificate (if applicable for relaxation).
  • Religion Certificate (if required).
  • School Character Certificate.
  • Character Certificate from Village Sarpanch/Municipal Corporation.
  • Unmarried Certificate.
  • NCC Certificate (if applicable).
  • Sports Certificate (if applicable).
  • Affidavit on Rs 10 stamp paper as per format.
  • Single Bank A/C, PAN Card & AADHAR Card.
  • Police Verification Form.
  • Certificate from serving personnel for wards of serving soldiers (if applicable).
  • Any other relevant documents as specified in the notification.

Salary Structure

Agniveers will be paid a customized package with fixed yearly increment. In addition, Risk and Hardship, Ration, Dress and Travel allowances as applicable.

Eligibility Criteria for HPRCA Various Posts 2026

1. Age Limit

The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 45 years for all advertised posts, except for Post Code 26013 (Audiometric Technician – Job Trainee) and Post Code 26011 (Speech Therapist – Job Trainee) where the age limit is 18–38 years. Age is reckoned as on 01.01.2026. Upper age relaxation of 5 years is applicable for SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates domiciled in Himachal Pradesh and for HP Government employees and Ex-servicemen of HP.

2. Educational Qualification (Post-wise)

Post Name (Code) Essential Qualification
Panchayat Secretary (26005) Bachelor's Degree from a recognised Institution approved by HP Government/University/Board. Minimum typing speed of 30 wpm in English or 25 wpm in Hindi on computer. Knowledge of word processing as prescribed by the recruiting authority.
Medical Social Worker (26006) Post Graduate Degree in Social Science or Sociology from a University recognised by the Central or HP Government.

Candidates who wish to apply for Tumakuru Pourakarmika Recruitment 2026 must carefully check the eligibility criteria regarding nationality, age limit, service conditions and language before submitting the application form at the respective Urban Local Body (ULB) offices.

Nationality: The applicant must be an Indian citizen to be eligible for Tumakuru Pourakarmika Recruitment 2026 in Tumakuru City Corporation, Tiptur City Municipal Council and Sira City Municipal Council.

Age Limit: As per the public notification, candidates must have completed a minimum age of 18 years and should not have crossed a maximum age of 50 years as on the date of publication of the Tumakuru Pourakarmika notification. The date of birth recorded in Aadhaar card, voter ID, ESI/PF records or other accepted documents will be considered for verifying age.

Experience as Pourakarmika / Sanitation Worker: Applicants must be currently working in the concerned local body on outsourced, daily wage or contract basis for at least one year as Pourakarmika, loader, UGD helper, cleaner, helper, waste processing unit worker, public toilet sanitation worker or zero‑waste management unit sanitation worker with ESI and PF benefits to be eligible for Tumakuru Pourakarmika Recruitment 2026.

Family members of deceased Pourakarmikas: Candidates who are family members of Pourakarmikas that died while working on outsourced/daily wage/contract basis due to Covid‑19 or other reasons in the concerned ULB may also be considered eligible for Tumakuru Pourakarmika posts, subject to production of proper proof and certification from the competent authority.

Manual Scavenger Victims: Persons identified as victims under the Manual Scavengers Act or their family members, duly certified by the competent authority, are also eligible to apply for Pourakarmika posts under this Tumakuru Recruitment 2026 drive.

Knowledge of Kannada: Candidates must have the ability to speak Kannada and basic knowledge of Kannada language for effective discharge of duties as Pourakarmika in Tumakuru district urban local bodies. A self‑declaration regarding knowledge of Kannada has to be enclosed with the application form.

Clean Service Record: Applicants should not be involved in any criminal case and should not have been dismissed or removed from service due to disciplinary action in any previous employment. Candidates must meet all conduct and character requirements as laid down in the Tumakuru Pourakarmika notification 2026.

Tumakuru Pourakarmika Salary 2026

Candidates selected through the Tumakuru Pourakarmika Recruitment 2026 will be appointed as Pourakarmikas under the direct payment system in Tumakuru City Corporation, Tiptur City Municipal Council and Sira City Municipal Council.

Salary under Direct Payment System: Selected Pourakarmikas will receive monthly wages directly from the concerned Urban Local Body as per the Government of Karnataka norms and prevailing minimum wage rates for civic sanitation workers. Detailed pay and allowances will be governed by applicable government orders and Poura Seva Vrunda & Recruitment Rules.

Service Benefits: As direct payment Pourakarmikas, workers will continue to be covered under ESI and PF and other welfare schemes notified by the State Government for civic workers from time to time. However, this recruitment does not automatically grant them regular government employee status unless specifically regularised by separate government orders.

Tumakuru Pourakarmika Application Fees 2026

The official Tumakuru Pourakarmika Direct Payment Recruitment 2026 notification primarily focuses on eligibility, experience and procedure for submission of application forms through the respective ULB offices.

Application Fee Status: No specific application fee structure is explicitly highlighted in the notification text, and the process is described as obtaining and submitting the prescribed application form at the concerned offices. Candidates should refer to the detailed notification and instructions on the Tumakuru DUDC website or ULB notice boards to confirm if any nominal processing fee is to be paid at the time of form submission.

Tumakuru Pourakarmika Selection Process 2026

The Tumakuru Pourakarmika Direct Payment Recruitment 2026 selection process is based on the service conditions and special categories defined in the notification, under the chairmanship of the Deputy Commissioner, Tumakuru.

Merit Based on Existing Service: Priority is given to candidates who have been working for at least one year in the concerned ULB on outsourced/daily wage/contract basis as Pourakarmikas, loaders, UGD helpers, cleaners, helpers and other sanitation workers with valid ESI and PF records certified by the competent authority.

Special Priority Categories: Family members of Pourakarmikas who died while working (including due to Covid‑19) and persons or family members identified as victims under the Manual Scavengers Act are also considered under special categories, subject to proper certification.

No Reservation under Direct Payment: The notification clarifies that this direct payment recruitment process is not governed by the statutory reservation provisions applicable to regular recruitment, and appointments will be made strictly under the specific direct payment rules and government circulars.

Final Decision by Selection Committee: The Direct Payment Pourakarmika Recruitment Selection Committee headed by the Deputy Commissioner, Tumakuru, reserves the final authority regarding scrutiny of applications, preparation of selection list and all decisions related to appointment.

How to Apply for Tumakuru Pourakarmika Recruitment 2026

Applicants who meet the eligibility norms for Tumakuru Pourakarmika Direct Payment Recruitment 2026 must submit their applications only through the offline mode at the respective ULB offices within the stipulated dates.

Step 1 – Read Public Notification: Candidates should first read the Tumakuru Pourakarmika public recruitment notification carefully on the District Urban Development Cell website or on the notice boards of Tumakuru City Corporation, Tiptur CMC and Sira CMC to understand eligibility, conditions and instructions.

Step 2 – Obtain Application Form: From 25‑03‑2026, visit the concerned ULB office (Tumakuru City Corporation / Tiptur City Municipal Council / Sira City Municipal Council) in person and obtain the prescribed Pourakarmika application form for direct payment recruitment.

Step 3 – Fill Application Carefully: Fill in all required details such as personal information, contact details, experience as outsourced/daily wage/contract Pourakarmika or sanitation worker, ESI and PF details, category (if applicable), family details of deceased worker or manual scavenger victim, and declaration in the application form without any errors.

Step 4 – Attach Required Documents: Attach self‑attested copies of supporting documents such as Aadhaar card, voter ID, proof of age, ESI and PF records, service certificate from the concerned ULB, death certificate and competency certificate (for deceased Pourakarmika cases), manual scavenger identification certificate (if applicable) and self‑declaration of knowledge of Kannada.

Step 5 – Submit Application at ULB Office: Submit the duly filled application form along with all enclosures in person at the office of the respective ULB on or before 08‑04‑2026 up to 5:00 PM. Applications sent by post, courier or any mode other than personal submission at the ULB office will not be accepted.

Step 6 – Keep Acknowledgement and Copy: After submission, candidates should obtain acknowledgement (if provided) from the ULB office and keep a photocopy of the filled application form and attached documents safely for future reference during verification and selection.

RWF Apprentice Vacancy 2026 Details

Sl. No. Designated Trade Total
1 Fitter 85
2 Machinist 31
3 Mechanic (Motor Vehicle) 8
4 Turner 5
5 CNC Programming cum-Operator (COE Group) 23
6 Electrician 18
7 Electronic Mechanic 22
TOTAL 192

Note: The above vacancies are tentative and the administration reserves the right to modify them. Seats of PwBD and Ex-Servicemen are included in the total and not separate.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Minimum Educational Qualification: Candidates must have passed the 10th class examination or its equivalent with a minimum of 50% (aggregate) marks from recognized Boards, as on the date of issue of Notification.
  • Technical Qualification: Candidates must also possess a National Trade Certificate (NTC) in the designated trade in which this administration is imparting training, issued by the National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT). Mere completion of a course is not sufficient.
  • Note: Candidates who are awaiting results pertaining to ITI/NTC as on the date of this Notification are NOT eligible to apply. Candidates who have failed in ITI/NTC should not apply.
  • Higher Qualification: Engineering Graduates and Diploma Holders are NOT ELIGIBLE to apply for undergoing Apprenticeship Training in response to this Notification, as they are governed by a separate scheme of Apprenticeship.
  • Employment Exchange Registration (Mandatory): The candidates who have registered their names with the local Employment Exchanges are only eligible to apply. The registration should be current and valid as on the date of issue of this Notification. Preference will be given to those candidates who have registered in Employment Exchanges within the jurisdiction of State of Karnataka.
  • Wards of Serving Railway Employees: Wards of Serving Railway employees all over the Indian Railways are also eligible to apply. Serving Railway employees should ensure that the applications of their wards are sent through their respective Controlling Officials in the prescribed proforma as per Annexure-D. Registration of names of their wards with Employment Exchanges is not necessary for this category.
  • Only full-time regular courses will be considered. All minimum essential qualifications must be from recognized Boards / NCVT.

Stipend / Salary

  • Fitter, Machinist, Mechanic (Motor Vehicle), Turner, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic: Stipend of ₹12,261/- per month during the period of apprenticeship training.
  • CNC Programming cum-Operator (COE Group): Stipend of ₹10,899/- per month during the period of apprenticeship training.
  • Stipend rates are as per extant rules amended from time to time.
  • Note: As per the Act, it is not obligatory on the part of the Railways to offer any employment to the Apprentices on completion of their Apprenticeship training. The Act Apprentices imparted training in Railway establishments will have no claim to seek employment on Railways on the basis of such training.

Age Limit (as on 01-03-2026)

  • The candidate should have completed 15 years of age and should not have completed 24 years of age as on 01.03.2026 (i.e. date of issue of Notification).
  • Age Relaxation:
    • SC / ST candidates: Upper age limit relaxable by 5 years
    • OBC candidates: Upper age limit relaxable by 3 years
    • Age relaxation as per extant instructions of Railway Board and as amended from time to time.
  • Candidates who want to avail the benefit of reservation of SC/ST must produce his/her caste certificate on Govt. of India format issued by appropriate authority as per Annexure-B.
  • Candidates who want to avail the benefit of reservation of OBC must produce caste certificate and Non-Creamy Layer Certificate issued on or after 01.07.2025 on Govt. of India format as per Annexure-C.

Application Fee

  • Application Fee: ₹100/- (One Hundred only) as processing fee in the form of an Indian Postal Order (IPO) / Demand Draft from any Nationalised Bank, drawn in favour of 'Principal Financial Adviser / Rail Wheel Factory'.
  • Exempted Categories: No fee is required to be paid by SC / ST / Physically Handicapped / Women candidates.
  • Applications not accompanied with the processing fee, wherever required, will be summarily rejected.
  • The IPO/DD instruments should not have been issued earlier to the date of issue of this Notification (28.02.2026).
  • The processing fee is non-refundable.

Training Period

  • Fitter, Machinist, Mechanic (Motor Vehicle), Turner, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic: Training period is One Year.
  • CNC Programming cum-Operator (COE Group): Training period is Six Months.
  • Training will be arranged in accordance with the standards and syllabus prescribed by the Central Apprenticeship Council.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 28/02/2026
Last Date for Submission of Application 01/04/2026 (Before 17:00 hrs)
Probable Date of Display of List of Selected Candidates 45 days from the closing date of receipt of applications
Tentative Date of Commencement of Training 15 days after issue of merit list

Selection Process

  • The selection of candidates will be made on the basis of merit list prepared based on the percentage of marks obtained by the candidate in 10th Std / Matriculation or its equivalent with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks.
  • For the purpose of calculation of percentage of marks in 10th Std, marks obtained by the candidates in all the subjects as indicated in the said marks sheet will be reckoned and not on the basis of marks of any subject or a group of subjects.
  • Tie-breaking Rule: In case of two candidates having the same marks, the candidate with older age shall be preferred. In case dates of birth are also the same, the candidate who passed the 10th Std / Matriculation or its equivalent examination earlier shall be considered first.
  • A final merit list would be prepared equal to the number of designated trades proposed to be filled up, duly ensuring reservation for SC/ST/OBC/PH/Ex-Servicemen candidates, in descending order of percentage of marks obtained.
  • Candidates finally enlisted to undergo training would be subjected to verification of original testimonials.
  • Medical Fitness: Candidates must satisfy minimum standards of physical fitness as prescribed in the Apprentices Act, 1961 and Apprenticeship Rules, 1992 as amended from time to time. The selected candidates will have to submit a prescribed medical examination certificate in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-E) before their engagement. Physical fitness will be certified by a government authorized Doctor (Gazetted) not below the rank of Assistant Surgeon of Central/State Hospital.

General Information / Instructions

  • Rail Wheel Factory Administration is the nodal agency for processing of applications from candidates and preparation of their merit list.
  • Before commencement of the Apprenticeship training, selected candidates have to execute a Contract of Apprenticeship with the Employer. If the candidate is a Minor, then his/her guardian has to enter into a contract of Apprenticeship with the Employer.
  • Selected candidates are required to register the contract of Apprenticeship in online mode at the Apprenticeship portal: https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/candidate-login. Candidates are advised to register at the earliest without waiting for the final select list to be published.
  • On completion of training, the candidate, on passing a test to be conducted by NCVT in Vocational Trades, will be given a certificate of proficiency in the trade by the National Council.
  • Candidates should ensure that their Name, Father's/Mother's name/Guardian's name and Date of Birth in the application form exactly match as recorded in their Matriculation or equivalent certificates and other certificates including Aadhaar certificates. Any deviation found during document verification will lead to cancellation of candidature and debarment from undergoing training.
  • Reservation and age relaxation for various categories/communities is as per the Govt. of India Rules for the purpose and as revised by the Railway Board from time to time.
  • Candidates employed in Government / Quasi-Government / PSU should send their application through proper channel.
  • Candidates will have no claim to seek employment on Railways on the basis of such training as per the Apprentices Act, 1961.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature.
  • No Hostel facility will be provided. The selected candidates should make their own arrangements for their stay during their period of training.
  • The candidates attending the office for verification of documents will not be paid any TA/DA.
  • The caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC) should be in the form notified by the Government of India. If the caste certified by the candidate does not appear in the Central Gazette, then he/she will be treated as belonging to 'UR' community.
  • The applicant should submit only one application form. Multiple applications will be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates are required to furnish the correct and complete postal address with Pin Code in their application.
  • The list of selected candidates will be displayed at https://rwf.indianrailways.gov.in. Important messages will be sent by SMS/E-mail.
  • Help Desk: For any queries related to the submission of applications, candidates can call on 080-28072616 from 09:00 hrs. to 16:50 hrs. (Monday to Friday) on all working days and from 09:00 hrs. to 12:20 hrs. on Saturday (except Sundays and Holidays).

Documents Required (Self-Attested Photocopies)

  • 10th Std / Matriculation or its equivalent marks certificate with at least 50% marks, with Date of Birth as proof of age.
  • National Trade Certificate (NTC) in the designated trade issued by NCVT.
  • Copy of caste certificate (SC/ST candidates in proforma Annexure-B and OBC candidates in proforma Annexure-C).
  • Physically Handicapped / Disability certificate duly issued by the competent medical board.
  • Two identical passport size photographs duly self-attested and firmly stitched in a separate cover to the application form (apart from one copy pasted on the application form).
  • Discharge certificate / serving certificate for wards of Ex-Servicemen / serving Railway employee.
  • Employment Registration card, registered in Employment Exchanges within the State of Karnataka (for Karnataka candidates) or respective local employment exchanges (for other state candidates), with renewal being current.
  • Wards of serving Railway employees should produce a certificate issued by the respective controlling officers in proforma Annexure-D.
  • IPO / Demand Draft of ₹100/- as processing fee (where applicable).

How to Apply

  • Download the Application Form (Annexure-A) and all other Annexures (B, C, D & E) from the official website of Rail Wheel Factory: https://rwf.indianrailways.gov.in. No other format shall be entertained.
  • Fill the application form carefully. Ensure that Name, Father's/Mother's/Guardian's name and Date of Birth exactly match as recorded in Matriculation and other certificates. Any deviation will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • Affix a recent colour passport size photograph duly signed/attested by the candidate on the application form.
  • Enclose all required self-attested documents including 10th marks sheet, NTC, caste certificate, Employment Exchange registration card, photographs and IPO/DD as applicable.
  • Fill and sign the checklist in Annexure-F. Applications submitted without duly filled in checklist and signed by the candidate will not be considered.
  • The application (Annexure-A) can either be dropped in the sealed Drop Box kept in the Office of the Principal Chief Personnel Officer, Personnel Department, Rail Wheel Factory, Yelahanka, Bangalore-560064 on all working days (Monday to Friday: 09:00 hrs to 16:50 hrs; Saturday: 09:00 hrs to 12:20 hrs).
  • Alternatively, the application can be sent by REGISTERED POST ONLY to the below address, superscribing on the cover as "Application for undergoing training under the Apprentices' Act, 1961 for the year 2025-26 in Rail Wheel Factory":
    The Senior Personnel Officer-II, Personnel Department, Rail Wheel Factory, Yelahanka, Bangalore – 560 064.
  • Applications should be submitted to this office before 17:00 hrs. of the closing date i.e., 01.04.2026. Applications received after the closing date will not be entertained under any circumstances.
  • Candidates are advised to submit applications well in advance before the closing date to avoid last minute rush.

ISRO URSC Scientist Engineer Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates applying for ISRO URSC Scientist Engineer Recruitment 2026 must carefully check the post wise eligibility criteria for Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’, Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’ and Medical Officer ‘SC’ before filling the online application form.

Nationality: The applicant must be a citizen of India to be eligible for ISRO URSC Scientist/Engineer and Medical Officer posts under Advertisement No. URSC:01:2026.

Age Limit (as on 12.04.2026): For Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’, the maximum age limit is 28 years, while for Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’ and Medical Officer ‘SC’, the upper age limit is 35 years, with relaxations in the upper age limit for SC, ST, OBC, PwBD, Ex‑servicemen and departmental candidates as per Government of India rules.

Educational Qualification – Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech or equivalent degree in Industrial Production, Industrial Engineering, Industrial Management, Industrial Engineering & Management, Production Engineering or allied branches with a minimum of 65% aggregate marks (average of all semesters) or at least 6.84 CGPA on a 10‑point scale from a recognized university or institution.

Educational Qualification – Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’: Applicants should have a Ph.D. in Thin Films, Material Science, Applied Optics or Metallurgy along with mandatory pre‑eligibility qualifications such as M.Sc. in Physics/Material Science or M.Tech in Material Science/Metallurgical Engineering/Applied Optics, and B.E./B.Tech in relevant physical streams/Metallurgical Engineering/Material Science or B.Sc in Physics/Chemistry/Material Science, with at least 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA at the M.Sc./M.Tech and B.Sc levels and prescribed minimum marks/CGPA in B.E./B.Tech as per the notification.

Educational Qualification – Medical Officer ‘SC’: Candidates must have an MBBS degree with compulsory rotatory internship, passed with at least second class, recognized by the National Medical Commission (previously Medical Council of India), along with 2 years of post‑registration experience in clinical practice and a valid registration with the National Medical Commission or State Medical Council.

Minimum Marks & Course Duration: The essential qualifications at graduation and post‑graduation level must be completed within the stipulated duration of the course as prescribed by the university, and where both percentage and CGPA are mentioned, at least one of them must meet the minimum marks criteria prescribed for ISRO URSC Scientist Engineer Recruitment 2026.

Medical Fitness & Other Conditions: Selected candidates must be medically fit as per ISRO norms and should satisfy all other conditions mentioned in the URSC Scientist Engineer and Medical Officer notification, including good character, clean disciplinary record and submission of all required certificates in original during document verification.

ISRO URSC Scientist Engineer Salary 2026

Candidates appointed through the ISRO URSC Scientist Engineer Recruitment 2026 will receive salary as per the 7th CPC Pay Matrix along with admissible allowances and other benefits applicable to Central Government employees.

Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ Salary: Selected Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ at URSC will be placed in Pay Level 10 (Rs. 56,100 – 1,77,500) with an initial basic pay of Rs. 56,100 per month plus Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance/leased accommodation, Transport benefits and other ISRO‑specific perks.

Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’ Salary: Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’ will be appointed in Pay Level 11 (Rs. 67,100 – 2,08,700) with an approximate starting basic pay of Rs. 67,700 per month plus admissible allowances as per Government of India rules.

Medical Officer ‘SC’ Salary: Medical Officer ‘SC’ will also be in Pay Level 10 (Rs. 56,100 – 1,77,500) with basic pay of Rs. 56,100 per month along with allowances and an additional Non‑Practicing Allowance (NPA) @ 20% of basic pay as per medical cadre norms.

Other Benefits: ISRO URSC employees are covered under National Pension System/Unified Pension Scheme and are eligible for benefits like LTC, Group Insurance, medical facilities for self and dependents, subsidised canteen, transport facility/transport allowance and housing benefits as per ISRO/DoS policies.

ISRO URSC Scientist Engineer Application Fees 2026

Applicants for ISRO URSC Scientist Engineer Recruitment 2026 (Post Codes 01 & 03) are required to pay a partially refundable processing fee as specified in the advertisement.

Processing Fee: All candidates applying for Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ (Post Code 01) and Medical Officer ‘SC’ (Post Code 03) must initially pay Rs. 750/- per application as processing fee through the prescribed online payment gateway.

Application Fee Component: Out of the above amount, Rs. 250/- is treated as non‑refundable application fee for these posts, and the remaining portion of the processing fee is eligible for refund as per the category‑wise conditions mentioned in the notification.

Refund Rules: Women candidates, SC/ST candidates, PwBD and Ex‑servicemen who appear in the written test/interview are generally eligible for full refund of Rs. 750/-, while other candidates who appear in the written test/interview are eligible for partial refund (typically Rs. 500/-), subject to validity of their application and actual attendance.

No Fee for Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’: For Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’ (Post Code 02), there is normally no application fee; candidates only need to register and apply through the ISRO Live Register portal.

ISRO URSC Scientist Engineer Selection Process 2026

The ISRO URSC Scientist Engineer Recruitment 2026 selection process differs slightly for each post, combining written examination, shortlisting and interview as per the post code.

Selection – Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ (Post Code 01): Eligible applications are first screened based on academic performance and other criteria; shortlisted candidates are called for a Written Test at Bengaluru, and those who qualify in the written test will be further shortlisted for a personal interview, with final merit prepared on overall performance.

Selection – Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’ (Post Code 02): Candidates register on the ISRO Live Register portal; an initial screening is carried out using qualifications, research profile and other parameters, and shortlisted candidates are called directly for interview, where the final selection is made based on interview performance.

Selection – Medical Officer ‘SC’ (Post Code 03): For Medical Officer posts, applications are screened on the basis of MBBS qualification, registration and experience; shortlisted candidates are invited for interview, and selection is made purely on the basis of interview and verification of credentials.

Document Verification & Medical Fitness: At the time of interview/joining, candidates must produce all original certificates for verification and also satisfy the prescribed medical fitness standards of ISRO URSC.

How to Apply for ISRO URSC Scientist Engineer Recruitment 2026

Interested and eligible candidates must submit their applications for ISRO URSC Scientist Engineer Recruitment 2026 only through the online mode within the specified dates; no offline applications will be accepted.

Step 1 – Visit Official Websites: Go to the official ISRO website (www.isro.gov.in) or URSC website (www.ursc.gov.in) and open the careers/recruitment page to find the link for “URSC:01:2026 – Recruitment of Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’, Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’ & Medical Officer ‘SC’”.

Step 2 – Read Notification: Download and carefully read the ISRO URSC Scientist Engineer Notification 2026 to understand eligibility, important dates, post‑wise qualifications, selection process, fee details and instructions for online application.

Step 3 – Online Registration (Post Code 01 & 03): For Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ and Medical Officer ‘SC’, click on the online registration link, enter basic personal details, contact information and create your login; candidates registered on the National Career Service (NCS) portal must still complete this registration process on the ISRO/URSC site.

Step 4 – Fill Online Application Form: Log in with your credentials and fill the ISRO URSC application form with accurate details of personal information, educational qualifications (with marks/CGPA), experience (for Medical Officer), category, PwBD status and communication details as per your certificates.

Step 5 – Upload Documents: Upload recent passport size colour photograph, signature and required certificates (educational mark sheets and degrees, NMC/State Medical Council registration, experience certificates, caste/ESWS/PwBD/Ex‑serviceman certificates, AIU equivalence for foreign degrees, etc.) in the prescribed file format and size.

Step 6 – Pay Application/Processing Fee: Pay the Rs. 750/- processing fee (where applicable) through the integrated online payment gateway using net banking, debit/credit card or UPI, and ensure that the transaction is successful; later verify the payment status using the “Payment Status” link provided on the site.

Step 7 – Submit and Print Application: After verifying all entries, submit the online form; note down the online registration number and take a printout or save a PDF copy of the submitted application form and fee receipt for future reference and for producing at the time of interview/document verification.

Step 8 – For Post Code 02 (Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’): Candidates must register and apply through the dedicated ISRO Live Register portal, update their academic and research details before the last date, and keep a copy of the generated registration for future reference.

General Instructions for ISRO URSC Scientist Engineer Recruitment 2026

Candidates applying for ISRO URSC Scientist Engineer Recruitment 2026 must follow all general instructions given in the advertisement to ensure that their applications are accepted and considered for selection.

Accuracy of Information: Applicants are solely responsible for ensuring that they fulfil all eligibility criteria and that the details entered in the online form are correct; once the online application is finally submitted, it cannot be edited, so all information should be verified carefully before submission.

Multiple Applications: If any changes are needed after submission, candidates may submit a fresh application; in case of multiple applications, only the latest application for which fee is successfully paid will be treated as valid, and candidates should avoid unnecessary multiple submissions for the same post.

Document Upload & Verification: Applications without uploading clear scanned copies of the required documents will be rejected; the uploaded documents will be verified at the time of interview, and mere receipt of call letter does not guarantee selection.

Fee Payment & Refund: Application/processing fee must be paid only through the authorised online payment gateway; ISRO/URSC will not be responsible for failed or pending transactions due to incorrect bank details, and refund of processing fee will be strictly as per rules only to eligible candidates.

Compliance with Rules: All appointments are subject to Government of India rules, verification of original documents, character & antecedent verification and medical fitness; ISRO also encourages women and transgender candidates to apply as part of its commitment to gender‑balanced workforce.

Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC) under Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), Department of Space, Government of India has released the VSSC Authorised Medical Officer & Dermatologist Recruitment 2026 notification for contract-based positions of Authorised Medical Officer (Allopathy) at Parassala, Authorised Medical Officer (Homeopathy) at Nemom, and Dermatologist in Thiruvananthapuram.
 
Candidates must possess MBBS with permanent Medical Council Registration for Allopathy, BHMS with Registration in the Council of Indian Systems of Medicine for Homeopathy, and MD/DNB Dermatology or PG Diploma in Dermatology with additional qualification registration for the Dermatologist post, along with minimum two years of relevant experience after registration/graduation and their own well-equipped consultation room with good facilities at the specified locations (Parassala / Nemom / Thiruvananthapuram city). Preference will be given to doctors below 70 years of age.
 
All these latest ISRO doctor jobs on contract basis are offered initially for 6 months (extendable with mutual consent) with attractive remuneration ranging from ₹12,000–₹54,000 per month for Authorised Medical Officer (Allopathy) based on files assigned, fixed ₹12,500 per month for Homeopathy Medical Officer, and ₹400 per consultation for Dermatologist, making this one of the attractive government medical positions for experienced doctors looking for opportunities in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications – Authorised Medical Officer (Allopathy) at Parassala, Thiruvananthapuram:

  • Authorised Medical Officer (Homeopathy): Fixed amount of ₹12,500/- per month.
  • Dermatologist: ₹400/- per consultation.
  • All positions are on Contract Basis initially for 6 months, extendable with mutual consent.
  • Selection does not warrant any claim for regular employment in VSSC or any other Centres of ISRO/Department of Space.

Age Limit

  • Preference will be given to doctors below 70 years of age for all the above posts.

Event Date

  • Step 1 – Shortlisting: Applications received will be screened and only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. Shortlisted candidates will receive intimation about the details of the interview through email/phone.

  • Step 3 – Inspection of Consultation Room: The consultation room of the candidate will be inspected on or immediately after the date of personal interview. Only candidates with a consultation room with good facilities at the required location will be considered.
  • Candidates should enclose self-attested true copies of the relevant certificates/testimonials along with the application and submit the same on the date of interview.
  • Candidates possessing the advertised qualification, skill, and experience alone will be allowed to attend the interview.

General Information / Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals need apply.
  • Candidates should appear for the interview in person along with the Bio-data form (in prescribed format), original certificates proving educational qualification, age, experience, registration etc.
  • Candidates are advised to make their own arrangements for stay at their own cost, if required.
  • Selection does not warrant any claim for regular employment in VSSC or any other Centres of ISRO/Department of Space.

  • No interim correspondence will be entertained.
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
  • Government strives to have a workforce which reflects gender balance and women candidates are encouraged to apply.

How to Apply

  • Download the application form from the official website: www.vssc.gov.in.
  • Fill in the prescribed application/Bio-data form duly and completely.
  • Submit the filled application form along with scanned copies of educational qualification/registration certificates and experience certificates via email to: [email protected].
  • Email Subject Line must be: 'Application to the position of AMO (Allopathy) / AMO (Homeopathy) / Dermatologist on contract' (as applicable to the post applied for).
  • Applications must be submitted on or before 31-03-2026.
  • Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. Shortlisted candidates will receive information about interview date, time and venue through email/phone.
  • On the day of interview, candidates must bring the Bio-data form, original certificates of educational qualification, age, experience, registration etc., and self-attested photocopies of all relevant documents.

Eligibility Criteria – FCRI Walk-In Interview 2026

1) Trainee Graduate Engineers (Level‑1 & Level‑2) – Civil / Mechanical / Electrical / Instrumentation

  • Educational Qualification​

    • Full‑time degree in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) in relevant discipline (Civil / Mechanical / Electrical / Instrumentation / Electrical Sciences).

    • Degree must be from UGC/AICTE‑recognized Universities/Institutions.

    • Either 4‑year regular bachelor’s degree programme, or Engineering degree through lateral entry after full‑time Engineering Diploma in relevant discipline from recognized Polytechnic.

    • Minimum First Class with 60% or more aggregate in qualifying degree (and in diploma, if applicable).

  • Experience​

    • Level‑2:

      • Minimum 1 year experience in relevant areas as specified for each discipline (Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, Instrumentation/Electrical Sciences) – e.g. calibration/testing, construction & maintenance, O&M of substations, calibration of electro‑technical parameters, etc.

    • Level‑1:

      • Less than 1 year experience in relevant areas, including candidates with at least 2 months of relevant internship / practical exposure.

2) ITI/NCVT Trades (Level‑1 & Level‑2) – Machinist / Fitter / Welder / Plumber / Electrician / AC & Refrigeration

  • Educational Qualification​

    • ITI with NCVT in relevant trade: Machinist, Fitter, Welder, Plumber, Electrician, AC & Refrigeration.

    • Minimum 55% marks or more in ITI/NCVT.

  • Experience​

    • Level‑1:

      • Freshers or candidates with less than 1 year experience in relevant trade areas (shop floor, fabrication, installation/maintenance, troubleshooting, etc.).

    • Level‑2:

      • Minimum 1 year experience in relevant trade areas as described (workshop/machining, plumbing & piping systems, electrical fault rectification, AC & refrigeration systems, etc.).

No explicit upper age limit is mentioned in these walk‑in notifications; selection is primarily based on qualification, relevant experience and performance in the walk‑in interview / test.

Eligibility Criteria for MPESB Group-5 Paramedical 2026

1. Educational Qualification

Candidates must have passed the Higher Secondary (10+2) examination with Biology, Chemistry, and Physics from a recognized board. In addition, candidates must hold a relevant Diploma/Degree/Certificate in the concerned subject from a recognized institution, along with a valid registration with the Madhya Pradesh Para-Medical Council (MP Sah-Chikitsiya Parishad). The exact minimum educational qualification varies post-wise as specified in Chapter-2 of the official notification. Some examples are as follows:

  • Staff Nurse: 10+2 with Biology group + 3-year General Nursing programme OR 4-year GNM Diploma from a recognized institution + registration with a recognized Nursing Council.
  • Pharmacist Grade-2: 10+2 with Biology group + Degree/Diploma in Pharmacy + registration with MP Pharmacy Council.
  • Dental Technician: 10+2 with Biology, Chemistry & Physics + Diploma in relevant subject from a recognized institution + MP Para-Medical Council registration.
  • Ayurvedic Compounder: 10+2 (Higher Secondary) from a recognized board + 1-year Ayurvedic Compounder training from a recognized institution + registration with MP Para-Medical Council.
  • Lab Attendant / Dresser Grade-2 / Dissection Hall Attendant: 10+2 with Biology, Chemistry, and Physics.
  • Compounder (Aushadhi Sanyojak): 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology + Diploma in Pharmacy from an MP Govt.-recognized institution + Pharmacy Council registration + minimum 3 years of work experience as a Compounder.

Candidates must possess the required qualification as on the date of application submission. Qualifications acquired after the closing date of the application will not be considered.

2. Age Limit

The age limit for MPESB Group-5 Paramedical Recruitment 2026 is:

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 40 years (General/Unreserved)
  • Maximum Age: 45 years for SC/ST/OBC/Women (Reserved & Unreserved)/PwD/Government Employees/Home Guards of Madhya Pradesh
  • Age Relaxation: As per MP Government norms for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Ex-Servicemen
  • Age Calculation Date: 01 January 2026
  • Note: In no case shall the maximum age exceed 45 years (except for contractual employees and categories mentioned in Rule 14).

3. Nationality

Candidates must be Indian citizens or citizens of Nepal as specified under MP Civil Services Recruitment Rules 1961. Candidates who are not permanent residents of Madhya Pradesh can only apply for unreserved/open category posts and will not be entitled to any reservation or age relaxation benefits.

Selection Process for MPESB Group-5 Paramedical 2026

Candidates will be selected based on the following process as specified in the official notification:

  • Online Written Examination: A single objective-type question paper of 100 marks will be conducted online. The paper consists of two sections: (a) General Knowledge, General Hindi, General English, General Mathematics, General Science & General Aptitude — 25 marks; (b) Technical/Trade-based questions — 75 marks. Duration: 2 hours per shift.
  • Negative Marking: 0.25 marks will be deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Normalisation: Results will be prepared using the Normalised Equi-Percentile (NEP) scaling technique in case the exam is held in multiple shifts.
  • Merit List: Candidates will be shortlisted based on percentile scores obtained in the written examination.
  • Document Verification: Selected candidates' documents (educational, technical, professional qualifications) will be verified by the concerned recruiting department.
  • Medical Examination: Candidates must be physically and mentally fit as per the requirements of the post.

Note: MP-ESB is responsible only for conducting the written examination and declaring its result. All subsequent appointment procedures including document verification and issuing of appointment orders will be carried out by the respective recruiting departments.

  • General/Unreserved (UR) Candidates: ₹500/- per question paper
