Educational and professional qualifications for SECL Apprenticeship 2026 are stream-specific and must be from Government-recognised institutions in full-time regular mode only.

  • Graduate Apprentices: 4-year B.E./B.Tech / B.Sc. / B.Com / BBA / BCA in relevant discipline.
  • Technician Apprentices: 3-year Diploma in relevant engineering branch (after 10th or 2 years after 12th with lateral entry allowed; 1-year Diploma not permitted).

Candidates must be registered on NATS 2.0 portal and should not have undergone apprenticeship training earlier or completed one-year employment/service.

SECL Apprentice Selection Process 2026

The SECL Apprentice Selection Process 2026 is purely merit-based:

  • Shortlisting on the basis of Date of Passing (earlier passing gets higher rank)
  • Tie-breaker: Percentage of marks in Degree/Diploma → 12th/10th marks → Date of Birth
  • Two separate seniority lists: Level-1 (Chhattisgarh & Madhya Pradesh) and Level-2 (other states)
  • Document Verification + Medical Fitness Examination (as per Mines Rules 1955 / Apprenticeship Rules 1992)

SECL Apprentice Stipend 2026

Selected candidates will receive the following monthly stipend as per Rule 11(2) of Apprenticeship Rules 1992:

  • Graduate Apprentices: ₹12,300 per month
  • Technician Apprentices: ₹10,900 per month

50% stipend paid by SECL and 50% by Government through DBT in Aadhaar-linked bank account.

Selection Process

  • Written Examination (OMR Based):
    • Objective type questions on OMR sheet will be conducted.
    • Negative Marking (Rnnatmak Mulyankan) is applicable.
    • Exam centres: Indore, Bhopal, Jabalpur and Gwalior.
    • Exam Plan and Syllabus will be published on the Commission's website www.mppsc.mp.gov.in in due course.
    • Candidates up to a maximum of three times the notified vacancies (category-wise) will be shortlisted for interview based on written exam marks.
  • Interview (Viva Voce / Saakshaatkar):
    • Candidates shortlisted from the written examination will be called for interview.
    • Interview total marks: 100. Minimum qualifying marks for Unreserved category: 41; for Reserved categories and Divyangjan: 31.
    • Final selection will be based on the merit order of aggregate marks (written examination + interview).
    • Candidates absent from interview will be considered ineligible for selection.
  • If total applicants are less than 500: Selection will be based on interview only. Candidates will be shortlisted directly for interview as per the following ratio: 1 post – up to 12 candidates; 2–3 posts – up to 24; 4–6 posts – up to 36; 7–9 posts – up to 48; 10 posts and above – up to 50 candidates or 5 times the vacancies.
  • Post-Answer Key Process: Provisional answer key will be published on the Commission's website after the exam. Objections can be submitted within 05 days at ₹150/- per question (plus ₹40/- portal charge). Final answer key will be published after expert committee review. No objections will be entertained after publication of the final answer key.

General Information / Instructions

  • All amendments/instructions issued by the Government from time to time regarding age, domicile, employment exchange registration, reservation etc. will be incorporated into the final selection result.
  • The syllabus is attached in Bhaag-"H" of the notification and will be published on the Commission's website www.mppsc.mp.gov.in.
  • Cut-off marks of written exam and interview will not be disclosed prior to final selection.
  • If a computer or clerical error is noticed after declaration of result, the Commission reserves the right to correct it.
  • Reserved category seats (SC/ST/OBC) and age relaxation benefits are available only to Madhya Pradesh domicile candidates. Candidates from other states will be considered as Unreserved.
  • In any reserved category, if no eligible female candidate is available, the reserved seats will be filled by male candidates of the same category.
  • Divyangjan (Persons with Disabilities) candidates must attach the latest valid disability certificate issued by the District Medical Board constituted as per Ministry notification F-8-1-Satreh-Medi-2, dated 09.01.2009. Disability certificate issued after 01.06.2021 must be from the UID portal http://www.swavlambancard.gov.in. Manually issued certificates after that date will be invalid. Minimum 40% permanent disability is required to claim reservation and other benefits.
  • Candidates who are in Government service (temporary, daily wage, contractual, or under public undertakings) must submit an Undertaking that they have informed their Head of Department/office about applying for this post.
  • All information published regarding this recruitment notification including result will be available only on www.mppsc.mp.gov.in. Commission will not communicate through Email/letters/phone individually.
  • EWS (Economically Weaker Section) certificate valid for financial year 2026-27 must be held by the candidate by the last date of online application i.e. 20.05.2026.
  • OBC candidates must ensure they are not in the Creamy Layer. Non-Creamy Layer declaration as per the prescribed proforma must be submitted.
  • Final selection result for OBC reservation is subject to the pending court cases SLP 8764/2023 and WP5596/2024 and related matters. The result will be declared in Main Part (87%) and Provisional Part (13%) as per MP Govt. order dated 29.09.2022.
  • Disqualifications under MP Civil Services Rules 1961: Candidates convicted of crimes against women, candidates with more than 2 living children (where one was born on or after 26 January 2001) are not eligible for appointment.

How to Apply

  • Online applications must be submitted at www.mppsc.mp.gov.in. Applications through any other means will not be accepted.
  • Online application window: 21-04-2026 to 20-05-2026.
  • Before filling the form, prepare a recent passport-size colour photograph scan and signature scan file as per instructions in the notification.
  • Fee can be paid via Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking, or at M.P. Online authorized kiosks in cash.
  • After filling the form, a popup window will display basic information (name, parents' names, date of birth, category, gender) for verification. If any error is found, click Cancel to go back and correct. Click OK to submit. After successful submission, the application number will be generated (status will be Unpaid until fee is paid).
  • After submitting, click "Proceed for Payment" to complete fee payment. After successful payment, the application will be received and "Payment Done" will be displayed. Take a printout of the application form and preserve the application number for future reference.
  • Error Correction Facility: Online application correction can be done from 26.04.2026 to 22.05.2026 (till 12:00 midnight) at ₹50/- per correction. Applications submitted with late fee: corrections allowed up to 28.10.2026 at ₹50/- per correction.
  • Category/Gender/Date of Birth cannot be changed after the error correction period ends.
  • Candidates must ensure their signature is consistent across all documents; mismatch of signatures on various documents will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • No documents need to be uploaded at the time of online application. However, before the interview, attested self-certified documents must be submitted to the Commission as per the detailed checklist in Annexure/Parishisht-01 of the notification.
  • For any query or complaint regarding online application filling: Helpline – 0755-6720220; Email – [email protected].

The official notification for the Indian Army Agniveer Vacancy 2026 has been released, announcing over 25,000+ (Expected) vacancies across various positions including GD, Tradesman, Technical, Soldier Pharma, and more.

Eligibility Criteria

Candidates Should Posses 12TH, 10TH, 8TH Pass 

Class 10th /Matric pass with 45% marks in aggregate of five basic subjects and min 33% marks in each of those five subjects. For boards following grading system, grades commensurate to percentages, as above, will be considered. Indian Gorkhas – Class 10th simple pass.

Note: Candidates who have appeared in class 10th Board Exam and are awaiting declaration of results are also eligible to apply provided they fulfill all other Qualification Required.  Age Limit

  • Maximum Age: 22 years
  • Candidates born between 01 Jul 2005 to 01 Jul 2009 (both days inclusive) are eligible to apply.

Age relaxation is applicable as per rules.

  • Upper Age limit will be relaxable upto 30 years of age (as on date of joining training) in respect of widows of Defence personnel who have died in harness.
  • Note: Women who are widowed, divorced or legally separated are also eligible provided they do not have any children subject to fulfilling all other eligibility criteria. Widows of Defence Personnel who have died in harness will be eligible to apply for enrolment as Women Military Police. Such widows even with children will be, however, eligible only if they have not remarried.

  • Chest Expansion: The candidate should be capable of chest expansion of 05 cms.

Special Physical Standards

Candidates belonging to following regions will be given 4 cms height relaxation:

  • North East Region: Sikkim, Nagaland, Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Tripura, Mizoram, Meghalaya and Assam.
  • Gorkhas.
  • Garhwalis.
  • Ladakher.
  • Tribals of recognized tribal areas.

Note: Domicile and Caste certificate will be considered to determine applicability of height relaxation.

Application Fee

  • Examination Fee: Rs 250/- per application for all categories.
  • Payment Mode: Online (through the website during application).

Important Dates

  • Starting Date for Apply Online: 13-02-2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 01-04-2026
  • Online Exam Dates: 01/06/2026 to 15/06/2026 (Tentative)
  • Firm dates for online exam will be announced later on the website.

Selection Process

  • Phase I - Online Common Entrance Exam (CEE): Conducted at Computer based test centres. This will be conducted for provisionally shortlisted candidates. Admission to the examination will be purely on the basis of Admit Card. The CEE will be conducted at designated centres tentatively between 01 Jun 2026 to 15 Jun 2026.
  • Phase II - Recruitment Rally: Proportionate to the vacancies available candidates would be shortlisted based on the aggregate marks scored in the CEE. Shortlisted candidates will attend the Recruitment Rally at designated venue where the Physical Fitness Test, Physical Measurement Test, Medical Test and Document Verification will be conducted.

Physical Fitness Test (PFT) (At Rally Site)

  • 1.6 Km Run
    • Group I: Upto 7 Min 45 Secs - Excellent
    • Group II: 7 Min 46 Sec to 8 Min 30 Sec - Good
  • Long Jump: 10 Feet (Need to qualify)
  • High Jump: 3 Feet (Need to qualify)

Note: Provisions for extra time for 1.6 Km run in hilly terrain and lower timing for Long Jump and High Jump in such cases.

Medical Standards

  • Candidates must be in good physical and mental health, free from any disability likely to interfere with efficient performance of duties.
  • Detailed medical examination as per Army standards.

Final Merit List

  • Final merit list will be based on aggregate of marks scored in CEE and performance in PFT (if applicable).
  • Recruitment is purely based on merit depending on available vacancies.

Note: Selection in the Indian Army is 'Fair & Transparent' and on merit only. At no stage any bribe is to be paid to anyone for selection or recruitment in the Indian Army. Candidates should not fall prey to unscrupulous persons posing as recruiting agents.

How to Apply

  1. Visit the official website: www.joinindianarmy.nic.in.
  2. If new user, complete the registration process by providing basic details and creating a login ID.
  3. Login using the credentials and fill the online application form carefully.
  4. Upload required documents, photographs, and signatures as per specifications.
  5. Pay the examination fee of Rs 250/- online.
  6. Submit the application and take a printout for future reference.

Note: Applications invited from domiciles of all districts of Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, UT of Chandigarh & Delhi. Any change in policy or details published in notification will be intimated on registered email/mobile number and with a ticker on the www.joinindianarmy.nic.in web portal.

Documents Required

Candidates must carry the following documents in original along with self-attested photocopies at the rally site (Phase II):

  • Admit Card.
  • 20 copies of passport size photographs.
  • Education Certificates (Marksheets, Degree, etc.).
  • Domicile Certificate.
  • Caste Certificate (if applicable for relaxation).
  • Religion Certificate (if required).
  • School Character Certificate.
  • Character Certificate from Village Sarpanch/Municipal Corporation.
  • Unmarried Certificate.
  • NCC Certificate (if applicable).

  • Affidavit on Rs 10 stamp paper as per format.
  • Single Bank A/C, PAN Card & AADHAR Card.
  • Police Verification Form.
  • Certificate from serving personnel for wards of serving soldiers (if applicable).
  • Any other relevant documents as specified in the notification.

Salary Structure

Agniveers will be paid a customized package with fixed yearly increment. In addition, Risk and Hardship, Ration, Dress and Travel allowances as applicable.

Vacancy Details: DHFWS ANM Recruitment 2026

This recruitment targets regional needs, with language proficiency (Tamil for Puducherry/Karaikal, Telugu for Mahe/Yanam) as a must. Total tentative vacancies: 36 for ANM (Level 4), broken down by region and reservation:

Region Total
Puducherry & Karaikal (Tamil) 36*

*Grand Total: 36 (subject to change). Reservations follow Puducherry norms; PwBD categories include low vision, hearing impairment, locomotor disabilities, etc. Refer to the PDF for inter-se exchanges.

Eligibility Criteria: DHFWS ANM Recruitment 2026

DHFWS ensures accessible criteria with relaxations for reserved groups—review these to confirm your fit.

Educational Qualification

Pass in 12th Std. (HSC) or equivalent, plus Diploma in Multipurpose Health Worker (Female)/Auxiliary Nurse Midwife from a recognized institution. Must hold permanent registration as a Midwife from any State Nursing Council in India. Regional language (Tamil/Telugu/Malayalam) studied up to SSLC level required.

Age Limit

18-30 years as of March 8, 2026. Relaxations: 3 years (MBC/OBC/EBC/BCM), 5 years (SC), military service +3 years (Ex-Servicemen), 10 years (PwBD, plus category relaxations), up to 35/40 years (widows/divorced/judicially separated women, General/SC).

Experience

No prior experience needed—open to freshers. Seniority marks (up to 15) awarded for Employment Exchange registration post-Diploma.

Nativity: Must be UT native/resident for 5+ years; fresh certificate required on selection.

Selection Process & Exam Pattern: DHFWS ANM Recruitment 2026

Merit-driven and transparent, with no written exam—focus on your academics and registration history.

Selection Process

  1. Merit List: Based on 50% HSC marks + 50% Diploma marks (deduct 5% per extra attempt) + up to 15 seniority marks (1.5/year from Diploma registration in Employment Exchange).
  2. Total Score: Out of 115 marks.
  3. Wait List: Valid 1 year for unfilled spots.
  4. Certificate Verification: For provisionally selected candidates.

Exam Pattern

No exam; purely marks-based computation. Ties resolved by: Diploma marks > HSC marks > Date of birth (older preferred) > Alphabetical order. Regional language knowledge verified for placement.

How to Apply Online: Step-by-Step Guide for DHFWS ANM Recruitment 2026

Online-only initial submission; follow promptly to meet the March 8 deadline.

  1. Visit https://recruitment.py.gov.in, register with mobile number for Username/Password via SMS.
  2. Log in, select ANM post, fill personal/educational/category details; change default password.
  3. Upload photo/signature: Option 1 (single A4 scan, 200 DPI, <150KB) or Option 2 (separate JPEGs: Photo 238x306px <50KB, Signature 350x150px <30KB). Recent photo essential.
  4. Preview form, submit—corrections allowed till March 8 (3 PM).
  5. Download acknowledgment; print and send hard copy with self-attested copies (Birth/SSLC/HSC/Diploma marks, Midwife registration, Employment Exchange card) to: The Director, DHFWS, Victor Simmonel Street, Old Maternity Hospital, Puducherry-605001 by March 11 (5 PM) via Speed Post/In-person. Superscribe "APPLICATION FOR RECRUITMENT TO THE POST OF ANM".

Income Tax Department Pune Young Professional Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates applying for Income Tax Department Pune Young Professional Recruitment 2026 must carefully check the detailed Young Professional eligibility criteria including age limit, educational qualification and preferred skills before submitting the application form.

Nationality: The applicant must be an Indian national to be eligible for Income Tax Department Pune Young Professional Recruitment 2026.

Age Limit: Candidates should not exceed 35 years of age as on the date of advertisement for Income Tax Young Professional 2026. Relaxation in upper age limit, if any, will be as per Government of India rules as applicable to the Income Tax Department.

Essential Educational Qualification: Candidates must possess a Graduate or Post Graduate degree in Law from recognized Universities, Colleges and Institutions of national or international repute and/or be a qualified Chartered Accountant for Income Tax Young Professional posts.

Minimum Marks Requirement: Candidates should have secured at least 50% marks in their 3-year LLB or 5-year integrated LLB degree programme or in their Post Graduation degree in Law, or must be a qualified Chartered Accountant with the prescribed professional qualification.

Preferred Qualification – Experience in Taxation: Chartered Accountants who have completed their articleship in taxation and Law graduates/Post graduates who have been engaged in research work or projects in taxation will be given preference for Income Tax Department Pune Young Professional Recruitment 2026.

Preferred Skills – ICT & Communication: Candidates having good skills in Information & Communication Technology (ICT) along with strong communication and interpersonal skills shall be preferred for the Young Professional position in Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT) Pune.

Other Conditions: The Young Professional engagement in Income Tax Department Pune is purely contractual for a period of one year, extendable by another year based on satisfactory performance, and selected candidates will have no right to claim regular employment in the department.

Income Tax Department Pune Young Professional Selection Process 2026

The Income Tax Department Pune Young Professional Recruitment 2026 selection process will be carried out in two stages as mentioned in the official notification.

Stage 1 – Screening: All applications received for Income Tax Young Professional Recruitment 2026 will first be scrutinized and screened based on eligibility criteria, educational qualification, experience in taxation and preferred skills. Only those candidates who satisfy the prescribed Young Professional eligibility conditions will be shortlisted for the next stage of the selection process.

Stage 2 – Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be called for a personal interview for Income Tax Department Pune Young Professional 2026. The intimation for interview will be sent to the candidates on their registered e-mail address and/or by speed post, and no TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.

Document Verification: At the time of interview, candidates must produce their bio-data and all original certificates in support of age, educational qualification, professional qualification, experience and other claims for verification, failing which they may be disqualified from Income Tax Young Professional selection 2026.

Final Selection: Final selection for Income Tax Department Pune Young Professional posts will be based on performance in the interview and overall profile, as per the decision of the competent authority of the Income Tax Department Pune.

Income Tax Department Pune Young Professional Salary 2026

Candidates appointed through Income Tax Department Pune Young Professional Recruitment 2026 will be engaged on a contractual remuneration basis as specified in the notice.

Monthly Remuneration: Selected Young Professionals will be paid a consolidated salary of Rs. 60,000/- per month (lump sum) during the period of engagement with the Income Tax Department Pune.

Contract Period: The Young Professional engagement will initially be for a period of one year, which may be extended by another year subject to satisfactory performance and requirement of the department.

No Regular Employment Claim: The Young Professional position is purely contractual in nature and does not confer any right on the candidate to claim regular employment or absorption in the Income Tax Department Pune in future.

The official Income Tax Department Pune Young Professional Recruitment 2026 notice does not mention any specific application fee for submitting the Young Professional application form.

Application Fee Status: Based on the information given in the notification, there is no application fee prescribed for candidates applying for Income Tax Department Pune Young Professional posts, and candidates can submit their applications free of cost.

Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Eligibility Criteria 2026

  • Candidates applying for Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Recruitment 2026 must ensure that they satisfy all the eligibility conditions related to age, educational qualification and apprenticeship norms as on the crucial date 15th April 2026.
  • Educational Qualification: Applicants must have a full-time Diploma in Engineering or Technology in the relevant branch (Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical or Electronics) granted by a State Council or Board of Technical Education, a recognized University, or an institute recognized by the State or Central Government as equivalent. Candidates who have completed their Diploma through regular (full-time) mode only are eligible for Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Training 2026.
  • Diploma Passing Date Condition: Candidates must have completed their Diploma in Engineering/Technology on or after 15th April 2021. Diploma holders who have completed their qualification before 15th April 2021 are not eligible for Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Recruitment 2026.
  • Age Limit: The minimum age limit to undergo Technician Apprenticeship Training at Ordnance Factory Bhandara is 14 years, and there is no upper age limit under the Apprentices Act. However, candidates between 14 to 18 years are minors and therefore cannot sign the apprenticeship contract themselves; their apprenticeship contracts must be signed by their guardians.
  • No Prior Training/Experience: Diploma holders who have undergone training or have job experience for a period of one year or more after attaining the Diploma qualification are not eligible to be engaged as Technician Apprentices under this Ordnance Factory Bhandara Apprentice Notification 2026.
  • Gap Limit Between Diploma and Training: A candidate is not eligible to undergo apprenticeship training if the gap between completion of Diploma and commencement of training is more than five years. Therefore, only candidates whose Diploma is completed within five years from the crucial date (i.e. on or after 15th April 2021) can apply for Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Recruitment 2026.
  • Graduates/Postgraduates Not Eligible: Candidates who have completed Graduate or Post Graduate qualifications after their Diploma (such as B.E./B.Tech or higher) are not eligible for Technician Apprentice Training at Ordnance Factory Bhandara.
  • Other Apprenticeship Conditions: Candidates who have already undergone Graduate or Technician Apprenticeship under the Apprentices Act and whose apprenticeship contract was terminated for any reason are not eligible to be engaged again without prior approval of the Apprenticeship Adviser. Sandwich course students will also not be eligible after passing their final examination unless specifically approved by the Regional Central Apprenticeship Adviser.

Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Salary (Stipend) 2026

  • Candidates selected through Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Recruitment 2026 will be engaged as Technician Apprentices for a fixed training period and will be paid a monthly stipend as per Apprentices Act provisions.
  • Stipend Amount: The stipend for Technician Apprentice (Diploma) at Ordnance Factory Bhandara is Rs. 10,900/- per month for the entire duration of the apprenticeship training.
  • Training Period: The period of Apprenticeship Training for Technician Apprentices is one year. During this period, apprentices will be governed by the Apprentices Act 1961 (as amended) and applicable rules of Board of Apprenticeship Training (BOAT), Western Region.
  • No Employment Guarantee: On completion of the one-year Apprenticeship Training, no employment in Ordnance Factory Bhandara is guaranteed. The apprenticeship is purely for training purposes and does not confer any right to regular job in the factory.

Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Application Form 2026

The offline application process for Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Recruitment 2026 has started, and the last date to submit the duly filled Technician Apprentice application form is 11th April 2026. Candidates who fulfil the eligibility criteria as on the crucial date 15th April 2026 must download and fill the prescribed Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Application Form 2026 and send it by post to the factory within the stipulated timeline.

Applicants have to send their completed Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice application form along with self‑attested copies of required documents to “The Chief General Manager, Ordnance Factory Bhandara (Unit of Munitions India Ltd.), At + Post – Jawaharnagar, Tah + Dist – Bhandara, Maharashtra – 441906”, superscribing the envelope with “Application for Technician Apprenticeship Training at O.F. Bhandara.” Incomplete, incorrect or belated applications reaching OF Bhandara after 11th April 2026 will be summarily rejected and will not be considered for Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Recruitment 2026.

Click to Apply for Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Recruitment 2026

Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Selection Process 2026

  • The Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Recruitment 2026 selection process is strictly merit-based and does not involve any written test or interview.
  • Merit List on Diploma Marks: Selection will be based on a merit list prepared from the marks obtained in the final year examination of the Diploma, taking the aggregate of all years/semesters into account. In case of CGPA/SGPA grading, candidates must attach appropriate conversion documents from their institute to calculate equivalent percentage; otherwise, their candidature will be disqualified.
  • No Test or Interview: There will be no written test or interview for selection of Technician Apprentices at Ordnance Factory Bhandara. Shortlisting is purely on the basis of Diploma marks and fulfilment of eligibility criteria.
  • Document Verification & Medical Examination: Candidates shortlisted from the merit list will be called for Document Verification, where their certificates, mark sheets, caste category, PwBD status and eligibility conditions will be thoroughly checked. After successful verification, they will have to undergo a Medical Examination and also furnish a Police Verification Report and Character Certificates from two Gazetted Officers as per notification.
  • Registration of Apprenticeship Contract: Selected candidates must enter into an apprenticeship contract with Ordnance Factory Bhandara, which will be registered with Board of Apprenticeship Training (BOAT), Western Region, Mumbai for the prescribed training period under the Apprentices Act 1961.

How to Apply for Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Recruitment 2026

  • Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria for Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Recruitment 2026 are required to apply only through the offline mode by submitting the prescribed application form by post.
  • Step 1 – Read the Apprentice Notification: Visit the official Munitions India Ltd/Ordnance Factory Bhandara website or obtain the advertisement and read the Technician Apprentice Notification 2026 carefully, noting eligibility conditions, crucial date (15 April 2026), closing date (11 April 2026) and list of documents to be attached.
  • Step 2 – Download and Print Application Form: Download the Application for Technician Apprenticeship Training form attached with the notification and take a clear printout. Ensure that the format and all fields remain as prescribed by Ordnance Factory Bhandara.
  • Step 3 – Fill Application Form Carefully: Fill in all details in block letters where required, including full name, father’s/husband’s name, gender, category (Technician Apprentice), trade (Diploma in Chemical/Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics Engineering), permanent and correspondence address, email ID, mobile number, date of birth, educational qualifications, percentage in Diploma, Diploma completion date, category (GEN/SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD), job/training experience and status of any higher qualification.
  • Step 4 – Prepare Supporting Documents: Attach self-attested copies of all required documents: Diploma certificate and consolidated final year mark sheet (both sides), Aadhaar card, age proof (preferably SSC certificate), Central caste certificate of SC/ST/OBC (NCL) with recent valid Non Creamy Layer certificate for OBC, PwBD certificate (if applicable), declaration/affidavit regarding no prior training and gap, and CGPA/SGPA to percentage conversion certificate from college/university (if applicable).
  • Step 5 – Prepare Envelope and Superscription: Place the filled application form and all enclosures in a suitable envelope and clearly superscribe on the envelope: “Application for Technician Apprenticeship Training in Ordnance Factory Bhandara.” This superscription is mandatory for proper identification of your application by the factory.
  • Step 6 – Send Application by Post: Send the envelope by post to “The Chief General Manager, Ordnance Factory Bhandara (Unit of Munitions India Ltd.), At + Post – Jawaharnagar, Tah + Dist – Bhandara, Maharashtra State, Pin – 441906.” Ensure that your application reaches the factory on or before 11th April 2026; applications received after this date for any reason, including postal delay, will not be entertained.
  • Step 7 – Keep Copies and Track Communication: Keep photocopies of the filled application and all attached documents for your own record. Regularly check your email ID and keep your mobile number active, as all further communication regarding shortlisting, document verification and joining for Ordnance Factory Bhandara Technician Apprentice Training 2026 will be sent via email only.
  • Step 8 – Affidavit and Certificates at Joining: At the time of document verification/joining, be prepared to submit the original declaration/affidavit regarding training gap, Police Clearance Certificate and two Character Certificates from Gazetted Officers in the prescribed format, along with all original documents for verification.

Eligibility criteria - South Central Railway Act Apprentice 2025-26

1) Educational qualification​

  • 10th class/SSC passed under 10+2 system with minimum 50% aggregate marks from a recognised board.

  • ITI certificate in the relevant notified trade from an institute recognised by NCVT/SCVT (trade-wise: AC Mechanic, Carpenter, COPA, Diesel Mechanic, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic, Fitter, Industrial Electronics, Machinist, MMTM, Motor Mechanic Vehicle, Painter, Welder).

  • Candidate must possess required qualification as on date of online application submission.

  • Engineering graduates and diploma holders are not eligible for this Act Apprentice notification (covered under separate scheme).

2) Age limit (as on 11.04.2026)​

  • Minimum age: 15 years.

  • Maximum age: 24 years.

Category-wise permissible date of birth range:

Category Date of birth between
UR / EWS 11-04-2002 and 11-04-2011
SC / ST 11-04-1997 and 11-04-2011
OBC-NCL 11-04-1999 and 11-04-2011
Ex-Servicemen / PwBD (UR) 11-04-1992 and 11-04-2011
Ex-Servicemen / PwBD (SC/ST) 11-04-1987 and 11-04-2011
Ex-Servicemen / PwBD (OBC) 11-04-1989 and 11-04-2011

Relaxations included in above ranges:

  • SC/ST: +5 years.

  • OBC-NCL: +3 years.

  • PwBD: +10 years.

  • Ex-Servicemen: +10 years up to length of service in Defence Forces (no extra relaxation for their children).

3) Residential / jurisdiction eligibility​
Candidates must reside in districts under South Central Railway jurisdiction and provide valid proof of residence. Eligible areas:

  • Telangana: all districts.

  • Andhra Pradesh: all districts except Manyam, Srikakulam, Vizianagaram.

  • Maharashtra: Akola, Amaravati, Aurangabad, Beed, Chandrapur, Hingoli, Jalna, Latur, Nanded, Nasik, Parbhani, Washim, Yavatmal.

  • Karnataka: Balki, Bellari, Belgaum, Bidar, Gulbarga/Kalaburgi, Raichur, Yadgir.

  • Tamil Nadu: Vellore.

  • Madhya Pradesh: Burhanpur, Khandwa.

4) Category certificates (for reservation)​

  • SC/ST: Central Government format caste certificate (Annexure-B).

  • OBC-NCL: caste + NCL certificate (issued within 3 years) in Central format (Annexure-C) + self-declaration (Annexure-D).

  • EWS: valid Income & Asset certificate (Annexure-E).

  • PwBD: disability ≥40% in prescribed format (Annexure-G/H).

5) Salary/Stipend

  • Selected candidates will be paid a stipend during the apprenticeship at the prescribed rates as per extant instructions.

SCR Apprentice Selection Process 2025-26

  • Merit List Basis: Selection for SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 will be done purely on merit, by taking the average of percentage marks in 10th (minimum 50% aggregate) and ITI marks, giving equal weightage to both.
  • No Exam / Interview: There will be no written test or viva-voce for South Central Railway Apprentice Recruitment 2025-26.
  • Tie-breaking: If two candidates have the same aggregate percentage, older candidate (higher age) will be preferred; if DOB is also same, the candidate who passed Matriculation earlier will be preferred.
  • Document Verification (DV): Shortlisted candidates will be called for DV where all original certificates (education, ITI, caste, EWS, PwBD, ExSM, RDAT registration, medical fitness) will be verified.
  • Medical Fitness: Candidates must produce medical fitness certificate from a government-authorised doctor (Gazetted, not below Asst. Surgeon) in prescribed format at DV; without this, they will not be considered.
  • Training & Stipend: Selected candidates will undergo apprenticeship training as per Central Apprenticeship Council syllabus and receive stipend at prescribed rates during training.
  • No Job Guarantee: SCR apprenticeship 2025-26 provides training only; there is no guarantee of regular railway job after completion of apprenticeship.

South Central Railway Apprentice Application Form 2026

  • Application Mode: Online only via RRC/SCR portal; no offline forms will be accepted.
  • Application Dates: SCR Apprentice online form 2026 is available from 12 March 2026 (17:00 hrs) to 11 April 2026 (23:59 hrs).
  • Fee: ₹100 for applicable categories; SC/ST, female/Transgender and PwBD candidates are exempt from fee payment.
  • Multiple Trades: Candidates with ITI in more than one trade can submit separate SCR Apprentice application 2026 for each trade.
  • Communication: All updates regarding SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 application form, merit list and DV will be sent via registered email/SMS and uploaded on RRC-SCR webpage only.

How to Apply for South Central Railway Apprentice Recruitment 2025-26

  1. Visit the official South Central Railway website: https://scr.indianrailways.gov.in and go to About Us → RRC-SCR to open the ONLINE ACT APPRENTICE APPLICATION link.
  2. Read the detailed SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 notification carefully and ensure you belong to the eligible states/districts and possess required 10th + ITI qualification.
  3. Complete Registration: select state and district, upload address proof, enter valid mobile number and email ID, create a password and verify OTPs sent to mobile and email.
  4. Login as a registered candidate and fill in personal details (name, DOB, category, etc.) and educational/technical details (10th marks, ITI trade, ITI marks, RDAT registration number).
  5. Select your priority/preference of training units (Divisions/Workshops/Sheds) only for trades you are eligible for; options once submitted cannot be changed.
  6. Upload a recent colour photograph (JPEG, ≤1 MB, not older than 3 months), signature image (≤1 MB) and required certificates (10th, ITI, RDAT form, caste, EWS, PwBD, ExSM, medical certificate) in PDF format (≤2 MB).
  7. Ensure you have completed RDAT/NAPS registration at www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in and obtained registration number before filling the SCR apprentice application.
  8. Check all details in the Preview page carefully; after clicking Submit, no modification will be allowed.
  9. Pay the application fee (if applicable) through online payment gateway (Net Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI) and generate e-receipt.
  10. Download/print the final submitted SCR Apprentice application form 2026 and keep it along with fee receipt and uploaded documents for Document Verification.

HEF Khadki Selection Process 2026

For Supervisory Staff (Graduate Project Engineer):

  • Selection based on Marks scored in B.E./B.Tech and Personal Interaction/Interview only, in order of Merit.
  • Weightage: B.E./B.Tech marks – 85%; Personal Interaction/Interview – 15%.
  • Cut-off percentage for calling candidates for interview may be decided by HEF based on marks in qualifying examination to ensure sufficient competition.
  • Merit list prepared on combined marks of B.E./B.Tech and Personal Interaction/Interview.
  • Candidates scoring more than cut-off marks will be called for Document Verification in order of merit; number limited to posts notified (Discipline/Category wise).
  • Candidates qualifying Document Verification will be issued Offers of Engagement.

For Skilled Worker (AOCP – CPW):

  • Selection based on Marks scored in NCVT and Trade Test/Practical Test only, in order of Merit.
  • Weightage: NCVT Exam – 80%; Trade Test/Practical Test – 20%.
  • Cut-off for Trade Test/Practical Test decided by HEF based on total marks in NCVT.
  • Merit list prepared on combined marks in NCVT Exam and Trade Test/Practical Test.
  • Candidates with AOCP Trade (NCVT) will be given preference; candidates from feeder trades considered only if requisite number of AOCP candidates not available.
  • AOCP Trade Apprentices from Government/Private organisations will be given compulsory "ONE MONTH" extensive in-house training on Safe Handling of Explosives, ammunition, safety norms, DOs & DON'Ts, etc. After successful completion, two months On-Job training will be imparted, after which they will be considered for specific job deployment.
  • On successful completion of training, a Certificate will be issued acceptable in all MIL Group of Factories.

  • Remuneration at 1/30th of Basic Pay + Dearness Allowance for 8 hours work per day.
  • IDA as prevalent will be applicable.
  • House Rent Allowance as per classification of cities (when Company Quarter is not available). Priority for Company Quarters where available.
  • 30 days leave per year (2.5 days per calendar month of service); can be accumulated up to 30 days and encashed after completion of one year.
  • Eligible for EPF and Employees Compensation Act as per government guidelines.
  • Bonus (as applicable) as per Bonus Act 1965.
  • Night Duty Allowance at par with regular employees (for Night Shift due to production exigency).
  • Risk Allowance at par with regular employees as per extant rules.
  • Safety and protective gear, equipment, kits as per Company norms.
  • Maternity Benefits for female personnel as per Maternity Benefit Act, 1961.
  • Company Quarters eligibility (wherever available); license fee deducted at rates applicable to regular employees.

NOT entitled for: Promotions, OT allowance, Loans/Advances/Interest Subsidies, Medical Facilities, Contingency Advance, School Fee Reimbursement, LTC/LTA Facilities, Grant of Study Leave, Sponsorship for Higher Studies, or any other benefits admissible to regular employees.

Terms & Conditions of Tenure Engagement

  • Engagement on contract basis initially for One Year; extendable for another Three Years (total maximum Four Years) with yearly renewal based on factory requirement and individual performance.
  • Tenure ends automatically on completion of four years from date of joining, without any further notice.
  • Employment can be terminated at any time during tenure by giving one month's notice by either side or payment of Basic Pay + IDA Component in lieu of Notice.
  • No commitment to the candidate either for absorption as permanent employee or for extension of term.
  • Performance assessed on a six-monthly basis; poor performance will result in written notice to improve; repeated poor rating may lead to termination.
  • Full-time basis; absence other than authorized leave/Company Holidays will result in proportionate reduction in Consolidated Emoluments.
  • For quitting the job, candidate must give one month prior notice in advance, failing which one month salary will be deducted.
  • Tenure Based Personnel will abide by various Company/Factory Rules & Regulations governing the assigned tasks and conduct.
  • Personnel covered under Income Tax, Service Tax, Professional Tax as per applicable rules; all such taxes payable by candidates.

  • M.Sc. / Integrated M.Sc. / B.S-M.S. (Dual degree) / B.S. (with fourth year Research) in Chemistry (General/Applied/Organic/Inorganic/Physical/Analytical) with Physics as ancillary subject at B.Sc. level and Mathematics at H.Sc. level is eligible, subject to passing marks in these subjects.
  • M.Sc. / Integrated M.Sc. / B.S-M.S. (Dual degree) / B.S. (with fourth year Research) in Life Sciences disciplines (including Life Science, Botany, Zoology, Agriculture, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Marine Biology, Bioinformatics, Genetics, Plant Science, Plant Breeding, Plant Pathology, Entomology, Animal Science, Biomedical Sciences, Biosciences, Food Science, Food Science and Technology) with Physics or Chemistry or Biochemistry or Agriculture Chemistry or allied Chemistry as one of the subjects at B.Sc./five-year integrated M.Sc. level is eligible.
  • Candidates with specializations listed as not eligible in Physics, Chemistry and Life Sciences (such as Electronics and Instrumentation, Industrial Chemistry, Polymer Chemistry, Textile Chemistry, Environmental Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Petroleum Chemistry, Nanoscience, Nanotechnology, Fisheries, Horticulture, Forestry, Agronomy, Animal Husbandry, Bio-analytical Sciences, Polymer Science, Medicine/Medical Science, Pharmaceutical Science, Home Science, and B.Tech./M.Tech. in Life Sciences disciplines) are not eligible.
  • All academic requirements for the qualifying degree must be completed before 10-08-2026, and relevant proof must be produced at joining.

Salary/Stipend

  • Selected candidates will initially be considered as Junior Research Fellows (JRF) and will be paid a stipend of ₹37,000/- per month for a period of two years.
  • On satisfactory performance and review, the fellowship will be upgraded to Senior Research Fellowship (SRF) from the third year onwards with a stipend of ₹42,000/- per month (consolidated).
  • The total duration of the fellowship is five years.
  • Candidates are entitled to a contingency grant including book allowance of ₹60,000/- per year.
  • Financial assistance to attend one International Conference abroad during the PhD Programme may be provided, subject to conditions updated by HBNI.

Age Limit 

  • The candidate should be less than 28 years of age as on 01-08-2026.
  • Age relaxation is applicable up to 3 years for Other Backward Class Non-Creamy Layer (OBC-NCL) applicants.
  • Age relaxation is applicable up to 5 years for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe applicants.
  • Additional 10 years of age relaxation is applicable for persons with benchmark disabilities (PwBD) applicants.
  • Age, qualification, community status and creamy layer status will be reckoned as on 01-08-2026 for submission of online application.

Application Fee

  • Application fee of ₹500/- is payable at the time of submission of online application.
  • Mode of payment of the application fee is online only, using net banking, debit card, credit card, UPI, etc.
  • Application fee is exempted for Women candidates and candidates belonging to Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe and Person with Benchmark Disabilities.
  • After submission of the online application, the applicant has to make online payment of application fee using the Application Number generated; applications without fee payment will be treated as incomplete and rejected.
  • Candidates must use the ‘Make Payment’ option under the ‘My Account’ menu to pay the fee, selecting the generated application number from the drop-down list.
  • Detailed guidelines for payment of application fee are available under the menu “How to pay Application fee.”
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances and cannot be held in reserve for any other recruitment.
  • Application fee should be paid on or before the last date of receipt of online application.

Important Dates

Event Date
Receipt of applications (Start date) 10/03/2026
Receipt of applications (Last date) 31/03/2026
Interview (tentative dates) June-July 2026

Selection Process

  • Applications will be scrutinized and candidates will be screened in for interview based on eligibility as per the national level exam and their score in the qualifying exam.
  • The number of candidates to be called for interview will be decided by the Selection Committee.
  • Final selection will be based on the performance of the candidate in the selection interview only.
  • Allotment of research project will be on the basis of performance in the selection interview; in case of a tie, marks obtained in M.Sc./B.Sc. will be considered.
  • The recommendation/decision of the Selection Committee will be final and binding.

How to Apply

  • Facility for submission of online application will be available from 10/03/2026 to 31/03/2026 at the specified application portal.
  • Applications will be accepted online only and candidates should not submit multiple applications.
  • Candidates must read the instructions in the advertisement and online application form carefully before making any entry or selecting any option, and keep necessary documents/certificates ready.
  • All Educational and Professional Qualifications must be indicated under the ‘Educational & Professional Qualifications’ column; otherwise, the application will not be processed.
  • Candidates “pursuing” relevant degrees must choose the correct option from the ‘Name of Examination’ drop-down box, while those who have completed the degree must choose the appropriate completed option.
  • A valid e-mail ID and mobile number are mandatory, and the email ID must remain active till declaration of results; call letters or instructions may be sent by email or made available on the website.
  • Photo and signature must be clearly visible in preview; a recent front-facing passport size photograph in JPEG format of size not exceeding 50 KB must be uploaded, otherwise the application will be rejected.
  • Candidates must upload SSC/H.Sc./B.Sc./M.Sc./Integrated M.Sc./B.S-M.S. (Dual degree)/B.S. (with fourth year Research) mark sheets and Degree Certificates, valid Qualifying Examination Score Card and Caste Certificate (if applicable); applications without these attachments will be disqualified.
  • Before final submission, candidates should verify that all details, including name and date of birth, are correct as per SSC; no change or correction will be allowed after final submission.
  • If original educational documents have been submitted to another institution, copies may be uploaded and a letter from the Head of that institution must be produced at the time of interview.
  • In case of any difficulty in applying online or uploading documents, candidates should email complaints with screenshots to the specified email address given in the notification.

Odisha Staff Selection Commission (OSSC) Civil Defence Instructor / Senior Store Inspector Notification 2026 (Post Code 389) has been issued for Group-B posts under Level-9, Cell-01 of the ORSP Rules, 2017. A total of 7 vacancies have been announced for the Civil Defence Instructor / Senior Store Inspector post, with pay as per Level-9 of the Odisha 7th Pay Commission pay matrix.

Kendriya Vidyalaya Rourkela Part Time Contractual Teachers Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

  • Primary Teacher (PRT): Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks and 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed.) / Certified Teacher's Training (CT) /4 year-Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.) / 2-year Diploma in Education (Special Education) /equivalent OR Graduation with at least 50% marks and Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.). Qualified in the Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET-I). Proficiency to teach through Hindi & English media.
  • Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT): Four years' Integrated degree course of Regional College of Education of NCERT in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks in aggregate ; OR Bachelor's Degree with at least 50% marks in the concerned subjects/ combination of subjects and in aggregate. Specific subject combinations apply. B.Ed. or equivalent degree. Pass in the Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET-II). Proficiency in teaching Hindi and English medium.
  • Post Graduate Teacher (PGT): Two years' Integrated Post Graduate M.Sc. Course of Regional College of Education of NCERT in the concerned subject; Or Master Degree from a recognized University with at least 50% marks in aggregate. B.Ed. or equivalent degree. Proficiency in teaching in Hindi and English media.
  • Computer Instructor: B.E./B.Tech. (Computer Science)/B.C.A./M.C.A./M.Sc. (Computer Science) /M.Sc.(Electronic with Computer Science component)/M.Sc.(IT)/B.Sc.(Computer Science). OR Bachelor's/Master degree in any Science subject/Mathematics from recognized University with Postgraduate Diploma in Computer application. OR Post-graduate degree in any subject with Postgraduate Diploma in Computer application. OR Post-graduate degree in any subject with minimum 'A' level form DOEACC.
  • Guidance Counselor: B.A./B.Sc.(Psychology) with certificate of Diploma in Counseling. Minimum of One Year Experience in Providing Career/Educational Counseling to students at Schools. OR Working knowledge and experience in Placement Bureaus OR Registration with rehabilitation Council of India as Vocational Course.
  • Yoga Instructor: Graduate in any subject or equivalent from a recognized University. One year training in Yoga from a recognized Institution.
  • Odia Teacher: Graduation with at least 50% marks in Odia and aggregate +B.Ed. Odia should be studied as a subject in all the three years of graduation.

  • Sports Coach: Bachelor Degree in Physical Education (B.P.Ed.) or equivalent OR Distinguished sportsmen who have represented the Country in the recognized National or International events.
  • Vocational Instructor (ATL): B.E., B.Tech Electronic & Communication Engineering.
  • Special Educator: 12th passed and 2 years D.Ed. Special Education in any of the cat. of disability OR 12th passed and 1-year diploma in special education (DSE) in any of the category of disability. OR Graduate with B. Ed. (Special education).
  • Dance Coach: Diploma in Music/Dance. Experience in Classical, Vocal Music, Classical Coach and Folk Dance and participation in the State Level/National Level.

Eligibility Criteria

Jr. Overman, T&S Gr-C – Essential Qualifications:

  • Valid Gas Testing Certificate.

Mining Sirdar, T&S Gr-C – Essential Qualifications:

  • Senior Secondary school examination or intermediate examination (10+2) or equivalent Examination from any recognized Board of Examination OR Diploma in Mining Engineering of 03 years duration or Degree in Mining Engineering or other equivalent qualifications approved in that behalf by the Central Government from any recognized Institute.
  • Valid Mining Sirdarship Certificate of Competency (Un-Restricted) from DGMS under Coal Mines Regulation 2017 for working in both Open Cast (OC) & Under Ground (UG) Mines or any other certificate of Competency in Mining which entitle the applicant to work as Mining Sirdar as per Coal Mines Regulation 2017 for working in both OC & UG Mines.
  • Valid First Aid Certificate.
  • Valid Gas Testing Certificate.

Surveyor, T&S Gr-B – Essential Qualifications:

  • Senior Secondary school examination or intermediate examination (10+2) or equivalent Examination from any recognized Board of Examination OR Diploma in Mining/Mine Surveying Engineering of 03 years duration or Degree in Mining/Mine Surveying Engineering or other equivalent qualifications approved in that behalf by the Central Government from any recognized Institute.
  • Valid Survey Certificate of Competency (Un-Restricted) granted by Directorate General of Mines Safety (DGMS) as per Coal Mines Regulation 2017 for working in both Open Cast (OC) & Under Ground (UG) Mines.

Translator (Tr.) OL Clerical Gr. III – Essential Qualifications:

  • B.A. or equivalent with Hindi & English.
  • Govt. Diploma Holder in Hindi Translation preferred.

Selection Process

  • The Selection methodology will comprise of Computer Based Test (CBT) only. No personal interview will be held.
  • Eligible Candidates, as declared by them, will be provisionally called for Computer Based Test (CBT) on the basis of their declaration regarding their eligibility such as age, educational/technical qualification, Valid Statutory Certificate etc. as laid down in this notification/advertisement.
  • The CBT will comprise of objective type questions with multiple choice of answers and there will be no negative marking for wrong answers. The instructions will be Bilingual (English/Hindi).
  • The CBT will consist of two sections i.e. "A" & "B". Section "A" will comprise question specific to General Awareness/Aptitude and will comprise 20 questions of "One" mark each. Section "B" of the test paper will comprise questions relating to Technical knowledge and will comprise 80 questions of "One" mark each, with a total of 100 marks.
  • Qualifying marks (CBT): General/EWS candidates – 45 marks (i.e. 45% of 100); OBC(NCL) candidates – 40 Marks (i.e. 40% of 100); SC/ST candidates – 35 marks (35% of 100).
  • Based on the merit order of marks secured by the candidates in CBT, the shortlisted qualified candidates in the ratio of 1:3 will be called for document verification.
  • In case of a tie of marks obtained in the CBT, it will be resolved on the basis of Date of Birth (elder one being the first) and thereafter Name alphabets.
  • Successful shortlisted candidates will be notified to appear for scrutiny of their testimonials through the website of MCL. Candidates shall have to appear along with all original certificates/documents & photocopies thereof as per eligibility criteria notified in this advertisement.
  • Those who are working in Govt./Semi Govt./Autonomous Bodies/PSUs/CIL & Subsidiaries etc. must have to produce "No Objection Certificate" from their employer at the time of documents/certificates verification.
  • After verification of documents/certificates, 'Provisional Select List' of successful candidates will be published in the official website of MCL (https://mahanadicoal.in).
  • Finally, provisionally selected candidates will be issued offer of appointment based on their position in the merit list and with due consideration of the reservation policy of Govt. of India for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD/EWS/ESM. They have to undergo Initial Medical Examination (IME) by company's own doctors & their findings thereon will be final. Those who are found UNFIT, will be disqualified for employment.
  • The validity of the merit panel will be for 01 year or as per extant Govt. guidelines.
  • Exact schedule of CBT will be displayed on MCL website (https://mahanadicoal.in) in due course.

How to Apply

  • The candidates shall apply through online mode available on MCL website https://mahanadicoal.in only under CAREERS >>>> Recruitment section as per the qualification and eligibility criteria indicated above. No other means/mode of application will be accepted.
  • Before filling-up of the online application, keep the following details/documents/information ready: E-Mail ID, Mobile No., Personal and Educational qualification details, Scanned Copy of Matriculation (X) Certificate/Mark sheets/diploma/degree Mark sheets (in Jpg/Jpeg/PDF format), Scanned Copy of valid Caste Certificate for OBC (NCL)/SC/ST candidates and Income Certificates for EWS candidates (if Applicable), Scanned Copy of Ex-Servicemen Certificates (if Applicable), Scanned Copy of PwBD Certificates (if Applicable), Scanned Copy of competency certificate of Mining Sirdar/Overman/Surveyor, Gas testing & First Aid certificate (in Jpg/Jpeg/PDF format), Details of Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking for making application fee, Scanned Copy of candidates' Recent Photograph (not more than 3 weeks old in jpg/jpeg format), Scanned Copy of candidates' Signature with Black ink pen (in jpg/jpeg format).
  • Read Important Instructions and Click on (√) 'I Agree' Button.
  • Register by filling up necessary details (Post opted, name, Mobile No. and e-mail ID and click on Submit Button).
  • Check Application Sequence No., User ID & Password received on your e-mail and mobile number.
  • Re-login to your account by entering User ID and password received through e-mail.
  • Click on the option to go to Application Form and fill all the necessary details in the respective field and upload documents, Photo and Signature.
  • Check Preview of the Application Form and make corrections, if any.
  • Press Submit Button.
  • Make Online payment through Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking (as applicable).
  • Take Print out of application form for future record.
  • The last date for submission of application is 06/Apr/2026 up to 11:50 PM.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification: Bachelor's Degree or equivalent degree in any discipline from a recognized University / Institution / Board.

    • Candidates possessing academic qualifications from Universities / Institutions / Councils / Boards outside Odisha must produce proof of equivalence from any recognized University / Institution / Council / Board of the State of Odisha, and affiliation of the institution to a recognized University/Council/Board.
    • Candidates furnishing certificates and mark-sheets with grades / grade-points must furnish numerical equivalence from the examining body, failing which they shall not be considered eligible.
    • Government servants having requisite educational qualification and within the prescribed age limit, whether temporary or permanent, are eligible to apply, provided they inform their respective head of office in writing and produce a "No Objection Certificate" from the employer before the date of document verification.

Salary / Stipend

  • Pay Scale for all posts (Junior Assistant & Junior Clerk): Group-C, Level-4, Cell-1
  • Junior Assistants in Government Degree Colleges, NCC, and BSE are posted as Government employees.
  • Junior Assistants in State Public Universities and OUHS are posted in Autonomous Body status.
  • Junior Clerks in Non-Govt. Aided Colleges are posted under Non-Govt. Aided Colleges status.
  • Note: HRA, encashment of unutilized leave, and a few other incentives are not available to Non-Govt. Aided Colleges employees.
  • All persons appointed shall not be eligible for pension as defined under Odisha Civil Service (Pension) Rules, 1992; but shall be covered by the defined Contributory Pension Scheme in accordance with the Odisha Civil Service (Pension) Amendment Rules, 2005.

 Age Limit (as on 01-01-2026)

  • Minimum Age: 21 Years
  • Maximum Age: 42 Years (candidate must have been born not earlier than 1st January 1984 and not later than 1st January 2005)
  • SC / ST / SEBC / Women / Ex-Servicemen: Upper age relaxable by 5 years (up to 47 years)
  • PwD candidates (permanent disability of 40% and above): Upper age relaxable by 10 years
  • PwD belonging to SEBC/SC/ST categories: Cumulative age relaxation of 15 years
  • A candidate coming under more than one category shall be eligible for only one benefit of relaxation, which shall be considered most beneficial to him/her.
  • PwD category with temporary disability will not avail age relaxation and will not be considered for subsequent selection processes.
  • Date of Birth mentioned in the High School Certificate or equivalent certificate issued by the concerned Board / Council will only be accepted as age proof.

Application Fee

  • Unreserved (UR) / SEBC Category: Rs. 500/- (Rupees Five Hundred only) – Non-refundable and non-adjustable
  • Scheduled Tribe (ST) / Scheduled Caste (SC) / PwD Category: Rs. 200/- (Rupees Two Hundred only) – Non-refundable and non-adjustable
  • Mode of Payment: Online through SB Collect only. The link for SB Collect payment gateway is available in the online application form. Any other mode of payment will not be accepted under any circumstances.
  • Bank Account Details of SSB for Payment:
    Account No: 35396835756, State Bank of India, Govt. Treasury Branch, Bhubaneswar
    IFS Code: SBIN0009025
  • In case of non-payment of examination fee / application fee, the application form will be rejected.
  • After successful payment, the candidate will be able to download the application form from the SSB website after 48 hours.

Important Dates

Event Date & Time

Opening Date & Time of Online Application 11/03/2026 at 02:30 PM
Closing Date & Time of Online Applications & Online Payment 13/04/2026 at 11:45 PM
Age Reckoning Date 01/01/2026
Written Test Date To be announced
Computer Skill Test Date To be announced (held at Bhubaneswar)
Document Verification Date To be announced

Selection Process

  • Selection will be based on performance in Written Test and Computer Skill Test – Total 250 Marks.
  • Written Test: 200 Marks (100 Questions, Multiple Choice type, answered on carbonless OMR Answer Sheets, duration: 2 hours)
    • General English up to Graduation Level – 60 Marks
    • General Knowledge and Current Affairs – 40 Marks
    • General Mathematics up to HSC Standard – 40 Marks
    • Reasoning & Mental Ability – 60 Marks
  • Computer Skill Test: 50 Marks (1 hour duration; minimum qualifying mark: 20 marks for all categories)
  • For each correct answer, 2 marks will be awarded; for each wrong answer, negative marking of 0.50 mark.
  • Qualifying marks in Written Examination: 40% for Unreserved category candidates; 30% for SC/ST/SEBC & PwD categories.
  • On the basis of the Written Test performance, candidates will be shortlisted two times the vacancy (category-wise & sub-category-wise for PwD) for the Computer Skill Test.
  • Candidates who qualify both the Written Test and Computer Skill Test shall be called for Document Verification at the SSB office.
  • For final selection, the marks secured in the Written Test and Computer Skill Test taken together shall be considered for candidates who have successfully completed the document verification process.
  • In case of a tie after the Written Test (for shortlisting for Computer Skill Test), merit position will be decided based on aggregate percentage of marks in Bachelor's Degree (up to 2 decimal). A further tie will be resolved by date of birth (earlier born preferred).
  • The final merit list will be prepared as per vacancy of the posts advertised category-wise and sub-category-wise.
  • SSB will prepare the final merit list and submit it to HED for counselling of university-wise Junior Assistants, Govt. Colleges, NCC, and district-wise Junior Clerk in Non-Government Aided Colleges.
  • Zone of Examination: Written Test will be held at 5 zones – Balasore, Berhampur, Bhubaneswar, Jeypore, and Sambalpur (depending on number of candidates per zone).
  • Computer Skill Test and Document Verification will be conducted at Bhubaneswar.
  • Scribe facility and compensatory time shall be allowed to PwD candidates having 40% or above permanent disability. The PwD candidate must arrange their own scribe and provide scribe information in the prescribed format available on the SSB website.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must apply online through the link available on the official website of State Selection Board, Odisha: www.ssbodisha.ac.in
  • Read the detailed INSTRUCTIONS carefully before filling up the Online Application Form.
  • Enter the percentage of aggregate marks secured in Under-graduate (+3) degree, converting CGPA as per the conversion formula of the respective degree-awarding University/Institution.
  • Upload the latest passport size photograph (taken within fifteen days before the submission of application), scanned image of full signature, and left-hand thumb impression – all must be clearly identifiable/visible. Failure to do so will result in rejection of application.
  • Deposit the requisite application fee online through SB Collect only. In case of non-payment, the application form will be rejected. Ensure the Application ID No. allotted to you is entered correctly during payment.
  • After successful payment, the candidate can download the application form from the SSB website after 48 hours. Keep this form for future reference and during document verification.
  • Candidates are advised to submit the online application form well within the timeline without waiting for the closing date to avoid last-hour rush.
  • There is no edit option after final submission of the online application form. Candidates are advised to be very careful while filling up the form.
  • Application window: 11.03.2026 (02:30 PM) to 13.04.2026 (11:45 PM).

OPSC Dental Surgeon 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Nationality

The candidate must be a citizen of India.

Educational Qualification

  • Must possess a BDS or equivalent Degree from a Medical College or Medical Institution recognized by the Dental Council of India (DCI).
  • Must possess a valid Registration Certificate under the Dentist Act, 1948.
  • Candidates having degrees from foreign universities must possess required Conversion Certificates recognized by DCI.

Additional Requirements

  • Houseman-ship/Internship Completion Certificate
  • Certificate relating to passing of the screening test conducted by the National Board of Examinations (for candidates from foreign universities)
  • Odia language test pass certificate, or must pass the required Odia examination within 4 years of joining service

Odia Language Requirement

Candidate must be able to read, write, and speak Odia and must have fulfilled any one of the following:

  • Passed Middle School Examination in Odia as a language subject; OR
  • Passed Matriculation or equivalent examination with Odia as medium of examination in non-language subject; OR
  • Passed in Odia as language subject in the final examination of Class-VII or above; OR
  • Passed a test in Odia in Middle English School standard conducted by the School and Mass Education Department.

Proviso: If a candidate has not passed Middle School Examination in Odia as a language subject, he/she shall be required to pass the examination conducted by the Board of Secondary Education, Odisha within 4 years of joining service. Failing this, no further increment will be sanctioned and promotion to Group-A (Senior Branch) will not be allowed.

OPSC Dental Surgeon 2026 Age Limit (as on 01 January 2026)

  • Minimum Age: 21 years
  • Maximum Age: 42 years
  • Candidate must not have been born earlier than 02 January 1984 and not later than 01 January 2005.

Age Relaxation

  • Exception: PwBD candidates belonging to SEBC/SC/ST categories shall be eligible for 15 years cumulative age relaxation.
  • Date of birth in High School Certificate or equivalent certificate issued by the concerned Board/Council will only be accepted.
  • Save as provided above, the age limits prescribed can in no case be relaxed.

Selected candidates will be appointed in Level-12, Cell-1 of the Odisha Revised Scales of Pay (ORSP) Rules, 2017 and will also be entitled to Dearness Allowance (DA) and other admissible allowances as sanctioned by the Government from time to time.

The selection shall be made on the basis of a Written Test as per the Odisha Medical Services (Method of Recruitment and Conditions of Service of Dental Surgeons) Rules, 2022 along with Amendment Rules, 2025.

Total Marks 200
Total Questions 200
Question Type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQ)

Marking Scheme +1 mark for correct answer and -0.25 mark for wrong answer
Syllabus As per Dental Council of India (DCI) Syllabus for BDS
Qualifying Marks Will be decided by OPSC
Exam Date 21 June 2026 (Sunday) – Tentative

Merit List Preparation

  • The Commission shall prepare a list of candidates in order of merit on the basis of the Written Test equal to the number of advertised vacancies.
  • If two or more candidates secure equal marks, the candidate securing higher marks in the BDS Examination will rank higher.
  • If marks in the BDS Examination are also equal, the candidate older in age will be placed above the younger candidate.
  • The recommendation list shall remain valid for one year from the date of recommendation or till the next recruitment is made by the Commission.
  • A Sports Person must secure the qualifying marks of his/her category for inclusion in the merit list.

Eligibility criteria - BFUHS Food Safety Officer Recruitment 2026

1) Educational qualification​

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s or Doctorate degree in any of the following (or equivalent notified by Central Government/FSSAI): Food Technology, Dairy Technology, Biotechnology, Oil Technology, Agricultural Science, Veterinary Sciences, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Chemistry or Medicine.

  • Additionally, other disciplines recognised by FSSAI for Food Safety Officer, including MBBS, BDS, BAMS, BHMS, BUMS, BSMS, BSRC and degrees listed under “Food Technology” and “Agricultural Science” in FSSAI notifications (e.g. Food Engineering, Food Processing & Preservation, Food Safety & Quality Management, Agriculture, Dairy Technology, Horticulture, etc.).​

  • Candidate must successfully complete FSSAI‑specified training at a recognised institute after recruitment, before being notified as Food Safety Officer under Section 37 of FSS Act, 2006.​

  • Candidates having any financial interest in manufacture, import or sale of any article of food are not eligible to be appointed as FSO.​

2) Punjabi language requirement​

  • Must have passed Matriculation with Punjabi as a compulsory or elective subject OR any equivalent exam in Punjabi language as specified by Punjab Government.

  • For Group‑C posts, must also pass a qualifying Punjabi Language test equivalent to Matric level with at least 50% marks, conducted by the recruitment agency in addition to the competitive exam; failing this disqualifies the candidate from final merit list.​

  • Certain war‑hero/defence‑personnel categories have relaxed Punjabi requirement as per Punjab Govt rules.​

3) Age limit (as on 31.12.2025)​

  • General age limit: 18 to 37 years.

  • Relaxations:

    • SC/BC: +5 years.

    • Persons with Disabilities: +10 years.

    • Ex‑Servicemen: deduct full service in Armed Forces from actual age; if resultant age does not exceed upper age limit by more than 3 years, considered within age limit.

    • Punjab Govt/Boards/Corporations/Commissions/Authorities employees & all State/Central Govt employees: upper age relaxable up to 45 years.

    • Widows, divorcees and certain other categories of married women: upper age relaxable up to 40 years as per letter No. 1/50/83-5PP(1368)-3454 dated 23.04.1984.​

4) Nationality​

  • Citizen of India, or

  • Citizen of Nepal, or

  • Subject of Bhutan, or

  • Tibetan refugee who came to India before 01.01.1962 to settle permanently, or

  • Person of Indian origin migrated from specified countries (Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, several East African countries, Ethiopia, Vietnam) with intention of permanent settlement in India, with eligibility certificate from Govt. of Punjab, Home Affairs & Justice.​

5) Other conditions​

  • Degrees/diplomas from non‑recognised institutions or certain distance‑learning courses within India are not accepted.

  • Candidates must meet all qualifications and conditions by the last date of application.

BFUHS Food Safety Officer Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

  • Written Test (100 Marks): Candidates will be selected purely on merit of a written examination of 100 marks conducted by BFUHS, Faridkot.

  • Document & Police Verification: Appointment is subject to satisfactory verification of certificates, experience (if applicable), police verification, and no pending disciplinary proceedings in case of Government employees.
  • No Extra Weightage: No additional weightage is given for higher qualifications beyond prescribed eligibility.

Eligibility Criteria – SSSB Punjab Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026

1) Educational Qualification​

Post Name Educational/Technical Qualification
Junior Engineer (Civil) Should possess 3 years Diploma in Civil Engineering or its equivalent from a recognized university or institution; OR who possess higher qualification in same discipline from a recognized university or institution
Junior Engineer (Mechanical) Should possess 3 years Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or its equivalent from a recognized university or institution; OR who possess higher qualification in same discipline from a recognized university or institution
Junior Engineer (Electrical) Should possess 3 years Diploma in Electrical Engineering or its equivalent from a recognized university or institution; OR who possess higher qualification in same discipline from a recognized university or institution

Additional Mandatory Requirement:​

  • As per Punjab Civil Services (General and Common Conditions of Service) Rules, 1994, Rule 17: Candidates must have passed Matriculation examination with Punjabi as one of the compulsory or elective subjects OR any other equivalent examination in Punjabi language as specified by Punjab Government.

Cut-off Date for Qualification:​

  • Candidates must possess the required educational/technical qualifications before the last date for submission of online application forms (i.e., 06.04.2026).

2) Age Limit (as on 01.01.2026)​

Category Minimum Age Maximum Age
General Category 18 years 37 years

Ex-Servicemen (ESM) of Punjab State As per Punjab Recruitment of Ex-Servicemen Rules, 1982 (as amended) Age relaxation: Actual service period in armed forces deducted; if remaining age does not exceed upper limit by more than 3 years, candidate deemed eligible
Persons with Disabilities (PWD) of Punjab State 18 years 47 years (10 years relaxation)

Note: State & Central Government employees must produce NOC (No Objection Certificate) from their department at the time of counselling to avail age relaxation.​

3) Nationality & Domicile​

  • Candidates must be residents/domiciled in Punjab State to avail reservation benefits.

  • Valid Domicile/Residence Certificate of Punjab State (not older than 5 years at the time of counselling) is mandatory for all categories (male/female).

4) Category-wise Reservation​

Reservation is available under the following categories for Punjab State residents only:

  • General

  • SC (M & B) – Scheduled Caste (Mazhabi & Balmiki)

  • Freedom Fighter

Important: Candidates must select the correct category and category code while applying online. Category and category code cannot be changed at any stage.
