Bank of Baroda Wealth Management Services Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates applying for Bank of Baroda Wealth Management Services Recruitment 2026 must carefully check the post wise eligibility criteria related to nationality, age limit, educational qualification, work experience and credit history as on the cut off date 01st March 2026.

Nationality / Citizenship: Applicant must be a citizen of India or a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1st January 1962 with the intention of permanently settling in India, or a person of Indian origin who has migrated from specified countries such as Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka and certain East African countries with the intention of permanently settling in India, subject to producing a valid certificate of eligibility issued by the Government of India.

Age Limit (as on 01.03.2026): For AVP II – Group Head, the minimum age is 31 years and maximum age is 45 years. For AVP II – Territory Head, the minimum age is 27 years and maximum age is 40 years. For Deputy Manager – Senior Relationship Manager, the minimum age is 24 years and maximum age is 35 years, and for Deputy Manager – Wealth Strategist (Investment & Insurance), the minimum age is 24 years and maximum age is 45 years, with applicable upper age relaxations for SC, ST, OBC, PwD and Ex‑servicemen as per Government of India norms.

Educational Qualification (Common Requirement): All posts under Bank of Baroda Wealth Management Services 2026 require a Degree (Graduation) in any discipline from a University recognized by the Government of India / Government bodies / AICTE. Desirable qualifications for certain posts include a 2‑year full time Post Graduate Degree / Diploma in Management and relevant Regulatory certifications such as NISM / IRDA, especially for investment and insurance focused roles.

Post-wise Work Experience – AVP II Group Head: Candidates for AVP II – Group Head must have a minimum of 10 years of post‑qualification experience in managing sales in Wealth Management, Retail Banking, Investments or related financial services. Out of this, they should have at least 5 years of experience managing a large team of Relationship Managers and Team Leaders at regional level or equivalent senior leadership capacity.

Post-wise Work Experience – AVP II Territory Head: For the AVP II – Territory Head position, candidates must possess a minimum of 6 years of experience in relationship management in Wealth Management, out of which at least 2 years should be as a Team Leader handling a team of Relationship Managers and driving affluent and high net worth client business.

Post-wise Work Experience – Deputy Manager Senior Relationship Manager: Candidates applying for Deputy Manager – Senior Relationship Manager must have a minimum of 3 years of experience as a Relationship Manager in Wealth Management with Public Sector Banks, Private Banks, Foreign Banks, Broking Firms, Security Firms or Asset Management Companies, with proven ability to acquire and manage HNI and affluent client relationships.

Post-wise Work Experience – Deputy Manager Wealth Strategist (Investment & Insurance): For the role of Deputy Manager – Wealth Strategist (Investment & Insurance), candidates must have at least 3 years of experience as a Relationship Manager or Investment Counsellor in Wealth Management, with excellent knowledge of investment products, PMS, AIF, mutual funds and insurance products and strong advisory skills for high value clients.

Experience Conditions: Only post‑qualification experience will be considered and any experience of less than six months in an organization as on 01.03.2026 will not be counted. Experience in clerical cadre will not be considered for determining eligibility for Bank of Baroda Wealth Management Services professional posts.

Credit History Requirement: Candidates must maintain a satisfactory credit history with a minimum CIBIL score of 680 (or as per bank policy at the time of joining). Applicants with loan or credit card defaults, adverse reports from CIBIL or other credit rating agencies or unsatisfactory credit profiles will be treated as ineligible and their candidature can be rejected at any stage, including after selection.

Other Eligibility Conditions: Candidates must be willing to serve anywhere in India, should meet the prescribed reservation and category criteria with valid SC/ST/OBC (Non‑Creamy Layer)/EWS/PwD certificates, and must be able to produce all original documents related to age, education, work experience and category at the time of interview and document verification. Merely satisfying the minimum eligibility criteria will not confer any right to be called for the online test or personal interview under Bank of Baroda WMS Recruitment 2026.

Bank of Baroda Wealth Management Services Salary 2026

Candidates selected through the Bank of Baroda Wealth Management Services Recruitment 2026 will be appointed on a fixed term contractual basis in specialist wealth management roles with compensation linked to qualification, experience and market benchmarks.

Remuneration Structure: Bank of Baroda will offer a competitive consolidated remuneration to AVP II – Group Head, AVP II – Territory Head, Deputy Manager – Senior Relationship Manager and Deputy Manager – Wealth Strategist (Investment & Insurance) based on the candidate’s educational qualifications, total and relevant work experience, overall suitability, last drawn salary and prevailing market benchmark for similar wealth management positions.

Contract Tenure & Service Conditions: The engagement as Officer on Contractual Basis (OCB) is for an initial period of 5 years from the date of joining, which may be renewed or extended at the sole discretion of the bank, subject to satisfactory performance, for an additional period of up to 5 more years, but not beyond the candidate’s 60 years of age. All selected candidates will be governed by the bank’s extant policies regarding probation, performance review, termination, and other service conditions applicable to contractual officers.

Bank of Baroda Wealth Management Services Application Fees 2026

Candidates applying online for Bank of Baroda WMS Recruitment 2026 are required to pay a non‑refundable application fee/intimation charge as per their category through the integrated payment gateway.

Application Fee for UR/EWS/OBC: For candidates belonging to Unreserved (UR), Economically Weaker Section (EWS) and Other Backward Classes (OBC), the application fee is Rs. 850/- (inclusive of GST) plus applicable payment gateway charges, which must be paid online while submitting the Bank of Baroda Wealth Management Services online application form 2026.

Application Fee for SC/ST/PwD/ESM/Women: For SC, ST, Persons with Disability (PwD), Ex‑servicemen/Disabled Ex‑servicemen (ESM/DESM) and Women candidates, the fee is Rs. 175/- (intimation charges only, inclusive of GST) plus payment gateway charges. The fee once paid is non‑refundable in all circumstances, whether or not the online test is held or the candidate is shortlisted.

Online Payment Mode: The BOB WMS application fee 2026 must be paid using Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, UPI or other online methods through the payment gateway integrated with the application form. If the online transaction is not successfully completed, candidates must re‑register and make the payment again; multiple payments will not be refunded by the bank.

Bank of Baroda Wealth Management Services Selection Process 2026

The Bank of Baroda Wealth Management Services Recruitment 2026 selection process involves multiple stages including shortlisting, online assessment and interview/psychometric evaluation to identify the most suitable wealth professionals.

Shortlisting & Application Scrutiny: Initially, applications will be scrutinised based on eligibility, educational qualifications, relevant work experience, domain expertise and other criteria decided by the bank. Only shortlisted candidates, as per internal norms, will be called for the next stages, and mere fulfilment of eligibility does not guarantee shortlisting for Bank of Baroda WMS selection 2026.

Online Test & Psychometric Assessment: The selection process may include an online test followed by a psychometric test or other suitable assessments to evaluate the candidate’s personality, communication, problem‑solving ability, efficiency, innovation and willingness to work anywhere in India. The bank reserves the right to conduct or waive the online test and/or psychometric test based on its recruitment strategy.

Personal Interview (PI): Shortlisted candidates will be called for a Personal Interview, where they will be assessed on domain knowledge, relationship management skills, leadership potential (for AVP roles), communication skills and overall suitability for wealth management roles. Candidates must obtain at least 60% marks in PI (55% for reserved categories), or such minimum qualifying marks as may be decided by the bank.

Final Merit & Provisional Selection: The final merit list for Bank of Baroda WMS Recruitment 2026 will be prepared based on the candidate’s performance in the online test (if conducted), psychometric test and personal interview, as per weightage decided by the bank. Only candidates who qualify in all stages and rank sufficiently high in merit, subject to vacancy and category norms, will be provisionally selected, and all decisions of the bank regarding shortlisting and selection will be final and binding.

Selection Process

  • Candidates must register successfully on NAPS/NATS portal and apply against the notification to be considered for the selection process.
  • There will be no written test or interview.
  • A merit list will be prepared based on the percentage of marks secured in the essential prescribed qualification for the respective post.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for Document Verification.
  • Shortlisted candidates must complete a Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Test and be adjudged medically fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical format.
  • Candidates whose documents and Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Certificate are found in order shall be issued an Offer of Engagement for Apprenticeship Training.
  • Opportunities not filled through the initial shortlisting shall be filled by eligible candidates from the merit cum panel list for the same opportunity.

General Information / Instructions

  • Candidates must apply only for ONE discipline code. Applications for more than one discipline code will be summarily rejected.
  • Applicants must submit applications only against vacancies notified under the states of Western Region (Maharashtra, Gujarat, Goa, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, UT of Daman & Diu, UT of Dadra & Nagar Haveli). Selection of training locations outside notified states will result in rejection.
  • Candidate profile on the portal must be 100% complete (Personal Details, Educational Details, Category, etc.).
  • The candidature of the applicant shall be provisional and subject to subsequent verification of certificates and testimonials.
  • Any false or incorrect information furnished at any stage will lead to cancellation of candidature and liability for criminal prosecution.
  • Candidates should maintain the same registered email ID and mobile number till completion of apprenticeship training.
  • SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates applying for Unreserved (UR) seats shall be considered subject to fulfilling standards applicable to General category candidates.
  • PwBD candidates are NOT eligible to apply for Discipline Codes 101, 102, 103, 104, 105, 106, 107, 108, 109, 110, 111.
  • Reservation will be applicable as per the prescribed percentage for the respective States/UT.
  • No. of seats indicated is tentative and may increase or decrease at the absolute discretion of management.
  • Upon completion of the Apprenticeship period, IOCL shall have NO obligation to offer employment, nor can an Apprentice claim the right for employment.
  • A minimum one-year gap between two apprenticeship trainings is required, provided the previous training is completed.
  • All future correspondence and latest information shall be shared only on IOCL website: https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships.
  • For OBC-NCL category, candidates must submit a latest caste certificate not more than 12 months old from 28.02.2026 in the Proforma prescribed by Govt. of India.
  • Canvassing of any kind shall disqualify the candidate.

How to Apply

  • Candidates meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria must apply online only through the NAPS/NATS Portal.
  • For Trade Apprentice (ITI/Data Entry Operator): Register at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/ (NAPS)

  • After registration, login to the respective NATS/NAPS portal using your User ID/Email ID and APPLY for apprenticeship openings using the following Establishment IDs of IOCL (Marketing Division) – Western Region:
    • NATS Establishment ID: WMHMCC000053
    • NAPS Establishment ID: E01172700332
  • Application window: 11.03.2026 (10:00 AM) to 26.03.2026 (5:00 PM).
  • No other means or mode of application will be accepted.
  • Ensure your profile is 100% complete with Personal Details, Educational Details, and Category before applying.
  • Before applying, keep ready: PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, Bank Account details with Cheque Book (name printed), and scanned copies of Educational Qualification Certificates.
  • Candidates are advised to apply well in advance before the last date to avoid last-minute technical issues.
  • Candidates registered with Local/State Employment Exchange(s) / Vocational Rehabilitation Centre for PwBD and meeting prescribed eligibility criteria must apply through NAPS/NATS Portal.

SMC Clerk, Engineers and More Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details 

The Surat Municipal Corporation's recruitment announces a total of 2,295 vacancies across various cadres with category-wise reservations for Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC), Unreserved (General), and Economically Weaker Sections (EWS), including 33% horizontal reservation for women.

SMC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

  • Mechanical / Automobile Engineer: B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical or Automobile Engineering from a recognised university, plus basic computer knowledge and Gujarati/Hindi proficiency.
  • Electrical Engineer: B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineering from a recognised university, plus required computer knowledge and Gujarati/Hindi proficiency.
  • Town Planning Officer / Planner: M.Arch/M.E. (Civil)/B.Arch/B.E. (Civil) and a PG degree/diploma in City/Town/Regional Planning or membership of the Institute of Town Planners after passing its exam, with basic computer knowledge and Gujarati/Hindi.
  • Food Safety Officer: Master’s degree in specified subjects (e.g., Chemistry, Biochemistry, Food Technology/Science & Technology, Food & Nutrition, Microbiology, Dairy Technology, Agriculture, Horticulture, Biotechnology, Life Science, etc.), or a one‑year PG Diploma in Food Safety & Quality Assurance, or BE/B.Tech in specified Food/Dairy/Biotech/Oil/Processing disciplines, or a 4‑year degree in Medicine/Veterinary/Fisheries/Animal Science, plus basic computer knowledge and Gujarati/Hindi.
  • X-Ray Technician: Bachelor’s degree in Science from a recognised university and passed X‑Ray Technician course from a Government institute or recognised medical college, plus basic computer knowledge and Gujarati/Hindi

Note: For post-wise qualifications, please refer to the official notification. We have provided the qualifications for only some of the posts.

SMC Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

  • For Surat Municipal Corporation Recruitment 2025-26, the upper age limit is generally 35 years for most posts and 45 years for some higher posts, with relaxations as per Gujarat government rules.
  • Most technical/specialist posts (Engineers, Food Safety Officer, X‑Ray Technician, etc.): maximum 35 years; age relaxable for reserved category candidates (SC/ST/OBC, etc.) as per applicable rules.
  • Certain senior Town Planning/Planning Officer posts: maximum 45 years, with similar category-wise relaxations.
  • For existing Surat Municipal Corporation employees, the upper age limit condition is not applied in some cadres, as specifically mentioned in the notification.

SMC Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

  • For General / OBC (Creamy Layer) candidates, the application fee is ₹500 per application.
  • For OBC (Non‑Creamy Layer) / SC / ST candidates, the application fee is ₹250.
  • PwD (Persons with Disabilities / Divyang) candidates are exempted from payment of any application fee.
  • The fee must be paid online through debit card, credit card, net banking or other options available on the SMC payment gateway during the application window from 01 April 2026 (11:00 AM) to 15 April 2026 (11:00 PM), and the fee is non‑refundable in all cases.

Important Dates

Selection Process

  • Shortlisting for test/interview: Based on eligibility and criteria fixed by SMC for each cadre, candidates are shortlisted for the next stage, which may include a written test, skill test and/or interview depending on the post.
  • Written examination / skill test: For technical and specialist posts (Engineers, Town Planning, Food Safety Officer, X‑Ray Technician etc.), SMC can conduct a written exam and/or practical/skill test to assess subject knowledge and job-related skills.
  • Interview (for selected cadres): Certain higher or specialist posts may also have an interview/viva‑voce round in addition to the written test, as decided by the corporation.
  • Preparation of merit list and waiting list: A merit list (and waiting list) is prepared based on marks obtained in the written/skill test and interview (if held), following reservation rules and post-wise weightage notified by SMC.
  • Document verification and final appointment: Shortlisted candidates are called for verification of original certificates, and appointments are issued from the approved list/waiting list subject to successful verification and medical fitness where applicable.

HVF Avadi Apprentice Eligibility Criteria 2026-27

HVF Avadi Apprenticeship eligibility criteria include educational qualification, domicile, year of passing, age as per Apprenticeship Rules, reservation norms and physical standards as prescribed in Apprenticeship Rule 1992.

Educational Qualification

  • Category I – Graduate Apprentices (Engineering / Technology): Full-time Degree in Engineering or Technology in relevant discipline granted by a Statutory University, Institution empowered by an Act of Parliament, or Graduate examination of professional bodies recognized as equivalent by State/Central Government.
  • Category II – Technician (Diploma) Apprentices: Full-time Diploma in Engineering or Technology in relevant discipline granted by State Technical Education Board, University, or Institution recognized by State/Central Government.
  • Category III – Non-Engineering Graduate Apprentices: Full-time Degree in Arts/Science/Commerce/Humanities such as BA/B.Sc/B.Com/BBA/BBM/BCA etc. from Statutory/Deemed University in relevant discipline (UGC approved).

Not Eligible: Candidates with Distance Education / Correspondence degrees, Open University degrees or Post Graduates (PG) are not eligible for Apprenticeship.

Year of Passing & Domicile

  • Candidates must be Graduate/Diploma holders who passed in 2022, 2023, 2024 or 2025.
  • Candidates must hail from Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana or Puducherry.

Age Limit

Age limit will be followed as per Apprenticeship Rules.

Reservation of Vacancies

  • Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD will be as per Apprentices Act guidelines.
  • Candidates claiming SC/ST/OBC/PwD reservation must produce valid certificates in Government-prescribed format; otherwise their claim will be treated as General category.
  • BC/MBC candidates claiming OBC (Non-creamy layer) must produce OBC (NCL) certificate in the approved format from competent authority.

Physical Standards

Minimum physical standards shall be as prescribed in Clause 4 of the Apprenticeship Rule 1992 and subsequent amendments.

Previous Training / Experience

Candidates who have already undergone or are currently undergoing Apprenticeship under Apprenticeship (Amendment) Act 1973, and/or having one year or more experience are NOT ELIGIBLE to apply.

HVF Avadi Apprentice Selection Process 2026-27

The selection process for HVF Avadi Apprenticeship 2026-27 is based on merit of qualifying examination and certificate verification.

  • Shortlisting: Board of Apprenticeship Training (Southern Region) will prepare the shortlist from online application data based on percentage of marks obtained in the basic prescribed qualification for the respective disciplines.
  • Intimation: Shortlisted candidates will be informed through their registered email ID.
  • Certificate Verification: Shortlisted candidates must appear for Certificate Verification at Heavy Vehicles Factory, Avadi, Chennai on the scheduled dates.

HVF Avadi Apprentice Stipend & Training Duration 2026-27

All Apprentices engaged under HVF Avadi Apprenticeship 2026-27 will undergo one-year training with monthly stipend as per Apprenticeship norms.

  • Graduate Apprentices (Engineering / Technology): ₹18,000/- per month.
  • Non-Engineering Graduate Apprentices (BA/BSc/BCom/BBA/BBM/BCA etc.): ₹18,000/- per month.
  • Technician (Diploma) Apprentices: ₹16,200/- per month.
  • Training Period: One year for all categories as per Apprenticeship (Amendment) Act 1973.

Upon completion of Apprenticeship, Heavy Vehicles Factory, Avadi, Chennai has no obligation to offer employment, and apprentices cannot claim right of employment on the basis of completion of training.

How to Apply for HVF Avadi Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27

Eligible candidates must register and apply online through the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal for Heavy Vehicles Factory Avadi (User ID: STNTLC000004) by following the steps below.

  1. Visit the NATS portal at https://nats.education.gov.in and click on “Student”.
  2. For first-time users, click “Student Register”, complete the registration form and obtain a 12-digit Enrollment Number.
  3. For existing NATS users, log in using registered email ID and password (or use “Forgot Password” to reset if migrated from old portal). Complete the application form if not already done.
  4. After enrollment, log in with email ID and password and click on “Apply against advertised vacancies”.
  5. Search for “HEAVY VEHICLES FACTORY” and click “Apply”. The status will change to “applied”.
  6. Upload Provisional Certificate or Consolidated Mark Sheet of BE/B.Tech/Diploma/BA/B.Sc/B.Com/BBA/BCA etc. and ensure that percentage of marks is correctly entered in the “% of marks / CGPA x 10” column; applications without percentage will not be considered.

Important Instructions

  • Only eligible candidates should apply and carefully read all provisions and requirements in the notification before submitting online application via NATS portal for HVF Avadi.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending certificate verification, and no boarding/lodging expenses are admissible for candidates.
  • Incomplete, erroneous or late online applications received after due date will be rejected, and no further communication will be entertained in this regard.
  • Board of Apprenticeship Training (Southern Region) has not authorised any individual/organisation to coordinate or liaison on its behalf; candidates are advised to beware of touts and note that the Board is not responsible for such incidents.
  • Canvassing or pressuring through any source will disqualify the candidature and the candidate’s name will be removed from official records without prior intimation.
  • For any clarification, candidates may contact through email at [email protected] as given in the notification.

The 2026 edition is special as it focuses exclusively on working teachers, providing them an opportunity to clear the test amid government directives making TET mandatory for promotions and continued service. This is particularly relevant following recent G.O.s and court rulings emphasizing TET qualification for in-service educators. Working teachers in government, aided, and recognized private schools should read this article to understand application details, preparation strategies, and benefits.

Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test for Working Teachers 2026 – Complete Guide

The Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test for Working Teachers 2026 is designed to certify the eligibility of in-service teachers for teaching positions in Classes 1 to 8. Conducted by the Teachers Recruitment Board (TRB) under the Government of Tamil Nadu, it targets working teachers appointed before a specified cutoff date. The exam is held in offline mode using OMR sheets, with two separate papers: Paper 1 for Classes 1–5 and Paper 2 for Classes 6–8.

What is Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test for Working Teachers 2026?

TET is a state-level eligibility test for teachers of Classes 1–8 in government and aided schools, ensuring they meet national standards for teaching aptitude and subject knowledge. The 2026 version includes a special focus on working teachers who have not yet cleared TET, aligning with government and Supreme Court directives to make it mandatory for all educators. Clearing TET is now essential for job security and career advancement in Tamil Nadu.

  • Conducting body: Teachers Recruitment Board (TRB), Government of Tamil Nadu
  • Level: State-level eligibility test
  • Applicable classes: Paper 1 – Classes 1–5, Paper 2 – Classes 6–8

Special TET 2026 for Working Teachers – Key Highlights

This special TET targets working teachers, offering a dedicated chance to qualify without competing with fresh candidates. It differs by restricting eligibility to in-service educators, emphasizing their need for TET clearance for promotions and regularization. The test follows the standard TNTET pattern and syllabus.

Eligibility Criteria for Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test 2026 (Working Teachers)

Eligibility is limited to working teachers appointed on or before 01.09.2025 as Secondary Grade Teachers (SGT), BT Assistants, or equivalent cadres on time scale, consolidated, or part-time pay in specified departments and schools.

Educational Qualification for Paper 1 (Classes 1–5)

Candidates must possess the qualifications as per G.O.(Ms).No.13, School Education [SE3(1)] Department, dated 30.01.2020, including 10+2/HSC plus Diploma in Teacher Education/Diploma in Elementary Education or equivalent. This applies to Secondary Grade Teachers, BRTEs, and Special Education Teachers (IEDSS). In-service teachers in aided or unaided schools are also eligible if they meet NCTE norms.

Educational Qualification for Paper 2 (Classes 6–8)

Graduation in the relevant subject plus B.Ed. or equivalent, as per special rules for Tamil Nadu School Educational Subordinate Services. For Special Education Teachers, qualifications from G.O.(Ms).No.144, dated 17.06.2025 apply. Subject-specific requirements include relevant graduation for Mathematics/Science or Social Science teachers.

Age Limit and In-Service Relaxations

There is no upper age limit specified for TET eligibility. Relaxations in qualifying marks apply: 50% for BC/BCM/MBC/DNC/PWD and 40% for SC/SCA/ST.

Who Can Apply as a Working Teacher?

In-service teachers in government, government-aided, and recognized unaided private schools teaching Classes 1 to 8, including those under various departments like School Education, MBC, ADW, Tribal Welfare, and corporations. Qualified serving teachers opting for promotion must also apply.

TN TET 2026 Exam Pattern for Working Teachers

The exam pattern is identical for working and non-working candidates: 150 MCQs, 3 hours duration, no negative marking.

General category: 60% (90/150). BC/BCM/MBC/DNC and PWD: 50% (75/150). SC/SCA/ST: 40% (60/150).

Tamil Nadu TET 2026 Syllabus for Working Teachers

The syllabus is based on the state-prescribed topics for Classes 1–8, with difficulty up to secondary/higher secondary stage.

TNTET 2026 Paper 1 Syllabus (Classes 1–5)

  • Child Development and Pedagogy: Stages of child development, learning theories, inclusive education, teaching–learning process, assessment and evaluation.
  • Language I (regional language): Reading comprehension, grammar, language skills, pedagogy of language development.
  • Language II – English: Comprehension, vocabulary, grammar, communication, English language pedagogy.
  • Mathematics: Number system, operations, fractions, decimals, geometry, measurement, data handling, pedagogy of mathematics.
  • Environmental Studies: Family and friends, food, water, travel, shelter, environment, resources, EVS pedagogy.

TNTET 2026 Paper 2 Syllabus (Classes 6–8)

  • Child Development and Pedagogy (11–14): Adolescent development, learning and motivation, classroom management, evaluation.
  • Language I and II: Similar components as Paper 1 but at higher difficulty level.
  • Subject-specific: Mathematics & Science – algebra, geometry, mensuration, statistics, basics of physics, chemistry, biology, pedagogy. Social Science – history, geography, civics, economics, social science pedagogy.

Note that the official TRB syllabus PDF must be followed strictly.

Application Process for Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test 2026 (Working Teachers)

Applications are online only via http://www.trb.tn.gov.in. Separate applications for Paper 1 and Paper 2 with fees.

  • Register with valid email and mobile number.
  • Fill details, upload photo (40-60 KB, JPG/JPEG/PNG), signature (20-40 KB), and certificates (250-300 KB PDF).
  • Pay fee: Rs.600/- (general) or Rs.300/- (SC/SCA/ST/PWD) via net banking/credit/debit card.
  • Use edit window if needed; submit by 10-04-2026.

Documents required:

  • 10th/SSLC, 12th/HSC, Diploma/B.Ed./UG certificates and mark sheets.
  • Community certificate, Differently Abled certificate.
  • Service Certificate (Annexure-I).

Exam Centres, Hall Ticket and Exam Day Guidelines

Exams in all districts; centre details in hall ticket. Download hall ticket from TRB website. Report early with ID proof; no electronic gadgets allowed. OMR-based; follow invigilator instructions.

TN TET 2026 Result, Certificate Validity and Use for Promotions

Results published on http://www.trb.tn.gov.in as qualified lists. Qualifying candidates receive TNTET certificates. Validity is lifetime as per norms. For working teachers, TET clearance is mandatory for promotions in Tamil Nadu government schools; it's an eligibility criterion for career progression.

Benefits of Clearing Tamil Nadu TET 2026 for Working Teachers

  • Eligibility for regularization and promotions in government and aided schools.
  • Compliance with Supreme Court directions making TET mandatory for Classes 1–8 teachers.
  • Better job security and mobility, eligibility for future recruitment drives.
  • Professional recognition and alignment with national teacher quality standards.

Preparation Strategy for Working Teachers – How to Crack TN TET 2026

Balance school duties with study by focusing on pedagogy sections. Use NCERT/Tamil Nadu textbooks for content revision.

  • Create a weekly timetable around school hours.
  • Revise core concepts from textbook levels you teach daily.
  • Use weekends for full-length mock tests.
  • Focus on weak sections identified from previous attempts.

Eligibility criteria - South Central Railway Act Apprentice 2025-26

1) Educational qualification​

  • 10th class/SSC passed under 10+2 system with minimum 50% aggregate marks from a recognised board.

  • ITI certificate in the relevant notified trade from an institute recognised by NCVT/SCVT (trade-wise: AC Mechanic, Carpenter, COPA, Diesel Mechanic, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic, Fitter, Industrial Electronics, Machinist, MMTM, Motor Mechanic Vehicle, Painter, Welder).

  • Candidate must possess required qualification as on date of online application submission.

  • Engineering graduates and diploma holders are not eligible for this Act Apprentice notification (covered under separate scheme).

2) Age limit (as on 11.04.2026)​

  • Minimum age: 15 years.

  • Maximum age: 24 years.

Category-wise permissible date of birth range:

Category Date of birth between
UR / EWS 11-04-2002 and 11-04-2011
SC / ST 11-04-1997 and 11-04-2011
OBC-NCL 11-04-1999 and 11-04-2011
Ex-Servicemen / PwBD (UR) 11-04-1992 and 11-04-2011
Ex-Servicemen / PwBD (SC/ST) 11-04-1987 and 11-04-2011
Ex-Servicemen / PwBD (OBC) 11-04-1989 and 11-04-2011

Relaxations included in above ranges:

  • SC/ST: +5 years.

  • OBC-NCL: +3 years.

  • PwBD: +10 years.

  • Ex-Servicemen: +10 years up to length of service in Defence Forces (no extra relaxation for their children).

3) Residential / jurisdiction eligibility​
Candidates must reside in districts under South Central Railway jurisdiction and provide valid proof of residence. Eligible areas:

  • Telangana: all districts.

  • Andhra Pradesh: all districts except Manyam, Srikakulam, Vizianagaram.

  • Maharashtra: Akola, Amaravati, Aurangabad, Beed, Chandrapur, Hingoli, Jalna, Latur, Nanded, Nasik, Parbhani, Washim, Yavatmal.

  • Karnataka: Balki, Bellari, Belgaum, Bidar, Gulbarga/Kalaburgi, Raichur, Yadgir.

  • Tamil Nadu: Vellore.

  • Madhya Pradesh: Burhanpur, Khandwa.

4) Category certificates (for reservation)​

  • SC/ST: Central Government format caste certificate (Annexure-B).

  • OBC-NCL: caste + NCL certificate (issued within 3 years) in Central format (Annexure-C) + self-declaration (Annexure-D).

  • EWS: valid Income & Asset certificate (Annexure-E).

  • PwBD: disability ≥40% in prescribed format (Annexure-G/H).

5) Salary/Stipend

  • Selected candidates will be paid a stipend during the apprenticeship at the prescribed rates as per extant instructions.

SCR Apprentice Selection Process 2025-26

  • Merit List Basis: Selection for SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 will be done purely on merit, by taking the average of percentage marks in 10th (minimum 50% aggregate) and ITI marks, giving equal weightage to both.
  • No Exam / Interview: There will be no written test or viva-voce for South Central Railway Apprentice Recruitment 2025-26.
  • Tie-breaking: If two candidates have the same aggregate percentage, older candidate (higher age) will be preferred; if DOB is also same, the candidate who passed Matriculation earlier will be preferred.
  • Document Verification (DV): Shortlisted candidates will be called for DV where all original certificates (education, ITI, caste, EWS, PwBD, ExSM, RDAT registration, medical fitness) will be verified.
  • Medical Fitness: Candidates must produce medical fitness certificate from a government-authorised doctor (Gazetted, not below Asst. Surgeon) in prescribed format at DV; without this, they will not be considered.
  • Training & Stipend: Selected candidates will undergo apprenticeship training as per Central Apprenticeship Council syllabus and receive stipend at prescribed rates during training.
  • No Job Guarantee: SCR apprenticeship 2025-26 provides training only; there is no guarantee of regular railway job after completion of apprenticeship.

South Central Railway Apprentice Application Form 2026

  • Application Mode: Online only via RRC/SCR portal; no offline forms will be accepted.
  • Application Dates: SCR Apprentice online form 2026 is available from 12 March 2026 (17:00 hrs) to 11 April 2026 (23:59 hrs).
  • Fee: ₹100 for applicable categories; SC/ST, female/Transgender and PwBD candidates are exempt from fee payment.
  • Multiple Trades: Candidates with ITI in more than one trade can submit separate SCR Apprentice application 2026 for each trade.
  • Communication: All updates regarding SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 application form, merit list and DV will be sent via registered email/SMS and uploaded on RRC-SCR webpage only.

How to Apply for South Central Railway Apprentice Recruitment 2025-26

  1. Visit the official South Central Railway website: https://scr.indianrailways.gov.in and go to About Us → RRC-SCR to open the ONLINE ACT APPRENTICE APPLICATION link.
  2. Read the detailed SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 notification carefully and ensure you belong to the eligible states/districts and possess required 10th + ITI qualification.
  3. Complete Registration: select state and district, upload address proof, enter valid mobile number and email ID, create a password and verify OTPs sent to mobile and email.
  4. Login as a registered candidate and fill in personal details (name, DOB, category, etc.) and educational/technical details (10th marks, ITI trade, ITI marks, RDAT registration number).
  5. Select your priority/preference of training units (Divisions/Workshops/Sheds) only for trades you are eligible for; options once submitted cannot be changed.
  6. Upload a recent colour photograph (JPEG, ≤1 MB, not older than 3 months), signature image (≤1 MB) and required certificates (10th, ITI, RDAT form, caste, EWS, PwBD, ExSM, medical certificate) in PDF format (≤2 MB).
  7. Ensure you have completed RDAT/NAPS registration at www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in and obtained registration number before filling the SCR apprentice application.
  8. Check all details in the Preview page carefully; after clicking Submit, no modification will be allowed.
  9. Pay the application fee (if applicable) through online payment gateway (Net Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI) and generate e-receipt.
  10. Download/print the final submitted SCR Apprentice application form 2026 and keep it along with fee receipt and uploaded documents for Document Verification.

NFC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection process varies by post code:

  • Post Codes 12601, 12603, 12604 – Interview Based: Selection on the basis of Personal Interview. If response is more, NFC may conduct a Screening Test (75 MCQs, 90 minutes, +3 for correct / –1 for incorrect) to restrict candidates called for interview.
  • Post Codes 12602, 12605, 12606 – Three Stage Process:
    • Stage 1 – Preliminary Test (1 hour, OMR-based): 50 MCQs – Mathematics (20), Science (20), General Awareness (10). +3 for correct / –1 for incorrect. Cut-off: 40% (General), 30% (Reserved categories).
    • Stage 2 – Advanced Test (2 hours): 50 MCQs from relevant discipline. +3 for correct / –1 for incorrect. Cut-off: 30% (General), 20% (Reserved). Merit list prepared based on Stage 2 marks only. Both stages conducted in a single session as Section A & B.
    • Stage 3 – Skill Test (Go/No-Go basis): Up to 5 times the number of vacancies shortlisted from Stage 2. Candidates clearing Skill Test empanelled in order of Stage 2 merit.

Payment mode: Online only through BharatKosh / Non-Tax Receipt Portal (NTRP) at https://bharatkosh.gov.in. Fee once paid is non-refundable.

Examination Centres

Examinations are tentatively scheduled to be conducted at Hyderabad (Telangana), Mumbai (Maharashtra), Rawatbhata (Rajasthan) and Pazhayakayal (Tamil Nadu). Candidates may indicate their preferred city in the application form. NFC reserves the right to add or delete centres without assigning any reason.

How to Apply for NFC Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official NFC recruitment website https://recruit.nfc.gov.in (available from 21 March 2026, 10:00 hrs).
  2. Read the advertisement and instructions carefully before filling the application.
  3. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit separate applications for each post.
  4. Keep the following documents ready in PDF format for uploading:
    • SSC/10th Standard Certificate
    • HSC/12th Certificate
    • Qualifying certificate (Degree/Diploma/Certificate for respective post)
    • Registration Certificate (as applicable)
    • Caste/PwBD/EWS certificate (if applicable)
    • Experience/Training certificate (as applicable)
    • Application fee payment receipt (if applicable)
    • Passport-size photograph (JPEG, 165×125 pixels, max 50 KB, white background)
    • Signature (JPEG, 80×125 pixels, max 20 KB)
  5. Pay the application fee (if applicable) through BharatKosh/NTRP before initiating the online application.
  6. Fill all details in the online application form correctly as per Matriculation certificate.
  7. Enter fee payment details in the 'Details of Fee Paid' column and submit the application before 18 April 2026 (17:00 hrs).
  8. A copy of the submitted application will be sent to your registered email ID in PDF format – preserve it till the selection process is completed.

Important Instructions

  • Only Indian citizens are eligible to apply.
  • All qualifications must be recognized by concerned Regulatory Authorities in India.
  • Only one application per post; separate applications required for each post if applying for multiple posts.
  • After final submission, no request for change/correction will be entertained under any circumstances.
  • Candidates working in Government/PSU/Autonomous bodies must submit NOC at the time of Interview/Skill Test.
  • SC/ST outstation candidates called for Tests/Interview/Skill Test will be reimbursed to-and-fro sleeper class/second-class railway fare by shortest route (subject to production of tickets); fare for first 30 km shall be borne by candidates.
  • Appointment is subject to Medical fitness conducted by NFC.
  • Selected candidates will be governed by National Pension System (NPS) or Unified Pension Scheme (UPS) as notified by the Government.
  • Select list/Wait list validity is one year from the date of publication of results.
  • Candidates must regularly check https://www.nfc.gov.in for all updates; no information will be sent by post/courier.
  • Any dispute will be subject to the Courts having jurisdiction in Hyderabad only.
  • Beware of fraudulent recruitment advertisements forging NFC/DAE name/logo; NFC does not ask for any payment other than the prescribed application fee.
  • For any clarification, contact: [email protected] (with Registration Number, registered email ID, mobile number, name, date of birth, and post applied for).

Other categories As per Govt. of India directives All other applicable relaxations as notified from time to time

India Optel Limited Junior Project Engineer Salary 2026

  • Junior Project Engineers engaged under India Optel Limited Recruitment 2026 will be placed in Pay Level ₹30,000 – ₹1,20,000, along with Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA).
  • They will be eligible for House Rent Allowance (HRA) as per applicable rates where company accommodation is not allotted.
  • Medical Allowance of ₹1,500 per month is payable, subject to conditions for retired Govt. employees/Ex-servicemen with respect to CGHS/ECHS/Defence Forces NOC.
  • An annual increment of 3% of basic pay (rounded to the next ten) is admissible during the tenure, based on satisfactory performance and recommendation of the competent authority.

Tenure of Engagement

  • The initial engagement on Fixed Term Contract basis will be for up to 2 years, depending on requirement.
  • Extension in engagement may be granted for periods up to 1 year at a time, subject to requirement and performance evaluation, with the total tenure not exceeding 5 years including initial term and extensions.
  • IOL reserves the right to terminate the contract before completion of the term in case of unsatisfactory performance or misconduct, with notice as per conditions in the advertisement.

Place of Posting

Selected candidates for India Optel Limited Recruitment 2026 will normally be posted at Opto Electronics Factory (OLF) and Ordnance Factory Dehradun (OFD), units of India Optel Limited located in Dehradun, Uttarakhand. However, depending on organizational requirements, they may be posted, transferred, attached or deputed to other locations with the approval of the competent authority.

India Optel Limited Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • Screening: Applications will be screened by a Screening Committee, and only eligible candidates will be considered.
  • Shortlisting: Candidates will be shortlisted for interview, generally up to 1.5 times the number of vacancies, based on percentage of marks in Diploma/B.Sc (as applicable).
  • Interview: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for personal interview, for which call letters will be sent through email.
  • Final Merit: Final merit will be prepared using 75% weightage for Diploma/B.Sc percentage and 25% weightage for interview performance.
  • Document Verification: Original documents will be verified before interview; any shortcomings or discrepancies will result in rejection of candidature.
  • Tie-breaking: In case of equal scores, the elder candidate (by date of birth) will be placed higher; if DOB is also same, alphabetical order of names will be considered.

Application Fee

  • There is no application fee (NIL) for India Optel Limited Recruitment 2026 Junior Project Engineer posts.

How to Apply India Optel Limited Recruitment 2026 (Junior Project Engineer)

Applications for India Optel Limited Recruitment 2026 are accepted offline only in the prescribed application format (Annexure “A”). Follow the steps given below.

  1. Download Application Form: Visit the DOO (C&S) website at https://ddpdoo.gov.in, go to the “Join Us” tab and download the application format (Annexure “A”) attached with the advertisement.
  2. Fill in Block Letters: Fill the application completely in BLOCK LETTERS, giving correct personal details, category, educational qualifications, post applied for, and experience information.
  3. Attach Photograph: Paste a recent passport-size photograph on the application form and self-attest it as specified.
  4. Attach Self-attested Documents: Enclose self-attested photocopies of:
    • Valid proof of date of birth (Matriculation/Secondary school certificate or Birth Certificate)
    • Educational mark sheets and degree/diploma certificates (10th onwards)
    • Experience certificates, joining/relieving letters, salary slips/statement, PPO (for retired candidates), etc., showing relevant post-qualification experience
    • Caste/category certificate for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS, PwBD certificate, Ex-Servicemen discharge certificate (if applicable)
  5. Check Email and Mobile: Clearly mention a valid and active email ID and mobile number which will remain in use throughout the engagement process, as all important communication will be sent via email.
  6. Separate Applications: If applying for more than one discipline/position, submit a separate application for each.
  7. Superscribe Envelope: Put the filled application and enclosures in an envelope clearly superscribed as “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ________ ON FIXED TERM CONTRACT BASIS”.
  8. Send by Speed Post Only: Send the application by Speed Post only to the following address so that it reaches within 21 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News:Postal Address: The Chairman & Managing Director, India Optel Limited, OFILDD Campus, Raipur, Dehradun (Uttarakhand) – 248008
  9. Applications received after the closing date, incomplete applications, applications without required enclosures, not in the prescribed format or with incorrect information are liable to be rejected without any correspondence.

Important Instructions & Rejection Conditions

  • Applications not meeting eligibility criteria, received after the last date, or not in the prescribed format will be summarily rejected and IOL will not be responsible for postal delays.
  • Incomplete, illegible applications or those without self-attested copies of required certificates will not be considered.
  • Any variation in name/surname between application and certificates, or any false/incorrect information or dubious documents, will lead to disqualification.
  • Candidates who do not fulfil the eligibility conditions at any stage will be disqualified ab-initio and no correspondence will be entertained regarding non-selection.

Nature of Engagement & Termination

  • The engagement is purely on Fixed Term Contract basis and does not confer any right for regular or permanent employment in India Optel Limited.
  • The engagement automatically ends on completion of the contract term unless extended, and may be terminated earlier for poor performance, misconduct, breach of company rules or prolonged unauthorized absence.
  • The contract can be terminated by giving notice (or payment in lieu) as specified in the advertisement: generally 3 months by the FTC employee and 1 month by the company.

HLL CNCI Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Candidates applying for HLL CNCI Kolkata Nursing, Paramedical and Non‑Medical Recruitment 2026 must ensure that they meet the post-wise educational qualification, experience and age criteria as on the cut-off date 01 March 2026.

  • Nationality: Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply for HLL CNCI recruitment.
  • Age Limit: Maximum age for all posts is 40 years as on 01.03.2026, with relaxation in upper age limit for SC, ST, OBC and PwD candidates as per Government of India rules.
  • Educational Qualification: Candidates must possess the prescribed qualification for the respective post such as: B.Sc/GNM Nursing, B.Sc/Diploma in OT/ICU/CCU/Radiology/Radiotherapy/Lab Technology, M.Sc Microbiology, M.Sc (relevant field), B.Pharm/M.Pharm/Pharm D, BSW/MSW, M.Sc Nutrition, Degree/Diploma in Engineering (Electrical/Biomedical), Master’s in Library Science, B.Com, Graduate in any discipline, SSLC/HSC with Hindi typing, etc., from recognised Indian universities/institutes.
  • Experience: Required post‑qualification experience varies by post (from 1 year to 10+ years) and must be in relevant settings like 50‑bedded hospitals, NABH‑accredited hospitals, cancer centres, licensed blood banks, CSSD, accounts, billing, patient services, IT/HIMS, store, office administration, etc.
  • Registration/Certificates: Wherever applicable, candidates should have valid professional registrations/certificates (e.g. nursing council registration, fire safety certificate, computer application certificate with Library Science, etc.).
  • Cut‑off Date: Age, qualification and experience will be computed as on 01 March 2026; experience obtained after this date will not be counted.

Meeting the HLL CNCI eligibility criteria 2026 is mandatory; merely fulfilling the minimum requirements does not guarantee shortlisting for interview.

Age Limit Maximum age for all posts under this HLL CNCI Kolkata Recruitment 2026 is 40 years as on 01 March 2026. Age relaxation for SC, ST, OBC and PwD candidates will be applicable as per Government of India rules.

HLL CNCI Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The HLL CNCI Kolkata Recruitment 2026 selection process is based on shortlisting of applications and an interview conducted by Chittaranjan National Cancer Institute (CNCI). Only candidates who meet all eligibility conditions will be considered for further stages.

  • 1. Application Scrutiny: HLL will scrutinise all online applications and uploaded documents to verify age, educational qualification, experience and other eligibility criteria as per Advertisement No. HLL/HCS/25-26/01.
  • 2. Shortlisting of Candidates: Based on qualification, length and relevance of experience, and project requirements, a limited number of candidates will be shortlisted for interview. The Institute reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called.
  • 3. Interview by CNCI: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview at CNCI, where their technical knowledge, clinical skills (for nursing/paramedical posts), communication, suitability for the role and overall profile will be assessed.
  • 4. Document Verification: All details furnished in the application will be verified against original documents at the time of interview; any discrepancy may lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage.
  • 5. Final Selection & Engagement: Final selection will be made by the competent authority of CNCI/HLL based on interview performance and verification of eligibility, for engagement on a fixed‑term contract of 1 year, extendable as per project requirement and performance.

HLL reserves the right to cancel, modify or restrict the HLL CNCI recruitment process 2026, including alteration in the number of vacancies, and the decision of the competent authority will be final.

How to Apply for HLL CNCI Recruitment 2026

The application process for HLL CNCI Kolkata Nursing, Paramedical and Non‑Medical Recruitment 2026 is completely online through a Google Form. Candidates must submit a digitally filled application form along with all supporting documents on or before 29 March 2026 up to 05:00 PM.

  • Step 1: Open the official Google Form link provided in the advertisement (Click here to Apply) or on the HLL website under the careers/recruitment section.
  • Step 2: Download the prescribed application format from the link available in the form or from the HLL website.
  • Step 3: Fill the application form digitally (in Word/PDF editor) with accurate personal details, contact information, post name and reference code, educational qualifications, and complete employment history.
  • Step 4: Save the duly filled application form as PDF/Word (maximum file size 10 MB) – handwritten applications are not accepted.
  • Step 5: In the Google Form, select the correct post you are applying for and upload: the filled application form, updated CV, educational certificates, experience certificates and latest salary slip, each file not exceeding 10 MB.
  • Step 6: Carefully review all details and uploads in the Google Form and then submit the form online before the last date and time (29.03.2026, 5:00 PM).
  • Step 7: Take a screenshot or note of the submission confirmation for your records; keep copies of the application and documents for use during interview and verification.

Applications not in the prescribed format, submitted after the deadline or with incomplete/incorrect information will be summarily rejected and no correspondence will be entertained.

Eligibility Criteria for UPSSSC Pharmacist 2026

1. Educational Qualification

As per Uttar Pradesh Bheshajik Seva Niyamavali, 1980 (Part-4, Rule-8), candidates must possess a Diploma in Pharmacy from a recognised institution and must also be registered with the State Pharmacy Council, Uttar Pradesh to apply for UPSSSC Pharmacist posts.

2. Preferred Qualification (Adhimani Arhata)

As per Rule-9 of Uttar Pradesh Bheshajik Seva Niyamavali, 1980, preference will be given to candidates who have either served in the Provincial Army for a minimum period of two years, or have obtained the 'B' certificate of the National Cadet Corps (NCC).

3. Age Limit

The age limit for UPSSSC Pharmacist Recruitment 2026 is:

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 40 years
  • Age Relaxation: As per UP Government rules — SC/ST/OBC and other reserved categories will get relaxation as notified from time to time.
  • For UP State Government Employees: 5 years relaxation in upper age limit as per relevant government order.
  • Age Calculation Date: 1st January of the year of recruitment (or 1st July if post is advertised between 1st July to 31st December).

4. Nationality

Candidates must be Indian citizens as specified in the official notification.

5. PET Eligibility Condition

Only those candidates who have appeared in the Preliminary Eligibility Test (PET-2025) and have been issued a score card by UPSSSC are eligible to apply for this Main Examination. Candidates who scored zero or negative marks in PET-2025 will not be shortlisted.

Selection Process for UPSSSC Pharmacist 2026

The selection for UPSSSC Pharmacist Recruitment 2026 will be based on the following process:

  • Shortlisting for Main Examination: Based on normalised scores of PET-2025. Candidates will be shortlisted at 15 times the number of vacancies (up to the final cut-off mark at 2 decimal places).
  • Main Written Examination (Likhit Pariksha): One objective-type question paper with 100 questions, total 100 marks, duration 2 hours (120 minutes). Negative marking of 25% (i.e., ¼ mark) for each wrong answer.
  • Document Verification: For selected candidates after the written exam.

Important Instructions for UPSSSC Pharmacist 2026

  • Only candidates who appeared in PET-2025 and received a score card from UPSSSC are eligible to apply for this Main Examination.
  • Candidates scoring zero or negative (absolute or normalised) marks in PET-2025 will not be shortlisted for the Main Examination.
  • All reserved category candidates from Uttar Pradesh must mention their category in the application form. Only one (most beneficial) reservation will be applicable if a candidate claims multiple categories.
  • Candidates who are not domicile of Uttar Pradesh will not be eligible for reservation benefits and will be treated as General/Unreserved.
  • EWS candidates must possess an EWS certificate issued between 01-04-2025 and 29-03-2026 (application closing date), based on income of financial year 2024-25 and valid for financial year 2025-26.
  • Date of Birth will be verified only from the High School (Class 10) certificate. No other document will be accepted for age proof.
  • Male candidates having more than one living wife, or female candidates married to a person who already has a living wife, will not be eligible.
  • Candidates currently employed in Central or State Government must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer.
  • The Commission will not contact candidates individually. All notifications will be published on the official website upsssc.gov.in only. Candidates must check the website regularly.
  • Providing false or incorrect information in the application may result in cancellation of candidature and debarment from future examinations.
  • Use of unfair means, misbehaviour, or any misconduct in the examination hall will lead to cancellation of candidature and debarment as per UP Public Examination (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act-2024.
  • Application amendment is allowed only up to 05/04/2026 for permissible fields (correspondence address, EWS/horizontal reservation details, qualification details, and marital status). No amendment is possible after this date.
  • For any difficulty in applying online, candidates may contact UPSSSC office on any working day or visit https://upsssc.gov.in.

UPSSSC ASO/ARO Educational Qualification 2026

Educational qualifications must be fulfilled as on the last date of application (11 May 2026).

  • Mandatory Academic Qualification: Post-Graduate degree or equivalent from a legally established Indian university in — Mathematics / Mathematical Statistics / Commerce / Economics / Statistics, OR any government-recognized equivalent qualification. UPSSSC ASO/ARO Selection Process 2026

The UPSSSC ASO/ARO Selection Process 2026 is a two-stage process:

  • Stage 2 – Main Written Examination: 100 objective/MCQ questions, 100 marks, 2 hours duration. Negative marking: 25% (¼ mark deducted per wrong answer).

Salary

  • For all tenure-based ITI posts (Machinist and other trades), the consolidated monthly salary is based on Basic Pay of Rs 18,000 at 7th CPC Level‑1 plus applicable Dearness Allowance (DA) as per Government rules.

  • The pay is treated as consolidated for contract employees, and an annual increase of 3% on the Basic Pay is admissible during the tenure, subject to satisfactory performance in half‑yearly evaluations.

  • Remuneration is calculated at the rate of 1/30th of Basic Pay plus DA for 8 hours of work per day, and proportionate deductions are made for unauthorised leave or absence; contract personnel are also eligible for company holidays at par with regular employees.

  • If company quarters are not provided, HRA is payable, and where quarters are allotted, licence fee is deducted at rates applicable to regular workmen.

Selection Process

  • Selection for all 151 tenure-based ITI posts is purely merit-based, combining NCTVT/NCVT marks and Trade/Practical Test performance.

  • First, candidates are shortlisted for Trade/Practical Test on the basis of total marks obtained in the NCTVT/NCVT exam; the cut‑off percentage for calling candidates is decided by Ordnance Factory Kanpur.

  • A Trade/Practical Test is then conducted for the relevant trade (Machinist, Examiner, Electrician, etc.) at Ordnance Factory Kanpur to assess hands‑on skills.

  • The final merit list is prepared using combined scores with 80% weightage to NCTVT/NCVT exam marks and 20% weightage to the Trade/Practical Test.

  • Candidates placed in merit are called for Document Verification, where all original certificates and eligibility conditions are checked; if some candidates are rejected at this stage, additional candidates in order of merit may be called until all notified posts are covered.

Application Fees

  • The application fee is Rs 100 per candidate, to be paid via Demand Draft in favour of “ORDNANCE FACTORY KANPUR” for both advertisements.

  • SC/ST, Ex‑Servicemen and Physically Handicapped (PwD) candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

  • The fee must be enclosed with the offline application form in the prescribed manner; applications without the required fee (where applicable) are liable to be rejected.

How to Apply Ordnance Factory Kanpur Recruitment 2026 (151 Posts)

  • Applications are accepted offline only for all 151 tenure-based ITI posts under Ordnance Factory Kanpur Recruitment 2026.

  • Candidates must download and print the prescribed application form format from the official notice section of the AWEIL website (aweil.in/notice) as given in the two recruitment advertisements for 116 Machinist posts and 35 trades posts.

  • Fill the application form in block letters, carefully entering personal details, educational qualifications (10th and NTC/NAC), trade applied for, category, and contact details as required in the format.

  • Attach self-attested copies of:

    • Class 10th certificate/marksheet (as proof of date of birth)

    • NTC/NAC certificate in the relevant trade

    • Caste/category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD), Ex‑serviceman documents, etc., if applicable

    • Any other documents specified in the notifications.

  • Paste the required photograph on the form and enclose two extra self‑attested passport-size photographs as instructed.

  • Prepare the application fee Demand Draft of Rs 100 (where applicable) in favour of “ORDNANCE FACTORY KANPUR”; SC/ST, Ex‑Servicemen and PwD candidates are exempt from the fee.

  • Place the filled form, DD and documents in an envelope clearly superscribed with the relevant post, for example:

    • “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF MACHINIST (SS) ON CONTRACT BASIS” (for 116 Machinist posts), or

    • “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ‘TRADE NAME’ ON CONTRACT BASIS” (for Examiner, Electrician, etc.).

  • Send the envelope by post to: The Chief General Manager,Ordnance Factory Kanpur,Kalpi Road, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh – 208009, ensuring it reaches on or before 08 April 2026; applications received after the last date or incomplete/unsigned are liable to be rejected.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications (Post 01 – Sanket Mook aur Badhir Vidyalay Teacher):
    • Intermediate or equivalent exam passed from Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad UP or Government-recognized Board.
    • Diploma in Special Education (Hearing Impairment) from Bhartiya Punarvas Parishad (RCI), recognized by Government of India.
    • Knowledge of reading and writing Hindi/English in Sign Language.
    • Registration with Bhartiya Punarvas Parishad (RCI) as a specialist teacher for hearing impaired.
  • Qualifications (Post 02 – Drishtibaadhit Vidyalay Shilp/Sangeet Teacher):
    • Intermediate with Music as a subject from Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad UP or equivalent diploma in Music.
    • Diploma in Special Education (Visual Impairment) from RCI recognized institution.
    • Knowledge of reading and writing Hindi/English in Braille script.
    • Registration with RCI as a specialist teacher for visually impaired.
  • Qualifications (Post 03 – Sparsh Drishtibaadhit Vidyalay Teacher):
    • Intermediate or equivalent from Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad UP or recognized board.
    • Diploma in Special Education (Visual Impairment) from RCI-recognized institution.
    • Knowledge of reading and writing Hindi/English in Braille script.
    • Registration with RCI as specialist teacher for visually impaired.
  • Qualifications (Post 04 – Shaareerik Roop se Aksham Vidyalay Teacher):
    • Intermediate or equivalent from Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad UP or recognized board.
    • Diploma in Special Education (Loco Motor/Cerebral Palsy) from RCI-recognized institution.
    • Registration with RCI as specialist teacher for loco motor/cerebral palsy.
  • Qualifications (Post 05 – Prayas Vidyalay Teacher):
    • Intermediate or equivalent from Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad UP or recognized board.
    • Diploma in Special Education (Loco Motor/Cerebral Palsy) from RCI-recognized institution.
    • Registration with RCI as specialist teacher for loco motor/cerebral palsy.
  • Qualifications (Post 06 – Mamta Maansik Roop se Avikasit Vidyalay Teacher):
    • Intermediate or equivalent from Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad UP or recognized board.
    • Diploma in Special Education (Intellectual Disability/Mental Retardation) from RCI-recognized institution.
    • Registration with RCI as specialist teacher for mentally underdeveloped.
  • Desirable (All Posts):
    • Served in Territorial Army for a minimum of 02 years, OR
    • Obtained 'B' certificate of National Cadet Corps (NCC).
  • Only those candidates who appeared in Prarambhik Aharta Pariksha-2025 (PET-2025) and have been issued Score Card by the Commission are eligible to apply for the Main Exam.
  • Candidates must possess all required mandatory educational qualifications by the last date of application i.e., 27-04-2026.

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Level: Level-6
  • Minimum Pay (Vetanmaan): ₹35,400/- Per Month
  • Maximum Pay (Vetanmaan): ₹1,12,400/- Per Month
  • Grade Pay/Pay Band: JO.T0.SI0 Grade (Posts 01, 02, 03, 05, 06, 07) | H0.T0.SI0 Grade (Post 04)
  • Pay is applicable as per Uttar Pradesh Divyangjan Sashaktikaran Vibhag Adhyapak Seva Niyamavali, 2000 (as amended up to 4th Amendment 2022).

Age Limit (as on 01-07-2026)

  • Minimum Age: 21 Years
  • Maximum Age: 40 Years
  • Age is determined as of the first of July of the calendar year in which vacancies are advertised.
  • Age Relaxation:
    • SC/ST candidates: Upper age relaxation as per UP Government rules.
    • OBC candidates: Upper age relaxation as per UP Government rules.
    • State Government employees (serving): 5 years relaxation in upper age limit as per GO No. 2-ई.एम./2001-का-4-2013, dated 27-08-2013.
    • Ex-Servicemen: Age relaxation as per UP Lok Seva (Reservation) Act, 1993 (as amended).
    • Mukhyamantri Adhyetavritti candidates: Relaxation as per UP Shasan Karmic Anubhag-2 Adhisoochna No. 01/2026/06/47-ka-2-2026, dated 30-01-2026.

  • Dependants of Freedom Fighters, Ex-Servicemen, Women, Divyangjan, and Outstanding Sportspersons will pay fee as per their original category mentioned above (Sl. 1–4).
  • Fee payment modes accepted: Credit Card, Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI, or SBI e-Challan.
  • Fee for Main Exam will be charged separately and must be paid before downloading the Main Exam Admit Card by shortlisted candidates only.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Publication Date 13-03-2026
Online Application / Fee Submission Start Date 06-04-2026
Last Date for Online Application and Fee Submission 27-04-2026
Last Date for Fee Reconciliation and Application Correction 04-05-2026

Selection Process

  • Stage 1 – Written Examination (Main Exam):
    • One question paper containing 100 objective-type, multiple-choice questions.
    • Total duration: 120 Minutes (Two Hours).
    • Each question carries 1 mark. Negative marking: 25% (i.e., ¼ of the mark prescribed for each wrong answer).
    • Exam Plan:
      • Part-1: Introduction to Disability (25 Marks) + Child Development & Learning (20 Marks) + Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 (20 Marks)
      • Part-2: Knowledge of Concepts of Computer and IT and Contemporary Technological Development (15 Marks)
      • Part-3: General Information related to the State of Uttar Pradesh (20 Marks)
      • Total: 100 Questions – 100 Marks
    • Shortlisting for Written Exam will be based on normalized score of PET-2025 (15 times the number of advertised posts).
  • Stage 2 – Qualifying Exam (Skill Test):
    • Candidates shortlisted on the basis of written exam marks will appear for Sign Language and Braille Script Proficiency Test (qualifying in nature).
    • For posts where Sign Language/Braille Script knowledge is not required in eligibility criteria, selection will be based on written exam only.
    • Sign Language Proficiency Test:
      • Component 1: Text to Sign Language Conversion – More than 20 functional words; 8 minutes; qualifying: minimum 10 functional words correctly converted.
      • Component 2: Sign Language to Text Conversion – More than 20 functional words; 8 minutes; qualifying: minimum 10 functional words correctly converted.
    • Braille Script Proficiency Test:
      • Component 1: Text to Braille Script Writing – 150–200 Hindi words; 10 minutes; qualifying: minimum 60 words accurately written in Braille.
      • Component 2: Braille Script to Text Writing – 80–100 Hindi words; 10 minutes; qualifying: minimum 40 words read and written accurately.

How to Apply

  • Application must be submitted ONLY through the Online Application System on the Commission's website upsssc.gov.in. Applications submitted through any other means will not be accepted.
  • Visit the Homepage of upsssc.gov.in and click on the relevant advertisement under the Live Advertisement Segment to download/view the notification.
  • Candidates must login using their PET-2025 Registration Number along with the OTP sent to their registered mobile number/email.
  • After login, personal details pre-filled from PET-2025 registration will be displayed. Candidates must verify and select the posts they wish to apply for.
  • Select the post(s), fill in qualification details (Board/University name, pass year, certificate/roll number, issue date, marks details), and proceed.
  • Photo and signature uploaded during PET-2025 will be auto-displayed. No changes can be made to these.
  • Fill in post preference and additional qualification details in the "Other Details" section.
  • Enter the Verification Code displayed on the Registration Page and click the "Submit" button.
  • Pay the prescribed fee using Credit Card / Debit Card / Internet Banking / UPI / SBI e-Challan before the last date (27-04-2026).
  • After successful fee payment/reconciliation, the application form will be auto-submitted and displayed on screen. Candidates must download and print the application form.
  • Application correction is permitted up to 04-05-2026 for fields like correspondence address, EWS/OBC category, gender, disability category, and marital status.
  • Only one application per candidate. If multiple applications are submitted, only the last submitted application will be considered valid.

Vacancy Details

High Court of Allahabad has announced the recruitment of Special Judicial Magistrates for two districts in Uttar Pradesh. These positions are on a fixed honorarium basis with conveyance allowance. The recruitment is open for Government servants or former Government employees who possess legal qualifications or have extensive experience in legal affairs.

District Vacancy Position
Gonda 1 Special Judicial Magistrate
Jalaun (Orai) 1 Special Judicial Magistrate

Eligibility Criteria

Essential Qualifications

  • Status: Must be a Government servant (current or former) OR has held any post under the Government of India/State Government/Union Territory
  • Educational Qualification: Must possess:
    • Law degree (LL.B. from a recognized university), OR
    • Be well-experienced in relation to legal affairs to the satisfaction of the High Court
  • Professional Background: Experience in legal matters, judicial work, or administrative/legal roles under Government is an advantage

Term & Age

  • Term of Office: 4 years from the date of assumption of charge OR attaining the age of 70 years, whichever is earlier
  • Age Limit: No specific upper age limit mentioned, but term ends at age 70
  • Transferability: A candidate appointed for a specific district shall NOT be transferred to any other district under any circumstances

Previous SJM/SMM Experience

  • Ex-SJMs appointed by Government of Uttar Pradesh do NOT need to submit character roll entries
  • Ex-SJMs applying for re-appointment must enclose four best judgments delivered while holding the post of SJM/SMM

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Released 09.02.2026
Application Submission Last Date 13-04-2026
Selection Process Merit-based by High Court
Term of Office 4 Years or Age 70 years

Selection Process

  • Application Scrutiny: All applications are submitted to the respective District Judge who conducts preliminary scrutiny
  • District Judge Review: The District Judge reviews applications and forwards only those he finds fit for the SJM post to the High Court with his remarks
  • High Court Evaluation: The High Court evaluates forwarded applications based on qualifications, experience, and legal expertise
  • Merit-Based Selection: Selection is based on merit, qualifications, Government service record, and experience in legal matters
  • Final Appointment: Appointment is made by the High Court through formal order of the Court

Salary/Remuneration

  • Fixed Honorarium: ₹45,000/- per month (fixed, subject to correction and updation by High Court)
  • Conveyance Allowance: ₹5,000/- per month for official travel and conveyance
  • Total Monthly Remuneration: ₹50,000/- per month (base honorarium + conveyance)
  • Payment: Subject to correction and updation from time to time as per High Court guidelines

How to Apply

Application Preparation

  1. Download the Application Form from the official High Court notification PDF
  2. Fill all columns of the application form in block letters (all columns are compulsory)
  3. Affix a self-attested recent passport-size photograph
  4. Provide complete and accurate information including:
    • Full name, father's name, date of birth
    • Current and permanent residential addresses with PIN codes
    • Email address and mobile number
    • Details of posts held under the Government (designation, pay scale, duration, retirement date)
    • Educational qualifications (High School, Intermediate, Graduation, LL.B., and any other qualifications)
    • Whether previously worked as SJM/SMM with year-wise details and annual confidential report percentages
  5. Mention whether any criminal case is pending or FIR lodged
  6. Sign the declaration that all information provided is correct

Required Documents (Self-Attested)

  • Photocopies of all relevant documents mentioned in the application
  • Character roll entries of the last 5 years of Government service (if applicable)
  • Law degree certificate and other educational qualification certificates
  • Copy of Gazette notification of Government service record
  • For ex-SJMs applying for re-appointment: Four best judgments delivered as SJM/SMM
  • Annual Confidential Reports (ACR) for the last 5 years (if available)
  • Self-attested photograph (4x6 cm)

Submission Mode

  1. Applicants must submit their applications OFFLINE directly to the respective District Judge of the district for which they are applying
  2. Do NOT send applications directly to the High Court — applications sent directly to High Court will be rejected
  3. Submit to the following District Judges based on your choice:
    • For Gonda: District Judge, Gonda District Court
    • For Jalaun: District Judge, Jalaun District Court
  4. Ensure all documents are complete and properly organized
  5. Keep a copy of submitted application for reference
